jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (CMK/Encryption Platform)
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.

The CMK/Encryption Platform Product Lead is responsible for product strategy, roadmap definition, and cross-functional execution for Atlassian's encryption platform work. The role spans both customer-facing capabilities and foundational platform services, requiring strong judgment on where to standardize, where to differentiate, and how to sequence investments across security, scale, and commercial impact.

This leader will work across product, engineering, security, go-to-market, legal, compliance, and customer-facing teams to ensure Atlassian's encryption capabilities meet enterprise expectations while remaining durable, usable, and economically sound.

The team's scope includes:

  • Customer Managed Keys strategy, roadmap, packaging, and lifecycle
  • Cryptor and related encryption platform capabilities used across Atlassian Cloud
  • Bring Your Own Key and external key management patterns, including future-facing options where relevant
  • Encryption standards, architecture direction, and platform consistency across products and cells
  • Enterprise customer requirements related to trust, control, compliance, and key management
  • Prioritization of investments that balance customer demand, risk reduction, platform leverage, and revenue influence

What you'll do

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for CMK and encryption platform capabilities across Atlassian Cloud
  • Clarify product scope and platform boundaries across CMK, Encryption Platfrom, and adjacent encryption services so teams can execute with clear accountability
  • Drive roadmap decisions across customer commitments, enterprise needs, architecture constraints, and commercial priorities
  • Partner closely with engineering and security leaders on encryption architecture, technical direction, delivery sequencing, and operational readiness
  • Lead planning for key initiatives such as CMK expansion, platform standardization, key management evolution, cell-scoped capabilities, and efficiency improvements
  • Represent the product area in executive, cross-functional, and customer settings with clear narrative, strong judgment, and crisp tradeoff framing
  • Work with field, support, and customer-facing teams to understand enterprise demand, shape adoption strategy, and unblock strategic opportunities
  • Ensure roadmap choices reflect security, compliance, resilience, scale, and usability expectations for a critical trust capability
  • Create alignment across product, platform, and go-to-market teams on what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured
  • Maintain continuity on in-flight work while improving role clarity, planning quality, and long-term portfolio coherence

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, eCommerce
jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Set the product strategy, quarterly goals, and success metrics, and present progress against milestones to executive leadership and finance
  • Own the unit economics that define launch readiness (success metrics, traffic quality, funnel efficiency), and make the call on when the data supports scaling, pivoting, or stopping
  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in performance advertising: DSP, retargeting platform, measurement/MMP, or ad network e-commerce products
  • Hands-on depth in web and mobile identity and attribution: probabilistic matching (IP and device signals), pixels, server-to-server postbacks, and the practical constraints of browser privacy changes (ITP, fingerprinting protection) and ATT
  • A track record of carrying a product from beta to GA, inc

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy
jobs.desc:
About the team

StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated.
This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do.
This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.

You Will Get To

  • Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing.
  • Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts.
  • Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market.
  • Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing.
  • Navigate the structural tension between organic relevance and advertising products that are core to the business model - not a side constraint, but a daily design problem.
  • Set the measurement framework for search quality in a non-deterministic, AI-powered experience - defining what "good" looks like when you can't rely on clean A/B tests alone.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

jobs.desc:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.

Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices, where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.

The install experience is critical to the compounding value of every Samsara product. A camera aimed correctly on day one trains better safety models. A gateway reporting cleanly makes every downstream workflow trustworthy.

You will own the software install experience end to end, with a dedicated engineering and design team, and you will own one number: install correctness, the share of installs completed right on the first attempt. Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.

You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.

To understand the scale of this problem, review the Samsara Vehicle Gateway here, our full hardware lineup here, and our installer partner network here.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. 

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master

The core ethernet layer - EPL, EVPL, and virtual connections - is the revenue engine at the heart of Fabric.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own this core ethernet services portfolio, spanning Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG management, service tokens, and Equinix Metro Connect (Fabric Metro Connect). jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Marketplace Supply
jobs.desc:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com.

The role

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You'll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it's working, and you'll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you'll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.
  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.
  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.
  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.
  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you'll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.
  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.
  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.
  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.

  • Paid parental leave.
  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows
jobs.desc:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery - agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

You Will Get To

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production
  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy
  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute
  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome
  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey
  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

jobs.desc:
Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, and execution of a core product squad. In this role, you’ll lead engineers and designers to ship high-quality, high-impact features that improve contractor workflows, while connecting product decisions to measurable business and growth outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong product mindset with customer obsession and a high bar for execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the squad roadmap, strategy, and execution for a core product area.
  • Conduct continuous customer discovery - interviews, prototypes, field visits - and turn insights into clear specs, user stories, and priorities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to iterate quickly and deliver intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Define adoption, activation, and retention metrics; set up tracking, analyze performance, and iterate based on data.
  • Produce and update our roadmap and communicate product direction across leadership and GTM teams.
  • Translate features into benefits and customer outcomes, supporting sales, marketing, and onboarding with clear collateral.
  • Sweat the details - QA, polish, and validate every flow and edge case before launch.
  • Apply Handoff’s product principles - simplemaxxing, mobile-first, AI-first, and customer-obsession - to every design, feature, and product decision

About you

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in vertical SaaS.
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products; with AI experience strongly preferred.
  • Track record of shipping 0→1 or early-stage features.
  • Strong skills in customer discovery, research, and ruthless prioritization.
  • Proven ability to work hand-in-hand with engineers and designers in agile environments.
  • Excellent writing and communication - able to produce crisp specs, epics, and roadmap docs.
  • Excitement about construction, remodeling, and home services - genuine curiosity about contractors’ world.
  • Bonus experience: CRM, project management tools, payments/fintech, AI-driven products, or PLG (product-led growth).
  • Startup DNA - comfort in ambiguity, bias for action, stamina for fast-moving environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA)
  • Relocation Allowance
  • Top-Notch Equipment
  • Team Offsites

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Kiss My Apps — компанія-платформа, що об’єднує 7 продуктових вертикалей та 30+ AI-first продуктів, 100+ мільйонів користувачів, власну екосистему аналітичних, пеймент та маркетингових розробок.

Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо Lead Product Manager, того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль:

Шукаємо Lead Product Manager, який(а) очолить розвиток одного з наших AI-driven застосунків на ринку, що активно зростає. Це роль із повним ownership за результат продукту — від формування продуктової стратегії до масштабування growth-каналів.

Наші продукти вже мають підтверджений product-market fit і значний потенціал кратного зростання. Твоя задача — знайти та оптимізувати робочу юніт-економіку, вибудувати системний процес продуктових експериментів і масштабувати продукт через продуктову розробку та performance-маркетинг.

Ця роль для людини, яка хоче не просто підтримувати існуючий продукт, а драйвити його масштабування, впливати на ключові метрики бізнесу та будувати продукт із потенціалом стати флагманом у своїй ніші.

Твої задачі:

  • Визначення продуктової та growth-стратегії для масштабування.

  • Пошук і стабілізація юніт-економіки продукту: pricing, paywall, retention, acquisition та ключові продуктові метрики.

  • Побудова системного процесу продуктових експериментів для зростання revenue та масштабування продукту.

  • Управління продуктовою командою та формування чітких цілей розвитку продукту.

  • Тісна робота з маркетингом для масштабування закупки трафіку (Meta, CPA-мережі та інші канали).

  • Прийняття ключових рішень по продукту: стратегія, позиціонування, монетизація, roadmap та розвиток команди.

Що очікуємо від тебе:

  • Досвід роботи з мобільними застосунками та розуміння специфіки mobile-ринку.

  • Практичний досвід масштабування продуктів або запуску нових продуктів з відчутним growth-результатом.

  • Сильна експертиза у продуктовій аналітиці та юніт-економіці.

  • Розуміння performance-маркетингу та досвід роботи з каналами платного трафіку (Meta, CPA networks тощо).

  • Досвід роботи з subscription-моделями монетизації.

Ми точно заметчимось, якщо ти не боїшся приймати сміливі рішення, ризикувати та завжди досягаєш своєї мети.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).

  • Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформ

About Versapay 

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

As Senior Product Manager, Payments, you will own the end-to-end payments product and experience, from customer-facing workflows through underlying processing, settlement, and partner integrations.

You will operate with a holistic mindset—owning outcomes across reliability, usability, scalability, and commercial performance—rather than isolated features. 
This role pairs deep payments domain ownership with modern product management practices. You will lead end-to-end product development, drive customer and business value through data-informed decisions, and collaborate across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative payments experiences. You will also regularly represent the payments product strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment decisions. 
This is an opportunity for a product leader who thrives in complexity, is energized by ambiguity, and is excited to help grow and modernize a global payments platform.

jobs.desc:
Kindred is a members-only home swapping platform that unlocks the ability to live a travel-rich lifestyle through the power of community. By exchanging primary residences with trusted peers, renters and owners alike can match with Kindred spirits and explore new destinations without breaking the bank.

Kindred is revolutionizing the “third option” of travel accommodation, compared to short-term rentals and hotels. Since launching in 2022, Kindred has grown to a global community of 300,000 members across 150+ cities and puts home swapping on the map as a radically more affordable, responsible, and connected way to travel.

To support that momentum, Kindred has raised over $150M in capital from some of the most credible investors in Silicon Valley, including Index Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, New Enterprise Associates, Bessemer Venture Partners, Caffeinated Capital, Elad Gil, and founders of companies like Opendoor, Figma, ClassPass, and more.

Kindred’s co-founders are proven leaders from the early team at Opendoor ($15B+ exit), who have each built and scaled products that today generate $1B+ annual revenue combined.

We’re looking for the world’s top builders, executors, and believers to help us make travel more meaningful.

You can learn more about us in Forbes and The New York Times.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of travel. This is a high-impact, strategic role where you'll work closely with our co-founders and a full-stack team to solve complex, deeply human challenges—like how to make hosting your personal home feel natural, how to scale a community without compromising quality, and how to create systems that serve both sides of a marketplace.

We’re looking for someone with deep consumer intuition and empathy and an exceptionally user-centric approach to problem-solving. This is fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and emotionally meaningful work—with the potential to reshape how people travel and connect.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and lead key areas of the core product experience (e.g. growth, search & discovery, hosting) with a team of 8-10 engineers.

  • Design systems that build trust, balance marketplace dynamics, and drive measurable outcomes for both our members and the business.

  • Lead 0→1 and 1→n initiatives across surfaces that require speed, creativity, and craft.

  • Use data to size opportunities, uncover insights, and evaluate performance (both qualitative and quantitative).

  • Collaborate closely with design, engineering, data and other cross-functional partners to scope, build, and ship products.

  • Champion product quality, simplicity, and craft.

  • Deeply understand and advocate for member needs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Cluster Linking
jobs.desc:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About the Role:

Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.

This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.

Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.

What You Will Do:

  • Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.

  • Define the future of real-time stream sharing across organizations, including its security model, networking, access controls, and how it scales across organizations and use cases.

  • Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.

  • Segment and re-package Cluster Linking. The product serves Disaster Recovery, migrations, data sharing, and cross-cloud replication, each with different customer needs and pricing dynamics. Define how we package, price, and position each so the offering works for customers and drives growth.

  • Partner closely with your engineering manager counterpart as a strategic partner. Use that partnership to understand tradeoffs, make decisions fast, and keep the product moving forward.

  • Work directly with customers. You'll be pulled in many directions, customers will ask a lot of you. Your job is to steer them toward the right architectures and models, get them excited about what's coming, listen to what they need next, and balance the present opportunity with where the product is headed.

  • Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.

  • Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.

About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunisation rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >4M people. Your role

As Lead Product Manager, you will own a set of Saturn's product areas in their entirety: strategy, roadmap, commercial outcomes, and the product managers who build them.a

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed company building the AI-native operating system for financial advice. Our platform combines a living data model of the client, AI agents that complete complex advice and operational workflows, and compliance logic embedded directly into how work is produced. The initial wedge is adviser productivity. The larger opportunity is rebuilding the operating model of the advice firm around connected data, intelligent workflows and continuous regulatory control.

This is a lead role with founder-level scope. You work directly with the CEO, engineers, partnerships, and associate product managers. You define the what and why with enough clarity that one engineer ships the whole feature. No handoff chain, no ambiguity, no hand-waving. Your work will determine whether Saturn becomes the intelligence layer through which advice is created, governed and delivered.

The Team

You will work in a cross-functional squad alongside Product Engineers who own features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and AI, plus Design and Saturn’s domain experts: chartered compliance officers and paraplanners. Product management at Saturn moves fast, and we protect that pace deliberately. The best PMs do their best work when they can see the impact of what they ship.

  • Owning the product strategy and a rolling 3-6 month roadmap for AI agents that automate advice workflows

  • Running independent discovery with advisers and paraplanners, distinguishing signal from noise, and turning adviser pain into product direction

  • Balancing enterprise partner demands with product coherence, and sequencing releases against the go-to-market calendar
  • Treating go-to-market as part of the build. You ship features that land, not features that launch
  • Coaching and multiplying the PMs around you, and building the frameworks the product function adopts as it grows

  • Product management experience at fast-paced, product-led B2B SaaS companies, including ownership of a product that shipped and won in market

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss AI architecture trade-offs, know why prompts break, and challenge engineering assumptions

Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
San Francisco, CA · Full-time · In person

Screenpipe gives AI agents memory of your work. It keeps raw computer history local by default and makes that context available to the AI tools you choose.

We're looking for a senior PM who can make a powerful technical product simple and useful in everyday work.

You'll work directly with the founder and engineers, owning the path from understanding a customer's problem to shipping a change and seeing whether it helped.

What you'll own

  • Customer discovery. Talk to users regularly, watch them use the product, and understand what they are trying to get done.
  • The customer journey. Help people move from installing Screenpipe to getting a useful result and making it part of their routine.
  • Product priorities. Combine interviews, support feedback and product data to decide what matters next and what can wait.
  • Delivery. Turn problems into clear flows, prototypes and scoped work. Stay involved through implementation, release and follow-up.
  • Product outcomes. Define meaningful activation and retention measures, run focused experiments, and check whether changes improve real usage.
  • Trust. Treat privacy, permissions and clear explanations as part of the user experience.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned a software product end to end and can explain what you personally shipped, why you chose it and what happened afterward.
  • You have strong UX judgment and know how to test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're comfortable with product analytics, funnels and cohorts, including questioning how a metric is defined.
  • You can use AI tools to investigate problems and build prototypes, and work closely with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and can make decisions with incomplete information.
  • You're based in San Francisco and want to work together in person.

Experience with early-stage products, desktop software, developer tools or AI agents is useful.

Why Screenpipe

This is a chance to shape how people use AI with the context of their actual work. You'll have direct access to users, a public codebase to learn from, and room to carry an idea from discovery through to a working product.

Benefits

  • Health and recovery: Personal health coach or trainer, gym membership, sauna and cold plunge access, and unlimited massages.
  • Health insurance: Top-tier health insurance.
  • Flexibility: San Francisco is our home base, with flexibility to work remotely from time to time, including trips abroad such as Thailand.
  • Learning: Unlimited books and audiobooks, on us.
  • AI tools: $20,000 per month in AI tokens to build, experiment, and do your best work.
  • Personal growth: Career and life coaching.
  • Team travel: Team trips and work retreats, including places like Hawaii.

Compensation

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 per year. Equity range: 0.25% to 1.00% on a fully diluted basis. Final compensation depends on experience and role scope. Any equity grant is subject to board approval, equity plan terms, vesting and definitive documents.

This role is full-time and in person in San Francisco. We are not offering visa sponsorship for this role.

Apply

Send us a product you helped build and a short explanation of your contribution. Include one example of a customer insight that changed what you shipped. Please use public examples or anonymize confidential details.

Explore Screenpipe and the codebase, then apply through YC.

How

About Us

Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home.

Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access.

We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered.

About You

Axle Health is building the operating system for home healthcare - scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement tools that give health systems and home-based care providers the infrastructure to run better, faster, and at greater scale. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own critical product initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and GTM teams to ship features that meaningfully improve how clinicians deliver care and how operations teams run the day-to-day. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product, where you'll have significant autonomy to shape what we build and how.

The Senior Product Manager who thrives here isn't waiting for a fully-scoped customer request to land in their lap. You have genuine product taste. You can look at a workflow and see immediately where the friction is, articulate what a great experience should feel like for home healthcare providers , and champion that standard all the way through to launch. You're a true advocate for the customer and the user - someone who leans into the user experience and holds the bar on experience even when it's easier to ship something just good enough. You're equally comfortable digging into the data and riding along with our customers to understand what they actually need.

You've shipped B2B vertical SaaS products at early-stage startups and know what it takes to move fast with limited resources, make smart trade-offs without losing sight of the user, and build things people actually want to use.

We do not monitor YC applications, please apply directly on our website to be considered for this position: https://www.axlehealth.com/careers

What You'll Do

  • Product Ownership: Own strategy and execution for key features within our scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement platforms - from discovery through launch and iteration

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, PBM Platform
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

  

Rightway is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own claims adjudication, the system at the center of Rightway's PBM. Adjudication covers the full lifecycle of a pharmacy claim: eligibility, coverage, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits. It is one of the most complex and consequential product areas at Rightway, and this role owns its strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

You will develop deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate today and use that to define where the platform goes next — working through real claim behavior alongside engineering, writing requirements precise enough to build against, setting the bar for correctness, and owning the validation approach that proves the system is ready for production volume. The role reports to the Director, Product Management, and operates with a high degree of independence. It requires someone who can take full ownership of a major product initiative and work cross-functionally across product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plan for claims adjudication, including how it scales with volume, new clients, and new lines of business
* Build deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate across eligibility, coverage rules, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits, and turn that into a structured, prioritized plan
* Define the long-term strategy for how the platform evolves to support operational scale, regulatory requirements, and new lines of business, including Medicare
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can execute against, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination in an agile environment
* Partner day to day with the adjudication engineering team to sequence work, manage dependencies, and resolve ambiguity in claim behavior quickly
* Set the bar for correctness and own the testing and claim certification approach that proves the system is ready for production volume
* Own readiness and rollout planning, including validation against real claim volume, parallel testing, and phased release
* Coordinate go-live readiness across operations, clinical, client success, and compliance so changes land without disruption to members or clients
* Partner with PBM operations, clinical, legal, and client success teams to ensure the platform meets workflow and regulatory requirements
* Manage the drug data, formulary, and prior authorization dependencies adjudication relies on, treating the internal teams who own them as first-class partners
* Define and track KPIs for claim accuracy, system performance, and reliability
* Act as the primary product point of contact for adjudication across the organization and with external partners

**WHO YOU ARE:**

  

* Bachelor's degree required; 5 or more years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare or enterprise technology
* Experience with complex, rules-driven transaction processing systems such as claims adjudication, payments, or benefit administration, including responsibility for correctness and testing
* Experience leading a platform migration or major system transition from requirements through go-live
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving product, engineering, legal, and operations stakeholders
* Ability to work independently and drive execution with minimal direction
* Strong communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams
* Detail oriented and process focused, and comfortable in a domain where correctness is measured claim by claim
* Comfortable working across complex, data-heavy systems
* Curious and adaptable, willing to dig into unfamiliar and highly technical territory and find answers
* Experience working in or with PBMs, pharmacy claims, or pharmacy operations is a plus
* Familiarity with systems that support regulated healthcare markets

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

**About Exposure Management**

Beazley Security’s Exposure Management platform provides continuous, automated visibility into organizations, internet-facing footprint: domains, IPs, exposed services, and externally accessilbe software. It goes b eyond simple asset discovery, integrating intelligence from Beazley Security Labs to highlight the exposures that matter most and guide focused, effective risk reduction. Exposure Management continuously scans organizations' externally-facing assets to provide a comprehensive view of their attack surface in near real time. By having near real time visibility to changes to

organizations' attack surface, along with proactive prompts and curated intelligence on known exploited vulnerabilities that affect environment’s assets, IT and security teams can take action to mitigate threats. This pre-emptive approach is essential to addressing potential risk before it can materialize.

As an extension of Exposure Management, Beazley Security launched two companion products: Dark Web Monitoring (DWM) and Third-Party Risk Monitoring (TPRM). TPRM evaluates key suppliers for security issues that could impact organizations. With TPRM, organizations can monitor vendor security posture in near real time with dynamic scoring based on vendors' access to their corporate systems, the sensitivity of data that they can access, and criticality to

business operations. DWM focuses on monitoring compromised user credential, notifying clients before attackers can exploit these credentials.

As Senior Product Manager for Beazley Security's Exposure Management (EM) suite, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the products that help clients continuously discover, prioritize, and reduce risk across their external attack surface.

We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

-------------------

Mindbody is seeking a **Principal Product Manager, Agentic Experience** to define how AI transforms the way businesses use our industry-leading B2B software platform.

This role will own the vision, strategy, and execution for incorporating agentic workflows into Mindbody's business experience. Your mandate spans both sides of the opportunity: envisioning an AI-first user experience that meaningfully improves how customers operate their businesses, and establishing the underlying platform capabilities that allow Mindbody teams to build reliable agentic workflows quickly, safely, and at scale.

This is not a role focused on adding isolated AI features or conversational interfaces to existing workflows. You will determine where agents can fundamentally simplify work, coordinate actions across the platform, and help customers achieve outcomes with less effort. You will also define the quality, evaluation, trust, and governance systems necessary to make non-deterministic products dependable in real business environments.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will operate as a senior individual contributor and organizational leader. * Establish a compelling vision for an **AI-first B2B user experience** across Mindbody's platform.
* Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for agentic experiences and their enabling platform capabilities.
* Identify the workflows where agentic systems can create meaningful customer and business value—not merely add novelty or incremental convenience.
* Determine the appropriate interaction models for agents, including proactive assistance, workflow orchestration, recommendations, approvals, and autonomous actions.
* Translate rapidly evolving AI capabilities into durable product strategy grounded in customer needs, technical feasibility, economics, and risk.
* Define clear boundaries between deterministic software, AI-assisted experiences, and agent-led workflows.

### **Build trusted agentic experiences**

* Lead the development of agentic workflows designed specifically for B2B users and their operational needs.
* Create experiences that make agent reasoning, proposed actions, uncertainty, and outcomes understandable to users.

* Design for user trust and control through confirmation patterns, reversibility, auditability, and effective recovery from errors.
* Partner with Design and Research to establish reusable interaction patterns for AI-first experiences across Mindbody.

jobs.desc:
**About Smokeball**  
Smokeball powers people-law. Our legal practice management software lightens the administrative burden, so legal professionals can serve those who need them most. With offices in Australia, the US, and the UK, culture plays a big part in our success, and our clear purpose and vision motivate us daily.

**Senior Product Manager, Personal Injury**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to help rebuild and expand Smokeball’s Personal Injury (PI) offering. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role where you’ll own a PI product area from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration — working directly with US personal injury firms and our engineering team in Australia.

You’ll report to the leader of our PI product team and work alongside our other Senior Product Manager, with the two of you sharing ownership of the PI portfolio. You’ll own your roadmap, make the calls on what gets built and why, and be accountable for the impact it delivers. Priorities will move, problems will change, and you’ll need to be comfortable jumping into something new, getting up to speed quickly, talking to customers, and turning messy problems into smart, well-scoped solutions.

One important thing: **don’t come in swinging a redesign hammer.** First, get to know the product. Firms rely on what exists today, and the quirks you might spot often exist for a reason. Your first job is to understand the *why* before deciding what should change.

We also build with AI in the loop. You should be comfortable using AI tools to design, experiment, and prototype — including Claude Code — and turning ideas into something customers can actually click on and react to. Around here, a good prototype can do a lot of the heavy lifting that a 20-page spec normally would.

Most importantly, this is a role for a Senior PM who wants to **do the craft, not just talk about it**. You’ll be in customer calls, sketching flows, building prototypes, making product calls, and getting into the backlog — not watching it all happen from a safe distance.

This is a **hybrid** position based in our Chicago, IL office. All Chicagoland employees are required to be in the office on **Wednesdays and Thursdays**.

**Customer discovery & validation**

* Build strong relationships with US personal injury firms and our in-house PI attorney to understand workflows, pain points, and market expectations.
* Run customer interviews, usability testing, and validation across your product areas.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to identify recurring customer and commercial problems.
* Develop a deep understanding of the existing PI product and the legal and workflow decisions behind it before proposing changes.

**Product ownership & strategy**

* Own the roadmap for your PI area, prioritizing opportunities based on customer impact, commercial value, and delivery effort.
* Make clear product decisions and trade-offs, and partner with the PI leadership team and other Senior PM to sequence the wider portfolio.
* Represent your product area with executives, customers, Sales, and cross-functional teams.

**Prototyping & AI**

* Produce your own wireframes and flows during discovery. You don't need to be a designer, but you do need to be self-sufficient. If you do have design experience, that’s a plus.
* Create your own wireframes and user flows during discovery and use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, to rapidly build working prototypes for customer validation.
* Treat prototypes as the primary product artifact, keeping documentation focused on intent, behavior, and key requirements rather than exhaustive PRDs.

**Delivery & iteration**

* Work closely with our Australia-based engineering team, giving them context, priorities, and fast answers. Engineering's role on this team leans toward reviewing, correcting, and hardening what comes out of AI-assisted development, so your prototypes and decisions feed directly into what ships.

jobs.title: OG.com - Senior Product Manager - Predictions
jobs.desc:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the consumer prediction-market trading experience end-to-end - web and mobile - once someone can fund: discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / live, and the fan UX that makes OG the default place to trade on real-world outcomes.

Your mandate is to make OG fast, clear, and design-obsessive for sports and prediction users: the core trading surfaces that keep them coming back, the workflows that feel native to fans (and to retail traders), and the translation of that craft into regulated U.S. event contracts. Fiat, KYC, and payment rails sit with a partner PM. You own what they do after they’re funded.

You will run this roadmap with independence. You make the call on UX tradeoffs, what ships when design quality isn’t there yet, and which trading patterns we borrow from sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail perps -and which we refuse. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.

  

**You can come from one of three product worlds:**

* Native consumer predictions - sports fluency, parlays / live, fan UX - and you can bridge that into regulated event contracts.
* Prediction / event markets -you’ve already shipped this category.
* Retail perps / derivatives / advanced trading -you know trader-grade workflows and can make them accessible for fans, not only power users.
* If you’ve shipped any of those, this will feel familiar. The difference is you’ll be doing it in regulated U.S. prediction markets -where sports energy, consumer accessibility, and compliance collide, and the playbook for “best consumer trading experience in the category” is yours to write.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the consumer trading roadmap. You are the DRI for web and mobile trading on OG -from first funded session through confident, repeat use. You set milestones, sequence work, and resolve cross-team dependencies. Nothing in this charter goes live without your sign-off on product and UX bar.
* Ship the product fans actually use. You prioritize market discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / multi-leg, live, and the workflows that keep sports and prediction users engaged. You kill “nice ideas” that don’t move outcomes.
* Bridge native prediction (or perps) into regulated event contracts. You take patterns fans already know -sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail advanced trading -and make them work under U.S. event-contract rules. You don’t copy a sportsbook blindly. You decide what translates.
* Hold the design bar. You champion usability and aesthetics as non-negotiable. You live in design reviews and give specific, actionable UX feedback -spacing, interaction patterns, information density, not vibes. Fan UX is a product skill, not a polish pass.
* Wireframe and partner in Figma. You create your own wires and drive design conversations. You catch pixel misalignments and clunky trade flows before users do.
* Talk to users like a peer. You run research, interviews, and community feedback. You ask “Show me how you currently place this parlay / live bet / perp,” not “Would you use this feature?” You distinguish what users say from what their behavior reveals.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Senior Product Manager

About NavLogic AI

NavLogic AI is building an AI-native operating platform for freight forwarders and NVOCCs. Our platform helps automate complex workflows across emails, documents, data entry, shipment follow-up, exception handling, customer communication, and billing.

Our initial focus is U.S. ocean import operations, with plans to expand into ocean export, air freight, trucking, warehousing, and other logistics workflows.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to turn complex freight-forwarding operations into reliable AI products.

You will work closely with freight operators, customers, design, engineering, and AI teams to identify high-value operational problems and take products from discovery through production launch and adoption.

Key Responsibilities

* Study and redesign end-to-end freight workflows, including ocean import, shipment creation, availability and LFD, customs and release status, pickup and delivery coordination, exceptions, customer updates, and billing handoffs.
* Define product strategy, priorities, MVPs, and roadmaps based on customer value, operational needs, automation feasibility, and business impact.
* Translate real-world business processes into AI and workflow automation products.
* Work closely with design, engineering, AI, data, and operations teams from product discovery through launch.
* Define product metrics and evaluate automation accuracy, adoption, productivity, and customer ROI.
* Interview customers and freight operators, manage product feedback, and turn customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

* 6+ years of B2B, enterprise software, or complex workflow product management experience. Exceptional candidates with 5+ years and strong results will also be considered.
* Proven experience owning a product or major product area from discovery through production launch and adoption.
* Experience in either logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, TMS/FMS, or enterprise AI/workflow products.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM, AI agent, document intelligence, or intelligent workflow product into production.
* Strong product skills including problem framing, workflow design, PRDs, prototypes, prioritization, and release management.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an early-stage startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Knowledge of U.S. ocean import, NVOCC, customs, trucking, warehousing, or freight exception management.
* Experience with FMS, APIs, EDI, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Startup or 0-to-1 product experience.
* Familiarity with AI workflow tools such as Dify, LangGraph, CrewAI, or n8n.

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
* Opportunity to shape the product and roadmap as an early product leader.
* Direct exposure to real freight operations and customers.
* AI-native working environment with modern AI tools.
* Opportunity to work with teams and customers across the U.S. and China.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Who We Are**

At Synapse Health, we're streamlining the durable medical equipment (DME) process. We manage intake, documentation, routing, claims, billing, and patient support. Our model reshapes how DME is delivered and experienced.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. By taking on operational and financial complexity, we're redefining how DME works for providers, prescribers, and patients. We are proud to offer ***work that matters, on a mission that*** ***matter******s*****.**

*Learn**more at*SynapseHealth.com*and on*Synapse Health's LinkedIn*.*

**What We Need**

We're seeking a **Senior Product Manager, RCM Strategy** to own and advance the future-state product strategy for Revenue Cycle Management across the order lifecycle. As Synapse continues to scale, RCM represents a complex and financially critical area of the business. This role will provide dedicated Product leadership to understand current-state challenges, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and design scalable solutions that support continued growth, improve operational performance, and reduce financial and administrative friction.

This role combines strategic discovery and product execution. You will develop product points of view and translate complex financial, operational, and user needs into a clear product strategy and roadmap. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, RCM Operations, Finance, and leadership to shape the roadmap, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive products from problem identification through delivery and iteration.

**Business & Financial Impact**

* Evaluate opportunities based on measurable business outcomes, including scalability, efficiency, quality, revenue cycle performance, and cost to serve.
* Translate complex financial, operational, and business problems into clear product strategies, requirements, and scalable solutions.
* Use data, user insights, and business context to build compelling product recommendations and support investment decisions.

**Product Roadmap & Execution**

* Define and evolve the RCM product roadmap, prioritizing capabilities and solutions based on business impact, scalability, user needs, technical considerations, and the future-state product strategy.
* Lead product execution from discovery and requirements through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Manage the product backlog, lead grooming sessions, and drive sprint planning and execution with a dedicated engineering team

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Infobase exists to power informed decisions. For decades, schools, libraries, and institutions have turned to our resources to build information literacy and help learners develop the skills they need to succeed long after the classroom. We build the platforms and content that make that possible, and right now we're growing the team behind them.

### **Job Summary**

The Senior Product Manager brings rigorous product management practice to bear on Infobase’s most ambiguous and complex product problems, working on a flexible, problem-driven basis rather than owning a single product area on an ongoing basis. The role partners closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy for their franchises — and with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition of new products and major product revisions on Infobase’s platform.

This is a senior individual-contributor role: for each assigned problem, the Senior Product Manager sets direction, builds the evidence base and business case behind major investments, and leads cross-functional alignment — including with Franchise Owners, the Senior Director, Platform Strategy, and Technology stakeholders — to move initiatives from strategy through adoption. Success depends on building alignment and driving outcomes through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. This role will create presentations for executive leadership and should be comfortable interfacing with all levels of the organization.

### **Scope & Assignment**

Assignments are based on the ambiguity and complexity of the business problem to solve — for example, defining a franchise’s multi-year evolution or transforming a franchise’s business model to withstand market shifts — rather than a fixed product line or market area. The Senior Product Manager moves successively between Infobase’s highest-priority strategic problems as they are identified, in partnership with the Chief Product Officer (CPO).

Franchise Owners hold steady-state, franchise-scope titles and retain ownership of content strategy and identity within their franchise on an ongoing basis. The Senior Product Manager and Franchise Owners work in close partnership on assigned problems, each bringing distinct expertise — product management discipline and rigor on one side, content and franchise knowledge on the other. While both positions interface with customers and solicit their feedback, voice-of-customer research represents a larger proportion of the Senior Product Manager’s time.

### **Essential Functions**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Define product vision and strategy for each assigned problem, in partnership with the relevant Franchise Owner(s) and CPO, grounded in customer-centric design, market analysis, competitive dynamics, revenue analysis, and customer research.
* Own and prioritize the roadmap for each assigned problem, making the tradeoffs needed to balance customer value, business priorities, and delivery capacity.
* Build the business case for significant product investments, including tradeoffs and expected impact, and present recommendations to product and executive leadership.

**Voice of Customer & Market Insight**

* Lead voice-of-customer practices for each assigned problem — direct research, usage data analysis, customer feedback loops, and piloting — to keep decisions grounded in evidence. Distinguish between buyers (librarians) and users (educators and students) in creating winning products that increase classroom presence.
* Track competitive and market developments relevant to each assigned problem and translate them into roadmap implications.

**Cross-Functional Leadership: Franchise Owners, Platform, & Technology**

* Partner closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy and franchise identity — to align future product direction with content strategy on each assigned problem.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition and requirements of new product

Are you a passionate product leader who wants to make a real impact on people's health? Lark Health is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the future of our core member app and AI coaching.

At Lark, we are leading the way into a new era of cardiometabolic care, leveraging advanced AI to provide scalable, compassionate care. Our platform helps manage millions of lives for our health plan partners, empowering users to prevent and manage conditions like diabetes, hypertension, and obesity. If you're excited to work at the intersection of healthcare, AI, and human-centered design, we'd love to meet you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

You'll lead the product work behind Lark's core mobile app experience. You'll work with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data scientists to deliver features that improve the lives of our members. You will:

* **Lead the development of** our core app and AI coaching, guiding the entire development cycle from concept to launch.
* **Use a hypothesis-driven approach** to define and refine key features, leveraging market analysis, user testing, and data to create products that deliver real value.
* **Own a portion of the product roadmap**, translating user insights and business goals into clearly shaped initiatives, user stories, product requirements, and launch plans.
* **Run a sharp measurement practice**: clean experiments, the right metrics, and real evidence behind key decisions.
* **Define and track success** by setting and monitoring key results, and communicating those results to stakeholders and leadership.
* **Partner tightly with the Enrollment and EHR teams** on shared work and shared goals, keeping everyone aligned around member outcomes.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

You bring a builder's mindset. You've taken major features from zero to one, you're comfortable in ambiguity, and sharp with data.

* A track record of shipping consumer mobile products and features that people love. You've built under real constraints and learned from real users.
* Real product judgment. You can feel the craft in what you've built.
* Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features, with a feel for what makes AI hard: accuracy, member trust, and designing for outputs you can't fully predict.
* Strong analytics and experimentation instincts. You're fluent in tools like Braintrust, Mixpanel, Looker, or Snowflake, and you know quality takes more than a standard A/B test.
* Familiarity with modern lean product development methodologies within a distributed team environment.
* A feel for behavior change and for the line between coaching and clinical care, so you design responsibly in a regulated space.

* Experience with the Medicare or older-adult population, or in B2C health, wellness, or fitness.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices and the healthcare-specific questions that come with them.

**About Lively**

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

#### **THE ROLE**

Lively is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how data moves between our platform and the systems our customers and partners rely on — payroll and HR platforms, benefits administration systems, carriers, and third-party administrators. You will own enrollment and eligibility data, file-based and API-based exchange, and the integration roadmap that connects Lively to its ecosystem.

You will also own the AI agent experiences that sit on top of that data layer, with a focus on onboarding and validation: agents that help customers and partners get their data into Lively correctly the first time, interpret what arrives, surface problems in plain language, and propose corrections. Integration work at Lively is increasingly AI-assisted, and this role decides where that assistance belongs and where human review stays mandatory.

Alongside this, you will shape Lively's forward data integration strategy: how our connectivity model evolves as the ecosystem moves toward real-time exchange, where we invest in building versus partnering, and how we make each additional integration cheaper and faster than the last.

This is a technically grounded product role. You will work closely with engineering on system behavior, data design, and agent behavior, and you will be the person partners and internal teams come to when they need to understand how the data actually flows. You will own large initiatives end-to-end and operate as the primary subject matter expert for your areas.

**Please note:** As a majority of our engineering team sits in Pacific time, candidate preference will be given to those in the **Pacific** and **Mountain** timezones.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Responsibilities are listed in order of anticipated time investment:

* Integration Ownership — Own the data exchanged between Lively and its partners: what moves, in what form, on what cadence, and what happens when something goes wrong. Define the contracts that both sides build against.
* AI-Assisted Data Onboarding & Validation — Own the AI agent experiences that accelerate getting partner and customer data into Lively: interpreting unfamiliar file structures, mapping fields, catching errors before they propagate, explaining what went wrong in language a non-technical administrator can act on, and recommending fixes. Define where the agent acts, where it advises, and where a human must approve.
* Enrollment & Eligibility Data — Own the enrollment data lifecycle end to end, including how changes, corrections, and exceptions are handled, and how Lively proves its records match the partner's.

Define how failures are detected, communicated, and resolved. Plan capacity for the benefits industry's seasonal enrollment peaks and for growth in partner and record volume.
