At BOLD, our mission is to transform the lives of job seekers globally through trusted brands like Monster, MyPerfectResume, and FlexJobs. As a Senior Product Manager on our Jobs pillar, you will drive this mission forward by owning **ExpertApply**—our AI-powered job search automation product.

You will own the end-to-end product strategy, driving day-to-day improvements, rigorous experimentation, and revenue-driving growth initiatives. If you are passionate about leveraging AI to build best-in-class consumer tools and thrive in an autonomous, data-driven environment, this is the role for you.

### **About This Team**

The Jobs team builds products to help job seekers find their perfect job, especially when it comes to remote work, WFH and flexible jobs. Our mission is to provide best-in-class tools that drive the best outcomes for our customers and long-term value for our brand. This role is specifically for our ExpertApply product. ExpertApply is our AI-powered job search automation product which applies to relevant job openings based on a candidate's profile.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategic Ownership:** Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap for ExpertApply, partnering with leadership, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to achieve core business goals.
* **Mobile-First Growth:** Champion a mobile-first strategy to optimize the application funnel, drive adoption and retention, and ultimately spearhead the launch of our dedicated mobile app.
* **Growth Loops & Experimentation:** Design, run, and interpret rigorous A/B tests across the product and marketing channels—including collaborating with Email Marketing to leverage job alerts for user retention.
* **Customer-Centric Innovation:** Continuously push the product forward by synthesizing market trends, competitive analysis, quantitative metrics, and qualitative user research into actionable features.

### **What You'll Need**

* **Experience:** 6-10 years of consumer-facing Product Management experience.
* **Execution & Prioritization:** Exceptional attention to detail with the proven ability to seamlessly manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Deep expertise in A/B test design, quantitative metric analysis, and translating complex data sets into clear, actionable business strategies.
* **Technical Fluency:** A solid understanding of modern technology stacks, allowing you to accurately gauge the level of effort and partner effectively with engineering teams.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** A history of cross-functional team building, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a globally distributed, remote work environment.

### **What's Good to Have**

* Experience in B2C subscriptions, Job Boards, or AI-driven products.

**Benefits**

**Outstanding Compensation**

* Competitive salary
* Bi-annual bonus
* 401(k) plan with match
* Equity in company
* Flexible spending accounts (health, dependent care)
* Internet and home office reimbursement

**100% Full Health Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision (optional plans for your family)
* Life & long-term disability insurance (optional)
* Mental health support and resources
* Wellness reimbursement (gym, health apps, etc.)
* Pet Insurance (optional)

**Flexible Time Away**

* Flexible PTO
* Sick time policy
* Observed holidays

**Eligibility**

**Eligible Hiring Locations**

This position is 100% remote, work from home.

BOLD can hire full-time residents of the following U.S. States & Territories: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington D.C.), Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.  

**Job Description**
===================

The Staff Product Manager at FuzeRx is a senior individual contributor role responsible for defining, shaping, and delivering high-impact product initiatives that advance patient care, pharmacy operations, and strategic growth. Staff Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.desc:
About Stepful :

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.

  • Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.

  • Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.

  • Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.

  • Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Shopping Experience
jobs.desc:
**The Role:**

As a digitally native company, Minted's Shopping Experience and commerce platform are core to the company's success. Minted's online shopping experience allows consumers to discover, customize, and purchase from an extensive assortment of products and categories, all designed by independent artists around the world. We are driven by creating a customer journey that serves both our artist community and the savvy e-commerce shopper.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to own the strategy for how customers find and choose products on Minted. Over the next two years, we are integrating a new product information management platform, which will give us structured, machine-readable data about our product catalog. That data supports a set of experiences we cannot build today: search and browse that understand what a customer is looking for, product detail and category pages generated from product attributes, and filtered navigation that is fully crawlable. Combined with parallel investments in analytics, customer data, and content management, it is the foundation for conversational shopping and for deep personalization later. This role decides what we build on that foundation, in what order, and why.

The role spans our discovery surfaces (search, browse, category, and product detail) and our conversion optimization program, with dependencies running into product data, customization and rendering, checkout, and marketing. You will set the strategy and objectives for your pod, lead initiatives that cross pod and functional boundaries, and raise the standard of product craft for the PMs around you.

### **You will:**

* Set the strategy for Minted's discovery experience in partnership with engineering and design: where to play and how to win across search, browse, category, and product detail. Derive it from business strategy, the competitive environment, behavioral data, test results, customer insight, and technical constraints and capabilities.
* Prioritize the growth levers that move our targets, then prioritize the customer problems that move those levers, then consider the solution space. Up-level the organization by holding that sequence when others want to start with solutions.
* Set the objectives, key results, roadmap, and initiative scope consistent with that strategy, along with the sequencing and the resourcing implications. Carry a two-year planning view alongside the near-term roadmap.
* Own and continuously maintain the prioritized list of customer problems across your surfaces, keeping it current with fresh behavioral data, user research, customer support and concierge signals, session replay, dogfooding, and competitive scans.
* Define the strategy for turning our new product data foundation into customer value, and lead its execution: attribute-driven search and browse, dynamic product detail and category pages, crawlable filtered navigation, and the groundwork for conversational shopping and deeply personalized discovery.
* Develop and lead initiative strategies that span multiple teams and functions, and resolve the dependencies and disagreements those initiatives create with other teams and with stakeholders.
* Shape solutions with engineering and design. You hold the business problem and the value case, design holds the experience, engineering holds feasibility and cost. Your job is to find the right-sized solution where the three meet.
* Argue for defensibility in addition to value. Ask whether a bet is hard for a competitor to copy and whether it improves margin, and be willing to kill an idea that does not clear the bar.
* Set a new standard for rationale and foresight with the briefs and documentation you produce, stating the assumptions, the growth lever, the customer problem, the success criteria, and the instrumentation plan explicitly.

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that's gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested **over $2 billion** in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than **100 countries** and **over 5 million** borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva's team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

At Orion180, we don’t just stand out for what we do; we shine because of how we do it. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional insurance experience through innovative technology, unparalleled customer service, and a comprehensive suite of products. Our vision is to be the premier global provider of insurance solutions and redefine the insurance industry.

Orion180 is proud to call three vibrant cities home. Our headquarters on Florida’s stunning Space Coast in Melbourne offers an exceptional quality of life, with affordable housing, excellent transportation, and close proximity to major cities like Orlando, Tampa, and Miami. Our Irving, Texas, office places us in a dynamic center of culture, business, and entertainment, keeping us closely connected to innovation and growth. Our Draper, Utah, location, nestled in the heart of the Salt Lake Valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

Join Our Team as a ***Senior Product Manager***

If you’re a product leader who is tired of slow decision-making, fragmented ownership, and ideas that never get implemented—this is your opportunity to do it differently.

At Orion180, Senior Product Managers don’t just manage and maintain insurance products. You own a portfolio, shape strategy, and directly influence growth and profitability in some of our most critical states. This is a role where your decisions matter—and where you will see the impact of those decisions quickly.

***Ideally this role will be located in Melbourne, FL, but we will consider hybrid/remote candidates***

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

As a Senior Product Manager at Orion180, you will operate with General Manager-level accountability, with full ownership of pricing, product strategy, and portfolio performance across your assigned states. You will be trusted to lead end-to-end, make decisions based on data, and drive outcomes that directly impact growth and profitability. You will:

* Own the full rate and product lifecycle across assigned states—from strategy through regulatory approval, if needed, to market impact
* Lead pricing strategy aligned with profitability goals, competitive positioning, and long-term enterprise growth
* Serve as a subject matter expert for your portfolio, influencing enterprise decisions and acting as a trusted voice with leadership

* Use data to win — leveraging internal analytics, competitive insights, and emerging trends to stay ahead of the market
* Build and execute a product roadmap that balances speed, rigor, and business impact
* Partner deeply across the organization (actuarial, underwriting, claims, data science, technology) to deliver scalable, integrated solutions
* Identify and unlock strategic opportunities across automation, data optimization, customer insights, and distribution expansion
* Mentor and elevate the team, helping develop the next generation of product leaders
* Continuously improve portfolio performance, driving measurable results in growth, loss ratio, and operational efficiency

This role will own one of our most important and visible states, making it a key driver of company performance and strategy.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

We’re looking for someone who wants more than execution — someone who wants ownership, influence, and impact.

* 8–12+ years of P&C insurance experience in product management, pricing, actuarial, or similar roles
* Deep understanding of ratemaking, regulatory environments, and product lifecycle management
* Proven ability to lead complex initiatives end-to-end in a fast-moving environment
* Strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate data into actionable decis

**About Pearl**

Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life.

Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes.

We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market.

As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit pearlscore.com.

**About the role**

**Pearl PRO** is the professional side of Pearl's platform: the web and mobile app that real estate agents use to bring Pearl Score into their listings, client conversations, and daily workflow. As Pearl expands its footprint with agents and brokerages, Pearl PRO is a critical growth engine and one of the company's most active areas of product investment.

The **Senior Product Manager for Pearl PRO** will own the product end to end - strategy, roadmap, discovery, and delivery - for Pearl's real estate professional-facing app across web and mobile. Reporting to the SVP Product, this is a **full-stack product ownership** role: you are the **single accountable owner** for Pearl PRO's outcomes, not one contributor among several on a shared roadmap.

We're looking for someone who is genuinely energized by building consumer-grade digital products - clean, intuitive, fast experiences - and who wants to apply that bar to a professional, workflow-heavy user base. Real estate agents are busy, mobile-first, and unforgiving of friction; they'll only adopt a tool that fits how they already work and clearly makes them more effective with clients. This role requires a **sharp sense for professional user needs** alongside the product craft usually reserved for consumer apps.

You'll work closely with a dedicated designer and engineering lead/squad on Pearl PRO, plus Data Science & Standards (to translate Pearl Score and scoring concepts into clear, trustworthy agent-facing experiences) and Business Development/Customer Success (to keep the roadmap grounded in what's winning and losing deals with brokerages and agents).

**What you'll do**

Product strategy & ownership

* Own the Pearl PRO product strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the SVP Product.

* Write clear specs and requirements that let design and engineering move fast without re-litigating scope.

**At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences - everywhere their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter.**
  
  
Now we're looking for a **Group Product Manager, Industry Solutions** to be our platform expert in front of customers and our voice for B2B Manufacturing back into Product. This is a hybrid role - part Sales Engineering, part Product Management, part Solution Architect - for someone who loves being close to customers and close to product decisions at the same time. You'll represent Inriver in customer conversations such as RFPs, check-ins and events, and you'll represent our Ideal Customer Profile, B2B Manufacturing, inside Inriver. You'll bring back what you hear, and you'll influence roadmaps across teams to act on it. In some cases that means shaping what dev teams build next. In others, it means building the answer yourself, configuring templates and solutions using the Inriver platform's own extensibility (including MCPs) to show what's possible, no dev resources required. This role reports to the SVP of Product Management.

### **Why you'll love this role**

* Be the platform expert in the room: Demoing Inriver, answering the hard questions, and representing product in RFPs, customer check-ins, and events
* Become our resident expert on B2B Manufacturing, our Ideal Customer Profile, and bring that signal directly into product decisions
* Work hands-on with the platform's extensibility features and prototyping tools to create solutions yourself, not just spec them for someone else
* Sit at the intersection of Sales, Partners, and Product, with real influence over what gets built.
* Join a company with strong product ambitions and a friendly, down-to-earth culture.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Represent the Inriver platform in customer-facing settings - RFP processes, existing customer check-ins, events, and partner conversations
* Deliver product demos that speak credibly to both business and technical stakeholders
* Gather structured feedback from customers and partners, and translate it into clear input for Product Management
* Build deep expertise in B2B Manufacturing as our ICP; their workflows, data challenges, and buying criteria
* Influence roadmap priorities across product teams by bringing evidence, not just requests
* Identify where customer needs can be met through configuration and templates rather than new development, and prototype those solutions yourself
* Partner closely with Sales, Partner teams, Marketing, and Customer Success to keep the product story sharp and consistent

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

️ 5-10 years of experience in a hybrid role spanning Sales Engineering, Product Management, or Solution Development, or strong exposure to more than one of these disciplines

️ Experience within B2B Manufacturing

️ Strong communication skills: equally comfortable in an RFP response, a customer workshop, or a roadmap review

* A role with real visibility: to customers, to partners, and to the product roadmap

**Why Work at Mercer Advisors?**

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron's for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients' best interests — always.\*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* *Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron's top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron's to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology* *here**.*

**Job Summary:**

Our ability to attract new clients is at the center of our continued success. As we've continued to grow - the success of our growth efforts relies increasingly on the digital experience, processes, and technologies that we offer to prospects, clients, as well as our own employees.

As the Senior Product Manager you are responsible for managing and executing the digital experiences and technologies that support our growth. You will be a key partner to achieve our growth targets – and will design and own digital experiences, technology, and processes - including integrations with partners. As a key-leader on our cross-functional team, you will be co-accountable for our OKRs.

You will provide organizational vision, leadership and strategy for our processes and products. You will be deeply hands on with the related technology (ensuring exceptional product day-to-day administration, data quality, user support) as well as establishing the long term vision, managing the overall roadmap enhancements, including system architecture, custom development, data integration, and ongoing release management. To be successful in this role, you must both have terrific operational skills and be able to think strategically about how the products can further enhance our business and how to successfully integrate acquired firms. A successful candidate will act like "employee #2" at a fast-moving startup and think like a "Growth CTO" for an established industry leader.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Responsible for activities related to the design and development of our products and applications
* Deeply understand our business and collaborate across the organization to identify and prioritize technology, process and experience initiatives that will drive results
* Provide strategic direction across all functions to support the product environment, and facilitate the cross-functional squad in the execution of these initiatives
* Prepare, manage, and maintain documentation of current business processes, the implementation of internal processes, and measure KPI's.
* Build and continuously refine the product roadmap in close collaboration with business stakeholders.
* Collaboratively define and document functional and technical requirements and specifications, business processes, workflows, and reporting output
* Regularly collaborate and seek input from internal and external users, to identifying gaps and opportunities related to current processes
* Organize technical projects from beginnin

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
jobs.desc:
##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

##### **Who are we looking for?**

**Skills & Abilities**

* You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
* You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.

jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
**You'll own a product domain end to end:** its outcomes, its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. You'll work in a trio with a designer and engineering, from discovery through launch and long-term growth.
  
This is not a backlog-grooming role. You'll be handed a business problem and held accountable for what moved, including what you chose not to build.
  
  
**Where it will sit:**  
**One idea runs through every domain:** operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day. Features earn that trust, and trust shows up as revenue. Your job is to find the changes that strengthen it and prove they did.
  
The domains you own will depend on where the business needs you and where your strengths fit. The outcomes below are illustrative. We'll set specific ones with you in your first weeks.
  
Core Ticketing. The fundamental building blocks operators use to turn their experiences into sellable products: single-use, multi-use and reloadable tickets; recurring products like memberships and donations; auto-renewing passes; timed, multi-date and multi-pack admissions; assigned seating; bundles and cross-sells. It also covers how those products are priced, from discounts and upsells to dynamic, usage-based and channel-specific pricing. For operators, this is how new products come to life, capturing more demand and maximizing the revenue of every sale. You'd answer for how quickly operators can launch new products and how much revenue each sale captures.
  
**Distribution. How operators' products get sold:** white-label ecommerce for each operator, RocketRez point of sale at the front gate, OTAs, and third-party sales partners. The work is building systems that make it as easy as possible for a guest to discover what an operator offers, find the best product for them, and complete the sale as quickly as possible. You'd answer for conversion by channel, attach rate, and throughput on peak days.
  
Ancillary Revenue. Revenue beyond admission, like food and beverage and retail, including the build-vs-partner calls that decide how we enter each line. You'd answer for ancillary revenue per guest, and for deals won because we can serve a broader range of operators.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut, even when the CEO or a major customer is asking for it. Engineering is a shared pool, not a dedicated squad, so make an evidence-backed case for your domain's claim on capacity and show that it paid off.
  

* Know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing, and shape pricing and packaging, not just scope.

Discovery, delivery and measurement• Spend real time with operators, like a zoo on a holiday weekend or a tour operator selling through OTAs. Tell a truly painful workflow from a merely unfamiliar one.
  

* Define success before you build, including instrumentation that doesn't exist yet. Measure behaviour change, not adoption.
* Write requirements engineering can estimate against, in plain language.
* Be willing to conclude that a thesis is wrong, and say so plainly.

As a Senior PM, you'll• Raise the decision quality of other PMs through review, pairing and mentoring, and contribute to hiring.
  

* Be the escalation point for cross-domain conflict, not the escalator.

**Two ways to be great here:**  
We hire PMs who lean toward one of two archetypes. Tell us which one sounds like you.

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. **About Vehlo:**

We started Vehlo in 2019 with a simple goal: to be the industry’s favorite provider of repair shop technology.

Across every part of the auto repair industry, Vehlo is igniting vehicle service success with software and financial solutions that unlock your potential. Our founder-led products power the entire service lane experience and keep customers coming back with streamlined tools that help you handle communication, workflow automation, touchless payments, valet pickup, and much more. We’re out to simplify the customer journey from start to finish and give power back to the people under the hood, making their jobs easier and your shop more profitable —just ask our over 30,000 customers, who generate more than 60M annual repair orders, and process over $12B in payments volume annually. At Vehlo, our only purpose is your success, and together, we’re reaching your goals faster than ever.

Being a Veep comes with more than a comprehensive benefits package—our biggest benefit is opportunity: Opportunity to make an impact, opportunity for growth, and opportunity for recognition and rewards. This is not a mega-corporation where you wonder what people are doing all day - every Veep is moving the ball forward day in, day out for our customers or for each other.

**About This Role:**

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own our customer-facing data, analytics and insights portfolio end to end. Most of our customers buy more than one Vehlo product and then cobble together other solutions to assemble the 360-degree view of their business that we don't yet give them natively.

Closing that gap is the starting point, but the bigger opportunity is what we build on top of it. We're not looking for someone to ship more dashboards. More value will come from AI-powered insights that tell an operator what's happening in their business and what to do about it, without them having to know what to ask.

At Vehlo, a Principal Product role is senior, highly visible, and hands-on, reporting to the SVP of Product. You won't have direct reports on day one, but that could change as we grow the business. You'll own strategy and set the pace of play while leading through partners in engineering, analytics, customer success and go-to-market. You'll drive the commercial model as well as the product: what it costs us to serve, what belongs in which tier, and what customers pay for.

**What You'll Do:**

* New AI-powered insight products, built zero to one: surfacing what an operator would never have thought to ask, explaining why a number moved, predicting what's coming, and recommending the next action, delivered inside the workflow rather than in a separate analytics destination.
* The premium analytics product line end to end: reporting and dashboard experiences, alerting, natural-language reporting, and meaningful additions to the basic reporting built into individual products.
* The cross-product view: one unified analytics experience spanning a customer's entire Vehlo footprint.
* Data delivery beyond the dashboard: APIs, MCP surfaces, exports, warehouse sharing, BI connectors, and the access model that governs which customer sees which data.
* The semantic layer and the metric definitions inside it, across products that were built separately and don't yet agree with each other.
* Pricing, packaging, and unit economics: cost-to-serve per location, what's free because it drives retention, and what's genuinely a paid tier.
* Aggregate benchmarking and market-intelligence products built from our repair data, along with the data-rights and aggregation model that makes them defensible.
* Data quality and customer trust as measured product outcomes, so we reinforce trust and value in the market.

**In your first 90 days**

* Align the teams on a governance model so everyone knows what every number in our analytics product means and where it comes from.
* Build a cost-to-serve model per location that our finance team accepts.

Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

### **Core Values**

* **Authenticity** — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
* **Curiosity** — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
* **Focus** — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.
* **Humility** — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".
* **Happiness** — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

**The Role**
------------

Digible is hiring a Group Product Manager who is both a hands-on product manager and an experienced people leader. Your primary responsibility is being the product manager for your own pod, and showing business results for that pod's area of responsibility is your top priority. In addition, you directly manage and coach two experienced Product Managers who each run their own pod. You and your two PMs work as a unit to identify overlaps and opportunities across pods, and you resolve them strategically and proactively in your respective product strategies and roadmaps rather than letting them surface as conflicts in delivery.

In your own pod, you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. You'll also work on some customer-facing experiences and run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you.

As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and you'll help shape how product management is practiced at Digible (AI-native, problem-first, customer-obsessed) through your own example and your coaching. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. ### **Position Overview:**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead a sprint-based ecommerce platform team supporting 11 real estate brands across 4 technology stacks. This role is highly execution-oriented and focused on driving measurable improvements to ecommerce performance, website experience, and platform scalability.

You will own sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery for ecommerce initiatives across brands, while serving as the primary ecommerce technology representative on our cross-functional ownership committee. This role requires strong operational leadership, cross-team coordination, and a deep understanding of ecommerce conversion, merchandising, and platform systems.

  

**What You"ll Do**

**Sprint Leadership & Delivery**  

* Lead a dedicated ecommerce sprint team operating in a two-week Agile cadence.
* Own backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and execution.
* Ensure roadmap commitments and business-critical work are delivered on time and at high quality.
* Balance roadmap initiatives, enhancements, and keep-the-business-running work within defined capacity allocations.

**Ecommerce Optimization Across Brands**  

* Drive continuous improvement of ecommerce performance across 11 brands and multiple tech stacks.
* Own initiatives related to:

o Conversion rate optimization (CRO)  
o Merchandising and package presentation  
o Checkout improvements  
o Pricing display and framing  
o Product detail page improvements  
o SEO and generative search readiness  

* Standardize best practices while accounting for brand-specific needs.

**Platform Ownership & Governance**  

* Serve as the primary ecommerce technology representative on the ownership committee.
* Provide visibility into sprint progress, platform risks, and trade-offs.
* Advocate for scalable solutions across multiple technology stacks.
* Help define and enforce standards for ecommerce experience consistency.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**  

* Partner closely with: Engineering pods (multiple stacks), UX and design, Marketing and growth team, and Content and curriculum teams
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements and prioritized execution plans.
* Ensure alignment between ecommerce improvements and broader product strategy.

**Data-Driven Performance Management**  

* Define and track key ecommerce metrics, including:

o Conversion rate  
o Average order value  
o Revenue per visitor  
o Funnel progression  

* Run structured experiments and A/B tests.
* Use insights to continuously refine backlog priorities.

**Multi-Stack Platform Coordination**  

* Navigate and optimize across four technology stacks.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, and long-term rationalization.
* Ensure changes are implemented consistently across brands where appropriate.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in ecommerce or multi-brand digital environments.
* Proven experience running Agile sprint teams.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce platforms, conversion optimization, and digital merchandising.
* Experience managing complex, multi-brand or multi-platform environments.
* Ability to balance hands-on execution with strategic thinking.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions.
* Familiarity with modern product tools (JIRA, analytics platforms, experimentation tools) Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; Master's degree is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

**Angi at a glance:**

* Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
* Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
* Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

**About the Team**
------------------

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product Management**

* Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.
* Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.
* Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.
* Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.
* Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.
* Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.
* Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

**Execution and Individual Contribution**

* Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.
* Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.
* Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.
* Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.
* Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.
* A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

jobs.desc:
#### **Job Description**

We’re hiring a dedicated product manager to own B2C ecommerce, conversion rate optimization and payments. You’ll shape our custom commerce platform and prioritize improvements to the business throughout the transition.

You’ll work directly with our head of tech, engineers, data engineer, finance, marketing and showroom operations.

#### **Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Product roadmap: prioritize customer and business problems across discovery, ring configuration, appointments, cart, checkout and payments
* Customer insight: combine customer conversations, showroom feedback, support issues and behavioral data to identify friction
* CRO: develop hypotheses, select appropriate experiments and make rollout decisions from measured results
* Full-funnel measurement: connect website behavior to online purchases, appointment bookings, attendance and subsequent showroom sales
* Payments experience: improve payment completion, deposits, balance payments, refunds and recovery from failed payments
* Provider evaluation: assess payment and financing options with finance, including cost, approval rates, fraud and operational effort
* Delivery: write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, resolve scope decisions and coordinate business acceptance testing
* Migration readiness: define essential launch capabilities, sequence releases and coordinate staff readiness with operations

#### **Requirements and Experience:**

* B2C product ownership: a record of owning an ecommerce product or a substantial purchase funnel
* CRO results: measurable improvements in conversion or purchase completion, with a clear explanation of how you assessed the result
* Payments experience: direct work with checkout, payment providers, authorization rates, refunds or chargebacks
* Analytical judgment: ability to define reliable metrics, interpret experiments and work with a data engineer to validate measurement
* Commercial understanding: ability to assess conversion gains alongside margin, payment costs, cancellations and support burden
* Technical fluency: comfort discussing APIs, integrations, data dependencies and release tradeoffs with engineers
* Delivery ownership: ability to make prioritization decisions and stay involved through launch, measurement and iteration
* High-consideration retail: jewelry, luxury, configurable products or other purchases involving a longer decision process
* Connected channels: customer journeys spanning ecommerce and physical locations
* Commerce migrations: replacing a live platform while maintaining day-to-day trading

Success in this role means more completed, profitable purchases across online and showroom channels, improved payment completion and a roadmap focused on the highest-value customer problems.

#### **Job Details:**

* Schedule: We work Eastern Time US hours.
* Salary: $145,000-$180,000 based on experience

#### **Benefits:**

* **Equity Compensation.** Every Frank Darling team member receives a stock option package to share in the company's upside.
* **Insurance.** Medical, dental, and vision insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month!
* **401k.** Optional 401k program.
* **Paid Time Off.** Flexible, unlimited paid time off policy enables motivated, goal-oriented team members to recharge
* **Disability and Life Insurance.**
* **Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits.**
* **Employee Discounts.** A generous discount program for you, your friends, and your family to make it easy to wear and gift Frank Darling.

You are responsible for competitive intel and defining metrics to demonstrate the success of the product and strategies. You should be growth focused. jobs.desc:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
-------------------------

We're on a mission to help communities adapt to a changing world. Forerunner builds modern, easy-to-use software for the people who keep communities running. Local governments, federal agencies, and infrastructure operators use Forerunner to run inspections, enforce codes, manage public works, respond to disasters, and meet their regulatory obligations.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead product for the Field Intelligence team.

You’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forerunner helps field teams understand what needs attention, capture trustworthy information, and turn their findings into action. This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

This is a high-ownership role for a hands-on product builder who enjoys getting close to users, making sense of complicated operational environments, and turning that understanding into clear product direction and tangible solutions. Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, while partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure what we build is adopted and creates measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Field Intelligence, from work planning and data capture through review, follow-up, and resolution.
* Spend time with inspectors, field crews, program managers, and operational leaders to understand how work happens in practice.
* Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to improve fieldwork while preserving user control, transparency, and trust.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, define requirements, and ship polished end-to-end experiences across mobile and web.
* Define how we measure success, including adoption, task completion, data quality, time saved, issue-resolution time, and customer outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, pilots, usage data, and structured experimentation.
* Balance immediate customer needs with investments in shared platform capabilities, reliability, and long-term product differentiation.
* Develop thoughtful rollout and change-management plans for workflows used in regulated and operationally critical environments.
* Equip Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing with a clear product narrative, launch materials, demonstrations, and the context needed to support adoption.
* Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and learnings clearly across the company.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Foodsmart is uniquely positioned to serve these client and member needs and we are aggressively building our product and service portfolio.

As the product lead for Food Access & Benefits platform, you'll be responsible for the systems and capabilities that underpin how members access food benefits, how employers and health plans administer those benefits, and how Foodsmart launches and scales new service lines in an environment with multiple stakeholders, regulatory considerations, and operational dependencies. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Procurement
jobs.desc:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

### **Position Overview**

Decision making in contract technology is shifting. Procurement, CFOs, and CIOs are gaining influence alongside Legal, and they expect contracting outcomes they can measure that are directly connected to company level business strategy. Agiloft has built deep strength with legal personas that will be extended into procurement through additional investments in our products.

As Senior Product Manager for Procurement, you will accelerate the development of procurement-focused contracting motions on our platform. You will identify the highest value procurement scenarios, prioritize for emerging customer demand, and turn them into a roadmap Product builds against.

This is a high-agency, high-accountability product and business building role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer. You will create and prove value for procurement customers in close partnership with the teams building our core platform and our connected, third-party experiences and generate the evidence that shapes further investment in this motion.

### **Job Responsibilities**

**Lead Product Strategy**

* Define and prioritize the procurement use cases with the clearest path to customer value building upon Agiloft's advanced and growing contracting platform.

**About Foodsmart**:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, this Senior Product Manager will be responsible for driving Foodsmart’s member activation. Every outcome we deliver for our members and clients starts with that first visit. You will own the funnel from first outreach to first visit, including the messaging, the channels, and the incentive structure that motivate members to show up.

Your customers are our members and our clients, who depend on us to turn eligible lives into engaged ones. You’ll lead a cross-functional pod to build out the systems and capabilities to achieve this goal and will work closely with Marketing, Data, and Partnerships to find what moves members from “eligible” to “booked” to “showed up,” and to do it at a cost that scales. This role is ideal for a product manager who is as comfortable in a funnel dashboard and an experiment readout as they are in the details of a text-message delivery issue or a broken scheduling flow.

### **You will:**

*Lead the Activation Pod & Funnel*

* Lead a cross-functional pod of Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing partners with a clear mandate: increase the share of marketable members who complete a first visit

* Define and track funnel metrics from outreach to first visit (reach, booking, and show rates) by channel, client, and member segment
* Run a disciplined experimentation program: clear hypotheses, fast readouts, and confident rollouts

*Drive the incentive structure*

* Shape our member incentive strategy end

NPR is scaling and maturing our audience engagement practice into a unified, data-driven, cross-platform growth and engagement engine, and lifecycle management is at the center of that transformation. This role owns the lifecycle activation tools, with a mandate to replace manual, campaign-by-campaign execution with scalable, AI-enabled (where appropriate) processes, and their work focuses on key touchpoints of engagement such as email acquisition, repeat engagement and donation conversion/retention. jobs.desc:
Overview:

GovCIO is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the delivery strategy and continuous improvement of a complex, high-visibility product — or closely related set of products — within the VA Telehealth portfolio. These products are integral to how Veterans and VA clinical staff connect for virtual care, making this a mission-critical role with real impact on daily Veteran health outcomes.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Senior PM serves as the primary product lead across VA stakeholders, clinical end users, and cross-functional delivery teams, including subcontracted development teams, — executing the VA's product vision with seasoned judgment, executive presence, and a record of owning consequential products in regulated or enterprise environments.

Responsibilities:

* Own the delivery strategy for an assigned telehealth product or product set, maintaining the roadmap in alignment with VA product vision, mission priorities and Connected Care program goals
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for product outcomes, including scope, quality, schedule, and stakeholder satisfaction
* Partner with VA stakeholders, clinical subject matter experts, and end users to translate complex operational needs into clear, prioritized product requirements
* Provide oversight and strategic guidance to subcontracted development teams executing Agile/Scrum delivery, ensuring sprint execution, backlog health, and release readiness meet the program's established quality standards and processes
* Advise on Agile best practices and delivery process improvements across teams; identify and address gaps in Scrum execution, team velocity, or delivery predictability
* Manage product planning artifacts — including roadmaps, backlogs, release plans, and integrated schedules — and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and key decisions
* Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers in coordination with the Program Manager
* Coordinate across UX, integration partners, infrastructure, and help desk teams to ensure end-to-end readiness and quality at release
* Support product launches and change management activities in partnership with training and communications teams
* Mentor junior Product Managers and Associate Product Managers on the team

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**
==================================

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, healthcare, or related discipline
* 8+ years of progressive product management experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead PM role with full end-to-end ownership of a complex, enterprise-level product
* Track record of delivering in regulated, high-stakes, or mission-critical environments where product failure has meaningful consequences
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices at the team and program level, with demonstrated ability to evaluate delivery performance, advise on improvements, and hold development teams accountable to commitments
* Experience managing or overseeing subcontracted or vendor development teams
* Proven ability to navigate and influence senior stakeholders, with the confidence to drive alignment across competing priorities and organizational complexity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and the ability to translate between business and technical contexts
* Experience with backlog and delivery management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
* **Clerance Required:** Public Trust clearance eligibility

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
===================================

* Experience supporting VA or federal health IT programs
* Familiarity with VA telehealth workflows, virtual care platforms, or clinical scheduling systems
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), including supporting or leading SAFe adoption or program increment planning
* Background in healthcare IT or patient-facing digital health

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**About the Product team**  
The Product team listens to our customers' needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. The Consumer Payments team powers how customers successfully make payments to Affirm. As a Senior Product Manager, you will create new payment experiences that make repaying easier, improve payment success, and define how payments are processed safely and cost-effectively. * We are looking for a curious, collaborative Senior Product Manager to improve how customers pay with Affirm

* Bonus points for experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce
