jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Attorney Experience
jobs.desc:
**About Rocket Lawyer**

We believe everyone deserves access to affordable and simple legal services. Founded in 2008, Rocket Lawyer is the largest and most widely used online legal service platform in the world. With offices in North America, South America, and Europe, Rocket Lawyer has helped over 30 million people create over 50 million legal documents, and get their legal questions answered.

We are in a unique position to enhance and expand the Rocket Lawyer platform to a scale never seen before in the company's history, to capture audiences worldwide. We are expanding our team to take on this challenge!

**About your role**

Have a passion for helping people through technology - especially AI? Join Rocket Lawyer as we disrupt the legal industry and advance our mission to make the law affordable and simple. You'll work at the forefront of agentic AI product development, building and launching cutting-edge products for attorneys. Sound exciting? We'd love for you to join us!

Your role will be to own the end-to-end delivery of our Legal Platform, the product that enables attorneys in Rocket Lawyer's network to deliver legal services through our on-demand marketplace.

Today, much of the legal work between attorneys and customers happens off platform - phone calls, emails, and file sharing. Your job will be to bring that experience on-platform through streamlined web conferencing, privileged workspaces, and secure collaboration tools for documents and messaging.

Creating a delightful experience for both attorneys and customers is essential. Attorneys already love Rocket Lawyer because it enables them to practice their craft on their own terms - without business development, invoicing, nor collections. Now we're equipping them with cutting edge legal technology and AI powered tools that enable them to do their job more efficiently than ever.

**How you will make a difference day to day**

*Product Strategy and Vision*

  

* Drive Product strategy and execution for our Legal Platform.
* Develop a deep understand of the needs of our network attorneys through quantitative and qualitative research.
* Passionately represent the voice of the customer (attorneys) while building products aligned with our product vision.
* Lead the ideation, development, and launch of products for our customers.

*Data Driven Product Development:*

  

* Define and analyze metrics to measure business impacts
* Prioritize features using data-driven analysis, business insights, and sound judgment.
* Develop and deliver a roadmap for our Legal Platform product capabilities.
* Understand and report on the direct revenue implications of product decisions.

*Design and Engineering Team Collaboration*

  

* Collaborate with a cross-functional team of Design, User Experience, Engineering, QA, and Content to bring product experiments to market.
* Develop a deep understanding of the marketplace and competitive environment.

**What you'll need**

* 8-10 years of software Product Development experience, ideally with B2B or B2C SaaS products.
* At least 4 years in SaaS (Productivity, Project Management, Collaboration, Workflow) specific product management.
* Ability to combine strong product sense with business acumen to deliver positive outcomes for both customers and the business.
* Passionate about our mission.
* Demonstrated ability to think critically and problem-solve.
* Excellent communication skills.
* An ownership mentality.
* Ability to engage in respectful debate and arrive at "win-win" decisions.
* A bias for action.
* Excitement to celebrate and win as a team.
* Self-aware and a growth mindset.

**A bonus if you have**

* Experience building or launching products that leverage agentic AI systems.
* Experience in the legal technology industry.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Comprehensive health plans (including Medical, Dental and Vision insurance for full-time employees)
* Unlimited PTO
* Competitive salary packages
* Life insurance
* Disability benefit

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing (Senior Staff)
jobs.desc:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Platform Vision:** Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.
* **Unified Entitlements:** Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.
* **Pricing & Packaging Delivery:** Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.
* **Metering & Usage Visibility:** Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.
* **Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle:** Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.
* **Enterprise & Marketplace Motions:** Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.
* **Fulfillment Automation:** Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.
* **Outcomes & Measurement:** Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Grantseeker
jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager, Grantseeker**

Fluxx is looking for a strategic, systems-thinking **Senior Product Manager** to own and evolve our Grantseeker platform. This role is a great fit for someone coming from FinTech. If you've built products that move money securely and compliantly, you'll find a natural home here, helping funds reach the organizations doing mission-driven work.

We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, candid, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

**This is a full-time, exempt position open to candidates located along the East Coast, with a preference for candidates based in the New York City area. Candidates outside of New York City must be willing to travel to our Manhattan office for in-person meetings and collaboration as needed.**

**About Fluxx:**  
At Fluxx, our mission is to be the leading collaborative grant management platform in our global communities. We build technology that drives positive impact by helping foundations, government agencies, and nonprofits streamline their grants management process – on both the grantmaking and grantseeking side – helping to accelerate impact across the communities we serve.

Today, Fluxx supports a global community of 500+ customers who collectively manage and distribute more than $39B in grants annually.

**About Fluxx Grantseeker:**

Grantseeker was originally launched by Fluxx in 2017 to help nonprofits manage the grantseeking process—a market traditionally underserved by grants management software. After serving more than 3,000 nonprofits, the platform was strategically divested in 2023, rebuilt as Grantseeker Pro for larger nonprofit and public sector organizations, and re-acquired by Fluxx in November 2025.

Today, Grantseeker helps nonprofits, higher education institutions, and government organizations manage grant portfolios, deadlines, budgets, reporting, documents, and compliance in one platform. Combined with Fluxx Grantmaker, it delivers a complete end-to-end solution for organizations that both award and receive grants.

**The opportunity**

This role owns Grantseeker's product direction at a genuine inflection point - having been re-acquired by Fluxx. Grantseeker has real traction, a durable data asset, and a newly dedicated product and engineering team — and it also has a two-platform architecture to reconcile, a free-to-paid conversion motion to sharpen, and an unrealized strategic advantage in being the only grantseeker platform owned by a major grantmaker platform.

You will be the person who decides what Grantseeker becomes over the next several years. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.

#### **What you'll do:**

**Own the roadmap.** Set and defend a 12–18 month product strategy grounded in customer evidence, funnel data, competitive reality, and commercial goals and keep the org aligned to it.

**Resolve the platform question.** Grantseeker Classic and Pro run in parallel. Own consolidation end to end —feature parity, migration tooling, customer communication, sunset timeline — balancing speed against long-tenured customers' trust.

**Sharpen the product-led motion.** Own activation, conversion, retention, and expansion as product metrics. Find where free accounts stall, build what converts them, and decide what sits above/below the paywall.

**Win competitive migrations.** Own import tooling, data mapping, onboarding, and the first-week experience that determines whether a migrated account survives.

**Connect funders and seekers**. Turn Fluxx's two-sided position into a shipped product — data flow, reduced duplicate entry, shared visibility — partnering with the Grantmaker team on shared data models.

For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Beacon Biosignals is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the roadmap and day-to-day product decisions for our clinician- and site-facing web application, the primary way clinicians, clinical research sites, and trial teams interact with Beacon's machine-learning-enabled brain health platform. This role reports to the Manager, Web Applications.

In this role, you'll work within Beacon's Web Apps team to drive major development milestones for the next generation of Beacon's web applications for clinicians and clinical sites. You'll shape product direction in partnership with the team's manager and turn it into quarterly plans your team can execute against. You'll be a clear, credible voice for the product with external users and internal stakeholders such as Beacon's clinical, scientific, regulatory, and commercial teams.

**Product Management**

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

**In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:**

* **Human Centered**
  + You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
  + You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

* **Business Focused**
  + Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
  + You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

* **Technology Driven**

* **Team Player.** You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About DealerOn**

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape product direction and lead high-impact SaaS initiatives that deliver measurable value for dealerships, their consumers, and our business.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned, technically grounded product manager who balances customer needs, technical feasibility, and business priorities, and who uses AI as a core part of how they work every day. They prototype to validate ideas while collaborating with UX and engineering teams, have sound judgment about where AI belongs in the product, and help peers build the same fluency.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap around company goals and customer needs.
* Use market trends, competitive insights, customer research, and product data to drive feature prioritization.
* Balance short-term delivery with long-term platform scalability and product vision.
* Lead initiatives that improve customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue.

**AI-Assisted Product Development**

* Build and test working prototypes to validate concepts with dealers and internal stakeholders.
* Use AI to accelerate research synthesis, competitive analysis, requirements drafting, and documentation.
* Define, scope, and measure AI-powered product capabilities, including success criteria, evaluation approaches, accuracy and reliability thresholds, and cost.
* Define requirements for how DealerOn products connect with AI through protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol), partnering with Engineering to determine which data and capabilities to expose to end users and agents.
* Assess where AI creates real value for dealers and shoppers, and where it introduces risk, before recommending it for the roadmap.

**Product Delivery**

* Lead collaboration across Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Operations from concept through launch.
* Write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, release planning, and release readiness.
* Engage with engineering team as a technical peer, weighing performance and implementation trade-offs early so they shape the solution.
* Drive launches through validation, stakeholder communication, enablement, and post-release analysis.
* Define success metrics, instrumentation, and KPI tracking with Engineering and Data teams, and monitor adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention to find improvement opportunities.

**Customer Discovery**

* Collaborate with UX team for product discovery through customer interviews, workflow analysis, usability testing, and feedback synthesis.
* Build deep knowledge of dealership operations, automotive retail workflows, digital marketing, and agency workflows.
* Translate qualitative and quantitative research into unmet needs, workflow improvements, and scalable product opportunities.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Earning trust across Product, Engineering, UX, and operational teams.
* Making decisions that reflect strong customer empathy and measurable business impact.
* Shortening the path from idea to validated concept by using AI tools to test with stakeholders early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional exp

The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.
  • End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.
  • Top-of-funnel and conversion: Partner with revenue marketing to define the acquisition channel mix, run campaigns, and drive early-access signups. Connect demand activity to free-to-paid conversion and early commercial signals.
  • Community building: Build Novus' presence where builders already spend time, including developer forums, social channels, influencer relationships, and event-driven activation. Earn trust with audiences that are skeptical of traditional marketing.
  • PLG motion: Partner with product and growth to design self-serve onboarding, activation flows, and freemium-to-paid conversion paths. Use data and feedback to improve how users discover, try, activate, and expand with Novus.
  • Novus and Pendo positioning: Define how Novus and Pendo exist together in the market. Shape the path for customers moving from fast-moving AI-native teams into more complex product organizations.
  • Sales and partner enablement: Build the materials, messaging, and proof points that help sales and partner teams have credible conversations with product engineers. Translate the product for a buyer that is meaningfully different from Pendo's traditional PM audience.
  • Metrics and commercial impact: Work with revenue marketing to define and track the metrics that connect Novus activity to pipeline and early revenue outcomes. Focus on activation, free-to-paid conversion, marketing-sourced ARR, and other signals that show whether the motion is working.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. jobs.desc:
**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

#### **The Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, for a project based assignment, with deep experience in digital strategy, customer journeys, and conversion optimization. This person will define actionable digital acquisition roadmaps, translate business needs into functional requirements, and partner closely with engineering and analytics teams to drive execution.  
The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed working sessions with technical teams. You should be able to analyze funnel performance directly, establish clear priorities, and design operating models that help teams manage competing requests effectively.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage digital acquisition strategies and roadmaps tied to measurable business goals
* Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear functional requirements
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure requirements are understood, accepted, and successfully delivered
* Analyze funnel and customer journey data to identify conversion gaps and growth opportunities
* Work directly with analytics teams to define metrics, evaluate performance, and guide decisions
* Facilitate working sessions with business, product, analytics, and technology stakeholders
* Present recommendations, progress, and strategic priorities to executive leadership
* Design intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and operating models for teams managing a high volume of requests
* Align stakeholders around clear priorities, ownership, and execution plans
* Track roadmap progress and adjust priorities based on data, business needs, and delivery constraints

#### **Requirements:**

* 10+ years of experience across digital strategy, customer journey optimization, product management, or conversion-focused work
* Demonstrated experience building digital acquisition roadmaps and driving them through execution
* Strong experience writing functional requirements that engineering teams can confidently build from
* Ability to work directly with funnel and performance data without relying solely on prepared reports
* Experience designing operating models, intake processes, or prioritization frameworks for high-demand teams
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate strategic recommendations clearly
* Ability to collaborate effectively in detailed working sessions with engineering, analytics, and IT teams
* Strong organizational, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

#### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with membership, subscription, or recurring-enrollment acquisition models
* Experience working within nonprofit, federated, or franchise environments where national and local organizations share a customer journey
* Experience supporting offerings with multiple participation tiers, products, or enrollment paths
* Familiarity with youth or family audiences and the privacy requirements associated with minors

**Employment Type:**

* Contract

* Partner with platform and servicing product teams to align shared capabilities, dependencies, and delivery priorities with HIL business needs.
* Collaborate closely with HIL business leadership to align product investments with commercial priorities, partner needs, and growth opportunities.
* Establish and monitor product success metrics, using data and feedback to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.

* Experience working in B2B2C environments, balancing the needs of business partners, distribution channels, and end consumers.

* Excellent communication and relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business partners, and executive leadership.

**Who We Are**
==============

ServiceMac is a new sub-servicing entity backed by some of the leading practitioners of the mortgage servicing industry. ServiceMac is focused on providing superior technology, products, and services for the mortgage and real estate industries backed by highly personalized service and support. Through continuous innovation and acquisition, our offerings comprise of personalized solutions that span the mortgage continuum and enhance security, compliance, customer satisfaction, and profitability. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all.

**What We Do**
==============

Product Management defines, promotes and communicates the strategic roadmap for current and future products. Partner closely with business and technical teams to gather insights, understand current business process, challenges, and opportunities, in order to envision, design and develop technology products. Identify emerging markets, conduct market research, generate product requirements, determine specifications, create product roadmap, and conduct competitive assessments and product positioning. Act as primary contact and product evangelist to build awareness, understanding, and user acceptance. Works with clients, as needed, to develop and prioritize high level product requirements and ensure satisfaction and goals are met. Works closely with technology and other cross functional teams to determine plans for product implementation, upgrades and deployments. Use their deep knowledge of technology, processes, methodologies and principles to lead their product teams to successful outcomes.

* Drive the vision and delivery of innovative new products to keep the business relevant and competitive
* Develop, define, maintain and communicate the product strategy and roadmap

* Prioritize product opportunities using criteria and requirements defined during research

* Troubleshoots a wide variety of complex problems and identifies solutions within broad applications and functional expertise
* Regularly provides input to define and implement conceptual issues

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Digital Products
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

As a leader in Medicare health insurance distribution, Spring Venture Group guides people through one of their most important life decisions — finding the right insurance coverage. We are on a mission to be the most trusted partner for our customers and our people, enabling empowered decisions along the journey to health and financial well-being.

Spring Venture Group offers incredible culture, benefits, and fantastic income potential in a stable and successful work environment at a Medicare agency. This starts with a workplace that empowers people to do their best work. Come build a rewarding career and make a meaningful impact on peoples’ lives in an environment that values your determination. Join our diverse, inclusive team and get ready to crush your goals!

 **Job Description**

**OVERVIEW**

As a Sr. Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining and championing the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success of SVG’s Digital Products, including B2B and Consumer. You will work closely with all of SVG’s business units and partner with engineering, design, go-to-market, and adjacent product teams to discover and deliver products that are valuable to customers, viable to operate, and feasible to build.

**REPORTS TO**

The Sr. Product Manager reports to the Sr. Manager, Product Management.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

The essential duties for this role include, but are not limited to:

* Understand customer needs and run discovery: Conduct discovery and work with business stakeholders and customers to identify and validate user problems, understand workflows, and prioritize outcomes.
* Manage the product roadmap: Own the product vision, priorities, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for SVG’s consumer facing products.
* Define product requirements: Translate user needs and business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria. Own third-party tools and integrations for assigned products.
* Evaluate go-to-market and delivery: Assess go-to-market approaches to enable strong product adoption.
* AI-fluent product management: Use AI tools and models in day-to-day product work, including research, specifications, prototypes, and delivery.
* Understand the business and regulatory environment: Understand SVG’s business model, processes, and financial metrics, and manage product compliance within the regulatory and data-privacy landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams: Work closely with engineering, design, and other stakeholders to ensure the product is built and launched effectively through Agile development.
* Analyze product performance: Track key product metrics, analyze user behavior, and identify areas for improvement.
* Communicate effectively: Engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship.
* Be a product evangelist: Promote the products internally and externally, and champion the organizations and consumers who use them.
* Foster a culture of innovation: Build a team culture where each member contributes ideas.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**BEHAVIORS**

The SVG behaviors are listed below:

jobs.desc:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a **Principal Product Manager** who will shape and grow Constant Contact's partner ecosystem through product innovation and strategy. This is not a Sales or Business Development role; you'll focus on identifying which partnerships create the greatest opportunities, prioritizing the integrations and experiences we build, and developing a product roadmap that connects our platform to new customers and drives meaningful business growth.

Your focus is **Vertical Partnerships**: tailoring our platform and partner experiences to the needs of specific industries, then repeating that success across several of them. Real Estate is one example. It's a vertical where our value proposition is resonating today, and it shows the kind of work involved: identifying the right partners, shaping an experience that fits the industry's workflows, and landing and expanding quickly. Our priorities will follow where the evidence is strongest, so the specific verticals will change as we learn. What stays constant is the goal of a repeatable model for entering, validating, and scaling vertical partnerships across several markets with strong market size and similar customer needs.

You'll share company goals for user acquisition, revenue, and average selling price (ASP) with Strategic Partnerships (our business development team), and you'll work across the company to deliver them. Expect daily collaboration with Design, Engineering, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Data teams, as well as external partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager**

Location: New York City | In-office

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

**The Opportunity: Turn Clinical Expertise into Product**
=========================================================

As our Senior Product Manager, you’ll bring deep clinical and EHR knowledge into the decisions that shape Taxo. You’ll understand how care teams actually work, identify where automation can help, and turn that insight into products engineers can build and customers can use. This role is for someone who can move comfortably between a clinical workflow, an EHR integration, and a product decision.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Get Close to the Workflow:** Spend time with clinicians, practice teams, and healthcare operators to understand their workflows, bottlenecks, and exceptions.
* **Own Product Decisions:** Own product discovery, roadmap priorities, requirements, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered administrative workflows.
* **Turn Complexity into Clarity:** Translate complex clinical and operational processes into clear product requirements and release plans, with measurable acceptance criteria for engineering and quality teams to validate.
* **Connect the EHR:** Work closely with engineering on EHR integrations, data flows, workflow dependencies, and human handoffs.
* **Measure Real Outcomes:** Define success measures for adoption, task completion, reliability, and time saved, then use evidence to guide iteration.
* **Learn from Deployment:** Turn clinic rollout feedback into reusable product improvements. Partner with the implementation team, which owns customer-specific rollout plans, training, user acceptance testing coordination, and go-live readiness.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **The Healthcare Expert:** Deep, firsthand knowledge of clinical workflows and day-to-day EHR use, demonstrated through healthcare software you have shipped with clinicians and practice teams.
* **The Product Builder:** Experience delivering healthcare software from discovery through adoption, with concrete examples of workflow exceptions you addressed, integration tradeoffs you made, and measurable adoption or operational outcomes.
* **The Translator:** The ability to map complex workflows, identify exceptions, and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues.
* **The Systems Thinker:** Practical understanding of EHR capabilities, integration constraints, data quality, and patient privacy, grounded in product decisions you have made.
* **The Decision Maker:** Strong prioritization and analytical skills, with a track record of using customer feedback and product data to make decisions.
* **The Owner:** Comfort working closely with engineers and taking ownership of the details needed to get a product into use.
* **Bonus:** A clinical, clinical informatics, or healthcare operations background; hands-on EHR implementation or integration experience; familiarity with HL7/FHIR, conversational AI, or workflow automation.

**Why Taxo**
============

Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible.

* **AI with a Clear Purpose:** Focus on where automation can reduce work while preserving reliability and human oversight.

jobs.desc:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**  
  
At Accelerate Learning, we’re dedicated to engaging and inspiring STEM education for PreK-12. Our mission is to spark curiosity in the STEM classroom with programs designed by experienced teachers and STEM experts. Supporting over 9 million students and 750,000 teachers, we constantly adapt to educators’ needs and customer feedback to promote powerful teaching strategies that shape the future of STEM learning.
  
  
“For teachers, by teachers” is not a slogan—it’s a fact. Our award-winning product, STEMscopes, was incubated in the classroom and developed by over 200 teachers, science experts, and science professors.  
  
We’re scaling rapidly and investing in cutting-edge cloud technologies, AI, and modern software practices to bring STEM education into the future. Join us, and your work will directly shape how millions of students learn.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
  
At Accelerate Learning, we’re on a mission to transform STEM education for millions of students and teachers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives on curiosity, customer obsession, and strategic thinking — someone who doesn’t just follow a roadmap but helps shape it.  
  
*Location: Onsite two days a week, if you live within a 45-mile radius of the Houston headquarters. Remote for those outside of the Houston metropolitan area.*  
  
  
**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**  
  
Key responsibilities include:

* Shape and refine the product roadmap in alignment with business goals and educational outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for innovation in areas such as AI, adaptive learning, and scalable SaaS solutions.
* Engage regularly with teachers, administrators, and students to understand their challenges and motivations.
* Translate educator and learner needs into actionable product requirements.
* Define clear requirements, epics, and user stories to guide development teams.
* Prioritize features and manage the product backlog in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and QA to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality solutions.
* Establish success metrics for new and existing features.
* Analyze product performance and usage data to drive iterations.
* Incorporate customer feedback to refine the product experience.
* Partner with Product Leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align on goals and priorities.
* Communicate product vision and progress effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Explore new technologies and approaches (AI, event-driven systems, adaptive learning) to keep products competitive.
* Stay informed on EdTech industry trends, instructional practices, and regulatory requirements.

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally with SaaS, EdTech, or consumer-facing products.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments — writing user stories, managing backlogs, and leading sprint rituals.
* Strong skills in gathering requirements, translating them into epics and stories, and prioritizing work for development teams.
* Data-driven mindset with ability to analyze usage patterns and customer feedback to guide iterations.
* Excellent communicator who can collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for improving education and empathy for teachers and learners.
* Curiosity to explore instructional challenges and design products that enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
* Bonus: A love of STEM.

Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data Cooperative & Activate)
jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager (Data Cooperative & Activate)**

**Company Overview**

InfutorData, an ActiveProspect company, delivers privacy-compliant consumer identity and data solutions that help marketers find, understand, and reach the right people. Our identity graph covers roughly 250 million US consumers and 120 million households. We are now building a transparent, consent-based data cooperative for consumer lead-generation publishers, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead it from concept to launch.

**Job Summary**

As Senior Product Manager, Data Cooperative & Activate, you will own a new publisher data cooperative and the Activate product line it powers. Publishers contribute on-site and form data under clear, documented terms. In return, they receive member services such as industry analytics and benchmarking, data appends, fraud and bot detection, and identity resolution.

This is a 0-to-1 build with a direct line to revenue on an established product line. You will design the member value exchange, sign and onboard publisher members, align other product teams around a shared member offering, and work with Engineering and Data to deliver the collection script, data feeds, and member services. You will work closely with Legal, Privacy, Sales, Finance, and an outside consulting firm, with regular exposure to executive leadership.

The role is an equal blend of partnership and product management. You should be as comfortable negotiating a data-sharing agreement with a publisher as you are writing acceptance criteria with an engineer.

**Responsibilities:**

**Co-op Strategy & Member Value Exchange**
------------------------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the publisher data cooperative.
* Define what members contribute and what they receive, including tiering (for example, Core and Premium) based on publisher discovery.
* Build and test member value propositions; decide which benefits lead and how to prove their value.
* Scope and launch member industry analytics (benchmarking and trend reporting) with the Data team, protecting each member's data in aggregate reporting.
* Model co-op economics and data-licensing value to inform packaging, pricing inputs, and investment decisions.

**Publisher Partnerships**
--------------------------

* Own the publisher pipeline from discovery through signed member agreement and onboarding.
* Lead conversations with publisher members and prospects on value exchange, integration, and data-use terms.
* Facilitate a Publisher Advisory Board to validate the model and gather ongoing feedback.
* Work with Legal and outside advisors to standardize member agreements and data-use terms.
* Select and launch pilot publishers, then scale membership month over month.

**Cross-Product Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Inventory existing products that can be offered to members (for example, API data appends, identity resolution, fraud and bot scoring).
* Partner with other product managers on what is included, at what tier, and on what timeline.
* Define packaging, entitlements, and member-facing positioning for bundled services.
* Identify new data products and member services that can be built on co-op data.

**Activate Product Line**
-------------------------

* Own the Activate roadmap, pricing inputs, and inventory health.
* Plan the transition of current Activate data sources into the co-op model so inventory holds during cutover.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on revenue attribution and commercial performance.

**Execution & Delivery**
------------------------

* Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with Engineering and Data for the collection script, scheduled data feeds, and member services.
* Define POC scope and success criteria with Data and Engineering.
* Work through dependencies across data infrastructure, identity, and integration teams.
* Build privacy into the program by design, including publisher notice

jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.

We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.

We are excited to offer a hybrid working environment for our employees. To be successful in this role, there are some requirements to visit our office locations from quarterly to a few times a quarter for workshops, team meetings and collaboration between teams. There will be opportunity for international travel annually or as needed based on business needs.

 **Job Description**

**Mission**

IntegriChain is on a mission to help all stakeholders in the life sciences industry drive access. We do this through our relentless focus on unifying all of the critical business functions for therapy commercialization and access contracts and pricing, gross-to-net, channel, and patient services unlocking strategic payer, provider, pharmacy and patient access insights for our life sciences customers.

This role is for a **Sr. Product Manager who wants real ownership and real impact**. You will own a critical product area end‑to‑end—**from problem discovery through delivery and adoption**—with clear accountability for outcomes, not just execution. You’ll operate as a decision‑maker at the center of Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and customer‑facing teams, shaping strategy while staying deeply connected to how the product is built and used.

The problems you’ll work on are **complex, operationally critical, and deeply embedded in customer workflows**. Success requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to translate messy, real‑world processes into clear product direction. You’ll be expected to challenge assumptions, prioritize based on evidence, and make hard tradeoffs when constraints collide.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

This is not a role for someone who waits for direction or optimizes for consensus. It *is* a role for a PM who:

* Wants **clear ownership** of a product area
* Is energized by **hard problems with meaningful business impact**
* Can balance **long‑term strategy with hands‑on execution**
* Earns trust by making sound decisions and delivering results

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Skills**

* Own and evolve the multi-quarter product strategy and roadmap (6+ quarters) for assigned product areas, aligned to company objectives and market needs.
* Facilitate prioritization with stakeholders using structured frameworks (e.g., value vs. effort, risk reduction, strategic alignment).
* Lead discovery activities with customers, internal users, and domain experts to validate problems before solutions.
* Translate validated needs into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and business context to explain the business need and value.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and scope changes, and drive resolution.
* Lead release planning and readiness for assigned product

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
Operators ask us questions every day. How did yesterday go? Which channel actually converts? Did the new pricing pay off, or did it just move demand around? Your job is to turn those questions into data, reports, and visuals that answer them clearly and lead to a revenue maximizing decision.
  
**You'll own Reporting & Analytics end to end:** the reports, dashboards, and insights operators use to run their business, from the general manager checking yesterday's attendance to the finance lead reconciling a month of revenue across channels, and the data models and metric definitions behind them. You'll own its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. Your job is to prove that reporting can be the front door to RocketRez: where operators start their day, and what moves them to act. You'll be measured on usage, and on the revenue operators earn from the decisions reporting drives.
  
  
**What we're building:**  
Operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day, and that trust depends on the numbers. If the reporting is wrong, late, or confusing, nothing else we build gets believed.
  
First, reporting operators trust. Core reporting on par with the best in hospitality.
  
Next, a revenue engine. Operators set revenue targets and campaigns, track their pace against them and against past seasons, and get clear options when they fall behind.
  
Then, automated revenue management. Automation keeps tracking and planning running without the operator asking. It recommends actions grounded in the operator's own history and in how similar operators are performing, and makes acting on them a single click. Season pass sales dipping? Here are three options based on this season and the last two.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
Understand the question• Spend real time with operators across roles, from general managers and finance leads to marketers and front-gate supervisors. Learn the decisions they make and the questions they need answered to make them.
  

* Design reporting that leads to a decision. Every report should make clear what it means and what to do next.

Data fluency• Prototype with real data. Write your own SQL to mock up a report or metric and put it in front of operators before engineering builds it.
  

* Own the metric definitions the platform runs on: revenue, attendance, capacity utilization, and conversion mean the same thing in every report, in every domain.
* Apply statistical judgment: seasonality, small samples, cohorts, fair comparisons, and forecasting.
* Choose the right visual for the question, and hold a high bar for clarity, accuracy, and honest scales.
* Treat data quality as product quality.
* Work with other domains so new products capture the data reporting needs before they ship.

**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut.
  

* Shape how automation and AI turn insights into recommended actions: which recommendations are trustworthy, when a human should decide, and the guardrails around both.
* Define how cross-operator benchmarks work: peer sets, minimum sample sizes, and anonymization that operators trust enough to opt into.
* Make the build, buy, and partner calls on analytics tooling, and know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing.

**What we look for:**  
The trait we care about most is adaptability. The tools and methods of product management are changing, so we hire people who have already reinvented how they work on their own initiative and will do it again.
  

* You've rebuilt how you work without being told to, including becoming AI-na

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Developer Platform and APIs
jobs.desc:
Alianza's Intelligent Communications Fabric gives service providers a path to modernize voice networks and deliver AI-infused experiences on top of them. Delivering on that depends on people outside Alianza being able to build against the network: Experience Providers today, and a broader developer audience over time.

This role owns that surface. It covers the APIs Experience Providers integrate with, the platform experience around them, meaning how someone gets access, gets oriented, and gets to a first successful call, and the work of growing a developer audience that does not exist yet.

This is a build-from-scratch mandate. The APIs exist and are already carrying real partner integrations. The platform around them, and the audience for it, are still to be built. The person in this role will bring structure and a well-informed point of view to that space, working in close partnership with engineering, legal, and the commercial team.

Key Responsibilities

Experience Provider APIs

* Own product definition for the APIs Experience Providers integrate with, including integration contracts, onboarding and lifecycle APIs, and new partner-facing APIs as the program expands.
* Turn recurring partner integration needs into reusable platform capability rather than repeated one-off work.
* Partner with engineering on API design, versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility as the surface grows.
* Define how third parties obtain and manage access, including credentialing and the permissions model around programmatic access to network data.
* Extend into adjacent platform APIs where developer-facing needs lead, as the platform and the program mature.

Developer Platform and Experience

* Define the path from first contact to first successful API call, then systematically reduce the friction along it.
* Establish how developers get support, in partnership with customer success and support.
* Build the feedback loop from usage data and direct partner input back into the roadmap.

Developer Audience and Adoption

* Build the audience from a standing start: define who the developers are, what brings them to the platform, and what keeps them building on it.
* Define and track the adoption metrics that matter, such as activation, time to first successful call, and active integrations.
* Work with product marketing and sales engineering on enablement, launch moments, and developer-facing content.
* Represent the platform in external partner and developer conversations.

Cross-Functional

* Partner closely with engineering on technical feasibility and sequencing.
* Coordinate with legal on data privacy, IP, and partner agreements where they touch platform access.
* Work with commercial stakeholders on packaging and pricing of platform capabilities.
* Contribute to and improve the frameworks the broader product team uses for partner and developer enablement.

Qualifications

Required

* 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning API-first, platform, or developer-facing products.
* Demonstrated experience defining and shipping partner- or developer-facing APIs, including the documentation and onboarding experience around them.
* Experience building or materially contributing to a developer portal, API documentation set, sandbox, or self-service onboarding flow.
* Comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and motivated by early-stage platform work rather than optimizing a mature one.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with engineering, legal, and commercial teams.
* Voice or telecom domain expertise is not required. Alianza will support ramp-up on voice architecture (ICF, Core, Fusion, Alianza One) for a strong API-background candidate.

Preferred

* Background in UCaaS, CPaaS, or other large-scale distributed cloud communications platforms.
* Experience with consent, privacy, or authorization and policy enforcement systems.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
### **Who We Are**

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

**Description**

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager**, you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt's Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises.

You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact.

**What You Would Do**

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

* **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics.
* **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
* **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation.
* **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows.
* **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers
* Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to help communicate product value and priorities to internal teams, including sales and marketing
Foster healthy culture, support and collaboration for a distributed team  

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Translate requirements from customers and defining the product functionality according to wider customer needs
* Inform senior stakeholders on progress and raise risks to the appropriate level
* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

**Equal Opportunities**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

### **About the role**

We’re hiring for a **Senior Product Manager** — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

### **What you'll do**

* **Own our end-to-end product development process**, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration
* **Conduct deep user research** with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs
* **Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes** to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on
* **Lead product launches,** partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

* **Own the tools that run our patient journey,** from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

* **Use AI tools** to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

* **Define and monitor success metrics** for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

* **Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders** to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

### **Who you are**

* You are a **senior-level individual contributor (IC)** with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health
* You have a track record of **owning complex, cross-functional products** from problem definition to launch
* You’re comfortable with **ambiguous, early-stage environments**, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools
* You’re both **empathetic and systems-oriented** — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

* You actively **use AI tools to move faster** — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Remote)
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

Product Management defines, promotes and communicates the strategic roadmap for current and future products. Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to gather insights, understand current business process, challenges, and opportunities. Identify potential products and emerging markets; conduct market research; generate product requirements; determine specifications; create product roadmap; conduct competitive assessments and product positioning; and craft marketing strategies/campaigns for new product introduction/launch. Act as primary contact and product evangelist to build awareness, understanding, and user acceptance. Works with customers to develop and prioritize high level product requirements and ensure customer satisfaction and goals are met. Work closely with technology, sales and other cross functional teams to determine plans for product implementation, upgrades and deployments. Participate in creating and driving product positioning and customer messaging.

**HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Drive the vision and delivery of innovative new products to keep the business relevant and competitive
* Develop, define, maintain and communicate the product strategy and roadmap
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements
* Determine and conduct market research to identify user need for new products
* Prioritize product opportunities using criteria and requirements defined during research
* Define high level customer requirements for the entire customer experience including product features and functions, target markets, and pricing
* Understands customer needs, pain points, and opportunities and reflecting by developing impactful positioning and customer messaging. Specifies research needed to obtain market information
* Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and determine necessary enhancements
* Lead and participate in planning meetings and provide advice and guidance on direction of products
* Collaborate with customers, team members, and outside influencers to ensure a solid and well-rounded understanding of products and developing needs
* Execute the product roadmap by providing direction to the product development team for product evolution and priorities, ensuring that the experience gained from external market activities, usage analysis, competitive response, and market research is reflected in future product releases
* Assess market competition by cultivating knowledge of competitor products to identify product gaps, assess and address competitive threats, and gain a competitive edge
* Other duties as assigned

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

At National Vision we believe everyone deserves to see their best to live their best. We help people by making quality eye care and eyewear more affordable and accessible. National Vision is one of the largest optical retail companies in the United States with over 1,200 stores. We operate four retail brands: America’s Best Contacts & Eyeglasses, Eyeglass World, and Vista Optical inside select Fred Meyer stores and on select military bases. We offer an innovative culture where training is a priority, hard work is praised, and career growth is a reality.

We are hiring for a **Senior Digital Product Manager** to join our growing team!

 **Job Description**

The Senior Digital Product Manager is responsible for shaping, delivering, and continuously improving digital products that create meaningful customer experiences and measurable business value. This role owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and performance of digital capabilities across web, mobile, eCommerce, omnichannel, and internal platforms. The ideal candidate combines customer empathy, analytical discipline, technical fluency, and strong cross-functional leadership to turn business goals and user needs into successful digital solutions.  
  
**What Would You Do? The Specifics.**

* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for assigned digital products.
* Translate customer needs, business objectives, market trends, and data insights into prioritized product requirements and user stories.
* Own and manage the product backlog, balancing customer impact, revenue opportunity, operational needs, technical feasibility, and delivery capacity.
* Partner closely with UX, engineering, analytics, marketing, operations, merchandising, customer support, legal, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
* Lead product discovery activities, including customer research, competitive analysis, journey mapping, usability testing, and opportunity sizing.
* Drive agile ceremonies and delivery alignment, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, acceptance criteria, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
* Use data, experimentation, A/B testing, and performance reporting to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continuously improve product performance.
* Coordinate go-to-market planning, launch communications, stakeholder training, and adoption support for new digital capabilities.
* Monitor product health, customer feedback, defects, accessibility considerations, and operational issues; prioritize enhancements and fixes accordingly.
* Communicate roadmap progress, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and results clearly to executive leaders and cross-functional partners.

  
**Qualifications**

**Work Experience**

* 6+ years in product management, digital product ownership, eCommerce, technology delivery, UX, business analysis, or a related discipline ((Required))
* Demonstrated experience managing digital products through the full lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch, optimization, and ongoing support. ((Required))
* Experience using analytics tools and product performance data to inform prioritization and decision-making. ((Required))
* Experience with eCommerce, omnichannel retail, customer account platforms, scheduling, checkout, payments, personalization, search, or digital marketing capabilities. ((Preferred))
* Experience with conversion rate optimization, funnel analysis, customer journey analytics, SEO, accessibility, privacy, or experimentation programs. ((Preferred))

**Education**

* Four year college degree or equivalent experience. in product management, digital product ownership, eCommerce, technology delivery, UX, business analysis, or a related discipline (Required)

**Licenses, Certifications, Professional Affiliations**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner, Product Management certification, Agile certification Upon Hire ((Preferred))

What makes us different? At Frontline Insurance, our core values – **Integrity, Patriotism, Family, and Creativity** – are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to making a difference and achieving remarkable things together. If you’re looking for a role, as a Product Owner III where you can make a meaningful impact and grow your career, your next adventure starts here!

* **Hybrid work schedule!**
* **Health & Wellness:** Company-sponsored Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance (Short-Term and Long-Term).
* **Financial Security:** 401k Retirement Plan with a generous match.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Four weeks of PTO and Pet Insurance for your furry family members.

**What you can expect as a** **Product Owner III****:**

**Strategic Product Leadership**

* Partner with senior leadership to define product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap.
* Own and manage large, complex products or multiple feature areas with high business impact.
* Translate organizational strategy into actionable product goals and measurable outcomes.
* Serve as a subject matter expert, influencing key decisions that shape product direction.

**Advanced Backlog & Delivery Management**

* Lead and oversee product backlogs across multiple Agile teams or product lines.

* 6–8 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent role in Agile product delivery.
* Demonstrated success managing large-scale, cross-functional, or enterprise-level products.
* Strong track record of delivering complex projects that achieve business results.
* Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, frameworks, and tools (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, Jira, ADO, Confluence).
* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and analytical skills.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication abilities at all organizational levels.
* Proven leadership and mentorship capabilities.
* Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term execution.
