jobs.desc:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, helping brands, CPGs, and retailer partners reach shoppers with relevant, effective advertising across the Instacart platform. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll own the Formats domain, where we place 0 1 bets that fuel double-digit growth for Ads and keep CPGs and new advertiser types engaged.

You'll sit at the intersection of CPGs, retailers, and customers, shaping new ad experiences across multiple user-facing surfaces. Your portfolio spans new advertiser, formats innovation, and in-store experiences. You'll partner closely with XFN stakeholders, our Online Grocery team, and external technology partners. If you're energized by taking ambiguous ideas from zero to one, fluent in ad formats and user experience, and comfortable managing partners and vendors, this is the role for you.

  

**About the Job**
-----------------

* Serve as the primary product partner to sales teams focused on New Advertiser types, including payment providers, upper-funnel non-endemic advertisers, and ad tech providers, with the goal of scaling non-endemic into a significant revenue line.
* Partner with sales teams focused on formats such as savings, in-store, and AI solutions.
Define the 0* 1 strategy for each bet, then own execution while aligning cross-functional teams across Instacart.
* As these bets mature, take on increasing strategic ownership: define and prioritize the next set of incremental bets across the Instacart Ads ecosystem.
* Communicate tradeoffs, progress, and results clearly to senior stakeholders, including the GM of Ads.

**About You**
-------------

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience in product management for ad formats, with a strong understanding of user-facing ad experiences. [TBD — finalize years of experience with recruiter]
* Track record of launching user-facing products and managing trade-offs between users and advertisers
* Experience managing partners and vendors, including external technology providers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across sales, engineering, and cross-functional teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with performance advertising products.
Experience taking new products from 0* 1 in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Background in ad tech, retail media, or a closely related domain.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gameplay
jobs.desc:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About You**

You love to play chess and want to help others discover that same passion. You understand the full user journey of being a chess player, and different types of players need to experience to find joy in the game. You are intimately familiar with the Chess.com experience and want to help further build out the Gameplay ecosystem.

You have extensive experience as a product manager shipping delightful consumer-facing products. You have worked deeply with design and engineering teams to define what great looks like and you communicate regularly and successfully to executive stakeholders.

**What you'll do**

* **Shape the Gameplay roadmap and vision.** In close partnership with leadership, shape both the near-term roadmap and the long-term vision for Gameplay at Chess.com. From live games, to daily, to bot play, you will own the gameplay experience.
* **Bring ideas and sharpen them with the team.** Come with your own point of view on what's worth building and why. You don't wait to be told. At the same time, engage seriously with feedback from leadership and peers: internalize it, push back where you disagree, and use it to make the work better. The vision is built together; you're a strong, informed voice in it.
* **Operate in public.** As a globally remote company spanning many time zones, async slack communication is how decisions get made. Work out loud in channels: brainstorm openly, pose sharp questions, make decisive small calls with reasoning attached, and be explicit on what's urgent vs. not. Engage with depth and without ego, pull the right people in by name to build alignment. Make the most of sync meeting time by taking on the biggest questions.
* **Define success and hold the bar velocity and quality.** Frame the problem, partner deeply with engineers and designers, work through what "good enough to ship”. Get product scope first-time right.
* **Use AI to prototype, de-risk, and accelerate.** Build mocks, test flows, and pressure-test ideas yourself. Bring working artifacts into discussions, not just decks. Run AB tests with velocity and build with foresight on configurability.

**Required Skills**

* **7+ years in product management, 4+ shipping consumer-facing products at scale.** You've shipped consumer-facing products to large user bases. You know how to balance a quantitative understanding of funnels, metrics, and experimentation with a qualitative feel for what makes a delightful user experience.
* **Excellent product taste, especially in the chess context.** You know what feels good and what doesn't. You know what users with different levels of chess skill and experience are looking to get out of gameplay.
* **AI-native.** You already use AI daily to prototype, explore ideas, and accelerate execution. You build working prototypes as the basis for discussion.
* **High-velocity communicator.** You communicate clearly and concisely at speed and across many projects. You act as the focal point across design, engineering, stakeholders, product peers, and executives, digging into engineering specifics in one thread then zooming out to exec-level outcomes in the next.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

**Summary of Position**

You'll own the vision and strategy for the core member software experience across the full care journey, from the moment a member first discovers what care is available through getting care and following up afterward. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in systems, has strong product design sense, and uses data and user research to decide what to build and why. You'll turn ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into clear direction, set a vision that delights members while working within the realities of a complex, regulated healthcare environment, and earn trust with partners from engineering leads to senior executives. You operate with a high degree of autonomy and are the person we point at a complex, high-priority problem to chase down end to end.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Set the vision and strategy: define a multi-year vision and roadmap for the core member-facing software experience across the full care journey, and prioritize smartly among competing efforts to deliver the greatest value for members.
* Think in systems: map the complete member journey end to end, break down ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into clear requirements, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data science, clinical, operations, and marketing.

* Take ideas from concept to impact: convert opportunities into well-scoped projects, lead the team through prototyping, launch, and iteration, and hold the team to a high standard of execution.
* Lead up, down, and across the organization: serve as a credible senior product voice with engineers and executives alike, synthesize complexity into a simple, persuasive narrative, create clarity without pretending certainty by communicating what we believe, what we've learned, and what remains unknown, and carry complex conversations independently.
Raise the bar for product: mentor other product managers on product craft, systems thinking, and analytical rigor.  

  

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

No

**About the team**
------------------

Confluence is where organizations write down what they know: decisions, architecture, process, and policy. But a company's work does not happen in one tool. It happens in file drives, chat, code hosts, CRMs, and data platforms.

The Aggregation team makes Confluence fill and organize itself from those tools. Content arrives with its source system's permissions intact, gets organized so a team can navigate it, and stays current as the underlying work changes. That content is what Confluence's AI answers are built on, which makes its coverage and quality the difference between an answer a team acts on and one they go verify by hand.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how Confluence turns connected content into knowledge that maintains itself: what a space pulls in, how it gets organized, how it stays current, and when it flags that something important is missing. Vision through launch and iteration, on problems that arrive undefined.

Quality is the job here, not a stage of it. Content that is stale, mis-grouped, or wrong does more damage than content that was never connected at all, because a team will have already acted on it.

You are building for three audiences, and the role requires you to name which one you are serving in every decision: the admin who approves connecting a system of record and will disconnect it the moment trust breaks, the space owner accountable for a body of knowledge staying current, and the end user who wants the answer without knowing which tool it came from.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for what connected content becomes inside Confluence: what gets pulled in, how it is grouped, titled, and summarized, and what happens to content that has gone stale or contradicts a published page.
* Define how messy inputs become usable structure. Documents, spreadsheets, meeting transcripts, chat threads, and CRM records do not arrive as pages, and deciding what shape they take in Confluence is the core of the work.
* Own freshness and decay. Decide what updates on its own when a source changes, what needs a human to confirm, and how a user can tell which one they are looking at.
* Set and defend the quality bar for retrieval: permission fidelity to the source, accuracy, and latency. Decide what does not ship, and hold that line when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality evals for the parts of the experience powered by a large language model. Define what a correct output looks like, build the test sets, catch regressions as models and content change, and decide when output is good enough that a user stops double-checking it.
* Decide where AI belongs in the experience and how it behaves when it is wrong. A suggestion that costs nothing to ignore and a suggestion that hijacks what someone was doing are the difference between a feature teams keep and one they switch off.
* Drive execution across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Partnerships, and Security and Trust. Bring clear recommendations to executive forums.
* Set the product bar. Mentor PMs and raise the quality of specs and decisions across the team.

### **What we're looking for**

* 8+ years in product management, including at least one product where content, retrieval, or a model-powered experience was the core value rather than a feature added later.
* You have taken a 0 to 1 product from strategy through launch and past the first disappointing metric.

Every draw, inspection, budget change and payment that moves through Built leaves behind data our customers need to manage risk and run their portfolios. Turning that data into products lenders rely on every day is one of the biggest opportunities in front of us.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager, Data to own the data capabilities and reporting tools that sit on top of the Built platform: embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio insights, data delivery into customer systems, and the data foundation our AI features depend on. You'll work alongside data engineering, analytics, and the product teams whose workflows generate and consume the data, and you'll be accountable for ensuring our core products deliver data value to customers.

jobs.desc:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Data & AI Platform team and own the algorithmic systems that sit underneath dozens of downstream product features and quietly decide what gets prioritized, surfaced, and trusted across ServiceTitan.


This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who thinks in statistics, not just user stories. The specific problems you'll own will shift based on what domain teams and our customers need most — today that might mean ranking methodology, deduplication logic, or causal inference; tomorrow it could be a different statistically-driven problem entirely. What stays constant is the kind of thinking: translating ambiguous, statistically messy problems into clear product requirements that engineering and ML can build against with confidence. This is a heavily stats-driven PM role: you'll be evaluating model tradeoffs, defining what "correct" means for a given system, and defending methodology choices to a technical audience as much as you'll be writing a roadmap.


What you'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for whichever algorithmic systems — ranking, deduplication, causal inference, or similar — are highest-priority based on domain team and customer need.
  • Translate real customer pain (bad matches, untrustworthy rankings, wrong conclusions drawn from correlated data) into statistically rigorous product requirements.
  • Co-author PRDs for statistically ambiguous problems where the "right answer" isn't obvious — you're defining the evaluation criteria as much as the solution.
  • Partner with ML and engineering to evaluate model tradeoffs (precision/recall, false positive cost, explainability vs. accuracy) and make the product call when there's no clean answer.
  • Set measurable, multi-quarter goals for algorithmic system health and lead cross-functional teams toward them with rigor.
  • Lead discovery with domain product teams and customers to understand where algorithmic errors actually cost time, money, or trust.
  • Proactively identify and resolve disagreements over methodology, ownership, and model quality before they stall multiple teams building on your systems.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, strong track record in enterprise B2B SaaS; experience with at least one of ranking/recommendation systems, entity resolution, or causal inference — this role will likely touch more than one over time.
  • Genuine statistical fluency — comfortable with precision/recall tradeoffs, confounding vs. causation, and model evaluation, regardless of which specific problem you're applied to.
  • Demonstrated ability to define evaluation criteria and "what correct looks like" for a new statistical problem from scratch, rather than working from an existing rubric.
  • Comfort context-switching between different algorithmic domains as customer and business priorities shift.
  • Experience translating customer-reported problems (bad matches, low trust in recommendations, wrong conclusions) into statistically defined product work.
  • Strong communication skills — explaining model tradeoffs to domain PMs, ML engineers, and customers who each need a different level of technical detail.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and holds themselves accountable to outcomes — "mostly works" isn't good enough when customers are trusting your systems with real decisions.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.

While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot), or built automations using AI agents. Show us how you've used AI to learn, build, and solve problems beyond basic text generation.

Director of Product Management, Commerce Billing

Location: USA

The HubSpot Product team is passionate about building tools that help businesses market, sell, serve their customers, and ultimately grow better. We build for more than 160,000 customers in over 120 countries around the world. Our team has scaled rapidly over the past few years, and our need for empathetic, adaptable, and remarkable product leaders have grown in kind.

Our product leaders have a few things in common: they are strong visionaries with previous success in defining a strategic roadmap, delivering a business plan, and positioning products in the market successfully that solve real customer problems. They are able to work autonomously, lead with psychological safety, and grow a team into more than the sum of its parts.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Join a product led culture
  • Drive our strategy, product roadmap & guide new product ideas from an initial concept all the way to product launch
  • Work in alignment with partners in UX and Engineering to create the greatest value and usability for our customers
  • Use data to identify opportunities, strategize to execute these changes, and partner with business stakeholders across HubSpot to make these solutions for our customers

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About This Role:

Every month, hundreds of thousands of patients and providers interact with Headway's support systems. Today, most interactions are handled by human agents working across disconnected tools. We believe CX is a product, not just a department — and the right product leader can transform how Headway supports its customers while dramatically improving both satisfaction and cost efficiency.

As Director of Product for CX, you will build Headway's CX product function from the ground up. You'll own the product vision and strategy for how patients and providers get help — from AI-powered self-resolution to context-aware agent tooling to the feedback loops that connect support insights back to the product.

You will:

  • Define the vision and strategy for Headway's CX product — spanning AI-powered resolution, agent tooling, proactive engagement, channel strategy, knowledge systems, and the feedback loops that connect support insights back to the product.
  • Build and lead a team of product managers focused on reducing cost-to-serve while increasing resolution quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Own the AI resolution layer — build the agentic workflows and API integrations that enable the AI agent to actually resolve problems, not just answer questions. Define the autonomy framework: what AI handles without human involvement, what needs guardrails, and what requires a human.
  • Build proactive engagement — systems that contact customers before they discover problems. Shift Headway's CX from reactive to proactive.
  • Launch and unify all contact channels — email, text, and voice — with intelligent routing that delivers differentiated experiences based on customer context, value, and issue type.
  • Own the knowledge and quality layer — machine-readable SOPs, AI evaluation frameworks and crisis escalation pathways.
  • Partner deeply with CX Operations to build agent tooling that makes human agents dramatically more effective — AI copilot, full journey context, auto-generated summaries.
  • Close the feedback loop: build the system that identifies the highest-impact product defects driving support volume and surfaces them to insurance platform teams for upstream fixes.
  • Establish measurement frameworks that connect CX product investments to business outcomes..

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

  • You are a product leader with 8+ years of experience, including at least 3 years managing PMs, with a track record of building CX/support products at scale.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.desc:
PerformYard is a profitable, growth-stage B2B SaaS company transforming how organizations manage and measure employee performance. Our AI-enabled platform is widely adopted for its customizable performance processes, ease of use, and measurable business impact. As we scale, PerformYard has significant opportunities to accelerate growth by creating AI-native workflows, expanding into adjacent talent modules, and modernizing our user experience.

We are seeking a customer-obsessed, strategically minded Vice President of Product to translate PerformYard's AI-native vision into validated, high-impact product experiences. By delivering AI-native innovation, modernizing the user experience to accelerate adoption, and expanding monetization pathways, this leader will directly impact ARR growth and long-term market leadership.

Reporting directly to the CTO and partnering closely with the executive team, the VP of Product will build and scale a high-performing product organization, drive a culture of data-informed decision making, and ensure product investments translate into tangible business outcomes. With a mandate to accelerate innovation and unlock durable competitive advantages, this leader will be central to PerformYard’s next phase of growth.

This is a 100% Remote Position - now & forever

What You’ll Do:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own and evolve the long-term product vision, embedding AI-native innovation into the core platform and future offerings
  • Translate company strategy into a multi-year product roadmap aligned with ARR expansion, market positioning, and enterprise value creation
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities across product, pricing, packaging, and adjacent talent modules
  • Establish durable competitive advantages and defensible differentiation within the HR tech landscape
  • Lead product discovery practices grounded in customer insight, market intelligence, and data
  • Maintain a regular cadence of direct customer engagement to ground product decisions in real user needs

Growth & Market Expansion

  • Drive product-led growth initiatives that improve adoption, expansion, retention, and customer lifetime value
  • Develop scalable monetization strategies, including AI-driven feature differentiation and packaging evolution
  • Own the end-to-end user experience vision and partner with Design to modernize the product interface, ensuring AI-native features are intuitive and adoption-ready
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to sharpen positioning, messaging, and go-to-market effectiveness
  • Evaluate build/partner/buy decisions and guide product integrations to accelerate strategic growth

Product Execution & Leadership

  • Lead roadmap execution in partnership with Engineering, ensuring high-impact delivery with measurable outcomes
  • Partner with Engineering leadership on platform modernization, scalability, and AI-first development priorities
  • Develop team members and build a strong leadership bench to sustain organizational performance
  • Lead a high-performance culture of accountability, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Maintain operational excellence and efficiency as teams scale

 

Executive & Board Partnership

  • Serve as a key member of the executive leadership team to drive growth and enterprise value
  • Present product strategy, roadmap priorities, and growth impact to the Board with clarity and confidence
  • Advise on capital allocation, market opportunities, and strategic product investments to maximize business impact
  • Quantify the business impact of product initiatives through clear, outcome-based reporting

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Credit Analytics
Head of Product @ Koast.ai
jobs.desc:
Head of Product | Contract, 20 hrs/week to start, growing into full-time | Remote (US overlapping hours) | Reports to the CEO

The short version

Koast is the AI operating layer for teams that run Meta ads at volume. Agencies, in-house media buying teams, and enterprise buyers managing 10+ ad accounts and launching 50+ ads a week use Koast to launch faster, automate optimizations off real attribution data, and see every account from one hub. The Koast Agent is the next layer: an AI that reads the account, spots what matters, and acts inside guardrails.

We are a small team shipping fast. The product is live, customers are paying, a Whop partnership just onboarded a wave of new users, and the Agent build is underway. What we do not have is one person who owns the product end to end: what gets built, why, in what order, and whether it actually landed.

That is this role. It starts at 20 hours a week on contract. If you are the right person, it becomes the full-time product seat at Koast.

What you will own

Discovery that finds the real problem. You will sit in on enterprise sales calls and onboarding sessions, run discovery with agencies and media buying teams, and figure out what they are actually trying to get done versus what they say they want. Every feature request gets mapped to a job: launching smoother, getting their team in, getting tasks done, keeping users active and growing spend inside Koast. If it does not serve a job, it does not get built.

Specs that engineering can execute without a meeting. We run a lean engineering team plus an AI-assisted dev pipeline. That only works when the ticket is unambiguous. You will write PRDs and Shortcut tickets that define the behavior, the edge cases, the data dependencies (Meta API limits, Hyros and Cometly attribution feeds, Whop account provisioning), and the acceptance criteria. If an engineer or an agent has to guess, the spec was not done.

The queue, and what is missing from it. You own the Up Next column. You will keep engineering fed so they are never blocked, and you will keep a standing view of what is discussed in Slack, support, and QA that does not yet have a ticket. Gaps are your problem before they become customer problems.

Evidence over opinion. PostHog, Intercom, session replays, rage clicks, support threads. You will run the user-behavior audit, know where people drop off in launching, and bring numbers to every prioritization argument, including the ones with the CEO.

Delivery from spec to shipped. Governance, milestones, release notes, and the customer conversation after it ships. When something breaks or slips, you are the one who says so early, not the one who explains it after.

Technical judgement in a non-deterministic product. The Koast Agent makes decisions off data that is noisy, seasonal, and shaped by Meta's learning phase. You will make product calls that respect that: what the Agent is allowed to do, what it must never do, how we measure whether an automated action was correct. Guardrails are infrastructure here, not UI. You need to understand why.

What you will do week to week

  • Run discovery sessions with prospects and customers and turn them into scoped, execution-ready PRDs.
  • Surface technical risk early: undocumented API behavior, missing data, an assumption that will not survive a real ad account.
  • Write and groom Shortcut tickets with enough detail for an engineer or Claude Code to ship without a follow-up question.
  • Partner with engineering on feasibility, sequencing, and cutting scope to what ships this week.
  • Own success metrics per feature and report on them after launch, n

From reconnecting with old friends to discovering local groups, marketplaces, and creators, the Facebook app is where people come to find the people and things they care about. * Lead and collaborate across cross-functional teams (product, engineering, data science, brand, PR, legal, policy) and the broader ecosystem — creators, communities, small businesses, policy makers, news media, and advocates — to create integrated marketing moments that are contextually relevant.

We're a growing, fast-moving group building technology that helps government leaders safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We're looking for a product leader who is equally energized by people and strategy — someone who can set the direction, build the systems, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product designers to do the most important work of their careers.

**About us**
------------

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

**About the role**
------------------

This role sits at the center of Recidiviz's ability to scale. As Director of Product and Design, you'll lead and develop a team of experienced product managers and designers—people with years of domain expertise and a deep commitment to the mission. Your job is to make each of them sharper, more supported, and more impactful: setting strategic context, building the people systems that help them grow, and creating the conditions for them to build products that actually get used on a daily and weekly basis. You'll report to the Chief Impact Officer and serve as a key partner on product direction, team health, operational standards, and organizational strategy as Recidiviz scales nationally. Some travel to our state partners, internal team gatherings, and offsites is expected.

-------------------------

* **Own the outcomes:** Drive positive correctional outcomes by expanding product-market-impact fit, building long-term organizational sustainability, and scaling what works to more states—ensuring tools deliver immediate usability and sustained weekly active engagement.
* **Lead and develop a high-performing team:** Manage and mentor PMs, designers, and emerging leaders. Build cohesive cross-functional rituals, streamline team operations, and drive adoption of shared UI standards to increase execution speed and state-by-state consistency.

* **Set strategic context:** Define a clear direction so every PM and designer understands where their area fits, what to prioritize, and why it matters. This role owns customer and business outcomes, transforming validated market and user needs into differentiated, scalable capabilities that reinforce a coherent and integrated Orion experience.

Working closely with a peer senior product leader, engineering, data science, customer-facing teams, and executive leadership, the Senior Director ensures cross-functional alignment and drives continuous improvement. This is a hands-on leadership role, setting vision and priorities for a defined Orion domain and directly leading discovery, prioritization, and execution with Precision eControl and Vorys eControl stakeholders. ***At this time, candidates who would work in the following states will not be considered for this role: VT, RI, NY, NJ, NH, MI, ME, MA, DE, CO, CT, CA, and AZ.***

jobs.desc:
**About DriveCentric**

* Founded in 2010 and headquartered in St. Louis, MO, with a distributed team across the US.
* Backed by Summit Partners, with a mandate to grow, not to trim.
* Trusted by 3,300+ dealerships across the US and Canada, from single-store independents to multi-billion-dollar dealer groups, plus adjacent retail such as RV, marine and powersports.
* Launched the Service Engagement Hub in August 2026, the first engagement platform built for fixed operations, and ships autonomous AI agents (Sales, Prospect, Nurture, Service-to-Sales, Performance Management, Service) on a monthly cadence.
* One of the first automotive software companies certified to ISO/IEC 42001 for AI management.
* Runs DC20, a dealer-led peer community and event series that most vendors would call a user conference and our customers call a 20 Group.

**Why this role exists now**  
Three things are true at once:

* The portfolio is multiplying. We are moving from one product line to a platform spanning sales, service, data, F&I, payments and digital retail. Each department has a different buyer, a different competitor set and a different vocabulary. Nobody owns the messaging architecture that ties them together.

* Product velocity is ahead of field readiness. Engineering and product are shipping at a pace the company has never operated at. Sales, account management, onboarding and support need enablement that is timely, credible and actually used, and we do not yet have the system to produce it.

* The category is up for grabs. The market wants to put us in the CRM box. Our thesis is that AI agents change what "CRM" means, and the company that explains that best to a skeptical, relationship-driven buyer wins the next decade of auto retail software. That story needs an owner.

And one thing underneath all three: we are building an AI-native company, not a company with an AI product. Engineering ships with AI, our internal agents answer the field's questions, and every function is expected to automate its own work. Product marketing has to be built that way from day one, which is why the person who builds it matters so much.  
  
You will report to the Chief Product & Business Officer and sit on the product leadership team alongside the VP Product, the AI Labs lead and the Head of Product Operations. Two product marketing managers will report to you on day one, with room to grow the team as the pillars scale.  
  
**What you will own**  
**Positioning and narrative.** Build and maintain the messaging architecture for the platform and each of its pillars: the umbrella story, the per-department stories, and the proof that connects them. Lead the multi-year narrative evolution from CRM to AI Engagement Platform, and make it land with three very different audiences: the owner-operator of one store, the centralized buying group running 5 to 15 rooftops, and the enterprise group with a CFO in the room.  
  
**Launches**. Design and run our new product introduction system: launch tiers, the artifacts each tier gets, who does what, and how we measure whether the launch worked. Build it AI-first, so that a monthly agent cadence produces a full set of launch assets without a monthly scramble. Then run the big ones yourself. NADA Show (February, Orlando) is the industry's Dreamforce and our largest launch moment of the year; you will own the product marketing plan for it.

The Director of Product Marketing will define how the market understands 1EXIGER.AI and designated portfolio priorities. **About Bobtail**
-----------------

Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.

We work in a unique way at Bobtail, where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.

If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.

* Teams over individuals

* Collaboration

* Communication

* Iteration

* Experimentation and failing fast

* Initiative and solutions oriented approach

* Documentation

* Data

* Mental health and work life balance

* Diversity

* Transparency

We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail. This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.

The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.

* A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
* Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.

* Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
* Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
* A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.

Reporting to the VP of AI & Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross-functional product teams.

Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform's two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.

**About this team**

Our mission is to provide the best-in-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.

**What you'll do**

Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy

* Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Search & Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
* Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).

* Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.

* Executive Storytelling & Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board-ready presentations for executive leadership.
* Build Cross-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade-offs.
* Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.

Drive Operational Excellence & Execution

* Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery.
* Systems & Marketplace Metrics: Establish clear performance metrics to measure search precision, recall, candidate-to-job match relevance, search latency, and reciprocal marketplace liquidity.

* Evolve Product Rituals: Establish operational frameworks, governance rituals, and decision-making standards that foster velocity and transparency across teams.

jobs.desc:
**Director of Product**  
Team: Product  
Reports to: McKay Ferrell, CPO  
Location: Remote, United States  
Type: Full-time  
  
Job Summary  
As a Director of Product at SureCost, you'll own the business of a set of products that pharmacies  
depend on to keep drugs on the shelf at the right cost. You'll bring new products to market and make  
our existing products better, from the first customer conversation through launch and adoption. You'll  
know our customers well enough to build things they love to use, and you'll measure whether they do.  
This is a hands-on role. You'll talk to customers every week, prototype ideas before engineering builds  
them, and work with our commercial team to launch and sell what we ship. We're rebuilding how our  
product team works around AI tools, and you'll help shape that as you go.  
  
Essential Functions  

* Own the roadmap, outcomes and quarterly priorities for your product areas, and decide which

initiatives make the quarter within the capacity your pods actually have.  

* Run a monthly business review for your area covering adoption, customer issues, revenue signals

and delivery against plan.  

* Build toward product-level P&L visibility for your area with the CPO.
* Own the quality of what your area ships, including the share of engineering time that goes to various

initiatives.  

* Build and help guide product builder team members with AI tooling and structures.
* Stay close to customers. Expect several customer conversations a week, including the hard ones

with enterprise accounts.  

* Work with the commercial team on product launch planning and enablement, including launch

timing, sales training, demo readiness and customer communication.  

* Partner with Marketing on positioning, messaging and competitive intelligence for your products.
* Give pricing and packaging input for new products and major enhancements.
* Bring what you hear from Sales, Customer Success and the market back into the roadmap, including

win/loss patterns and competitor moves.  

* Track adoption after launch and work with Customer Success to drive it.
* Build and ship prototypes, skills and agents yourself, and set the standard your team follows for AI-

assisted discovery, specs and evaluation.  

* Own the AI agents in your area end to end: the problem they solve, the precision bar they have to

meet, the evaluation that proves it, and where a named human approves an action.  

* Recommend when to stop or reshape an initiative, and bring the evidence.

SureCost | Job Description  

* Work across product areas with the other Director, Product Ops and Design so the product lifecycle

(inventory, purchasing, shortage) holds together for the customer.  
  
How We Work  

* Product areas own the work. Our value streams point where our teams are focused and set how

each pod's hours are split, and every Director plans inside that split.  

* Our product builders combine what used to be PM, PO and UX roles. Agents draft stories,

acceptance criteria, status and first-pass triage. People make the decisions and own the quality.  

* AI fluency is part of how we hire and how we review.
* We're remote-first. Most of our work takes place over digital ecosystems, including video calls,

chats, email, and other systems – you’ll need to be self-motivated and comfortable in an all-remote  
environment.  

* The domain is complicated: GPO contracts, wholesaler operations, DSCSA, 340B and drug shortages.

We give you time to learn it, and we expect you to go deep.  
  
Requirements  

* 5+ years in product management for B2B or enterprise SaaS, including 2+ years leading product

managers or product owners.  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Pharmacology, or related required.
* A record of owning product outcomes, such as adoption, retention or revenue, and being able to

show what changed because of your decisions.  

* Hands-on AI fluency you can demonstrate: you've built prototypes, workflows

Working closely with Executive Leadership, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Legal, and Compliance, the Director ensures that product investments align with company objectives and market opportunities while driving measurable business outcomes.

As Director of Product Management, you will help shape the future of SWIVEL's product portfolio while leading a talented team of product professionals. You will influence company strategy, drive customer and commercial outcomes, and own products from concept through commercialization. This role is ideal for a product leader who enjoys balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and believes product success is measured not only by what is built, but by the business and customer value it delivers.

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

**About this team**

Job Ingestion is the foundational engine that powers BOLD's entire job discovery and recruitment platform. Our mission is to build, scale, and optimize high-throughput, enterprise-grade ingestion systems that aggregate, parse, normalize, and index millions of job postings daily across all BOLD properties and partner feeds. By transforming high-volume, unstructured job data into rich, standardized job entities, our team enables critical downstream capabilities – most notably powering Search & Match, job alerts, SEO landing pages, recommendations, and employer analytics. * Data Quality & Governance: Establish schema validation, content freshness, spam/scam detection, and compliance standards to maintain high job catalog health without breaking downstream search indices.
* Team Development & Product Rituals: Coach and mentor product managers in business sense and executive communication, while establishing operational rituals that drive velocity and clarity.

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.  
  
This role is based in the United States, with Pacific or Mountain time zone strongly preferred to support collaboration with teams in Australia. You should expect regular travel to Sydney, San Francisco, and Seattle.  
  
**About the Role**

Atlassian is reimagining the future of teamwork with AI at its core. Jira’s mission is to autonomously organize, plan, and track work for our customers, then supply context from Atlassian’s Teamwork Graph to agents that help get the work done.

We’re looking for a visionary **Head of Product for Jira** to lead the product organization responsible for Jira’s experience, AI, and customer adoption. In this role, you’ll shape the surfaces where humans and agents work together: work items, boards, lists, backlogs, plans, agent sessions, and the Teamwork Graph context that makes Jira agents uniquely powerful.

You’ll lead a global team of product managers across Australia, the United States, and India. Reporting to Jira’s Head of Product, you’ll operate as an immediate deputy, directly responsible for strategy, team building, and executing major initiatives. You’ll work closely with engineering and design leadership across Atlassian, spend meaningful time with customers, and hold a high quality bar for everything we ship.

Responsibilities:

* **Product Leadership:** Own the multi-year product strategy for how humans and agents do work together in Jira, including new teamwork patterns that emerge as agents take on a larger share of delivery.
* **Core Jira Experience:** Lead the product vision for work items, boards, lists, backlogs, plans, views, and mobile experiences used by both humans and agents.
* **AI & Agent Context:** Define what a Jira agent knows that a generic agent does not, and how the Teamwork Graph turns that context into visibly better outcomes for customers.
* **Customer Adoption:** Drive agent adoption in Jira, including in-product discovery, onboarding, automation and chat adoption, and the path from a user’s first agent invocation to habitual use.
* **Team Leadership:** Build, develop, and scale a large product organization, hiring, coaching, leveling, and managing product managers and PM managers across three geographies.
* **Product Craft:** Set the bar for experience-led product management inside Jira, with a focus on taste, prototype-first thinking, and protecting quality by cutting scope when needed.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Partner with leaders across Atlassian, especially in the Teamwork Collection and AI groups, resolving duplicated work and aligning teams around shared outcomes.
* **Customer & Market Voice:** Act as the senior product voice with customers and in the market, translating what you learn from real teams into a durable experience vision.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**Type::** Full-time

**Location:** Remote, with a preference for candidates located in NY, TX, MD, or GA

**Compensation:** $140,000 - $180,000

**Job Level:** Director/VP (depending on experience)

**ABOUT LEMONTREE**
-------------------

There are more food pantries in the US than there are McDonalds, but most families facing hunger don't take that help. That's why we started Lemontree–because it makes no sense for our neighbors to go hungry when there's free food around the corner. We've helped one million households access the free food in their communities by bringing technology + empathy to the experience of food assistance. Learn more about us at https://www.foodhelpline.org/about.

### **Our Values**

**Service Over Self**

We put the mission — helping people find food — ahead of ego, credit, or agenda. That means caring for the people we serve and the team around us, and going the extra mile when it makes a real difference. We're here for the work itself and what it makes possible for others.

**Ownership**

We get shit done and we carry our piece so the whole team can move forward. When we make a mistake, we name it early and openly, because a problem we've owned out loud is one we can fix together. In a growing org, this kind of autonomy & accountability is how we do big things with a small team.

**Curiosity**  
We don't take anything for granted. We stay curious about our users and ourselves. We stay humble enough to accept that there's always room to improve. We stay ready to change course when the evidence points somewhere new. The plan we have today is a strong draft, but we'll always need to adapt to a changing world. We'd rather ask the better question and adjust than defend a stale answer.

**THE POSITION**
----------------

Lemontree is looking for a **Head of Product** **& Technology** that will partner with the Executive Director to own and evolve our platform strategy to scale our impact. Since 2020, we've grown from a simple helpline into a platform that serves thousands of families, partners, and volunteers daily. What we need now is someone who can shepherd us to the next level, bringing rigor and direction to how we evolve: sharper prioritization, better use of our data, and clearer decision-making & process around where we invest our resources. Every decision we make should align with our strategic anchors:

* User-centered

* Hospitality in every interaction

* Built for scale

This is a hands-on leadership role with high trust and high agency, reporting to the Executive Director. You'll be the person setting product direction and leading the charge to move it forward, partnering with an engineering agency on execution and collaborating closely across our broader Lemontree team. While product ownership is the focus, this is a multi-disciplinary position that combines product management, data analysis, and technical leadership to build toward stability *and* scalability. If you like operating with real autonomy and are motivated to take things from 1 100, this role will suit you.

### **What You'll Do**

Drive **technical leadership** that delivers a reliable, joyful, scalable user experience for neighbors looking for food assistance.

* Serve as a credible technical voice in conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and feasibility.
* Direct our engineering agency, translating product priorities into well-scoped technical work and holding a high bar for what ships.
* Oversee third party services that support our product, including setting up integrations, managing billing, negotiating nonprofit discounts, etc.

Own a **product roadmap** that increases the breadth & depth of our impact, aligned with our organizational strategy.

* Partner with CEO & senior leadership to shape overall strategy & product direction. Rather than making every single product decision, you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow-through.

Reporting to the VP, Commercialization, the Director of Product Management will serve as the strategic leader for Motional's product team and lead the design and execution of product vision and design to ensure every rider has the best rider experience possible. You will incorporate feedback from riders, executives, shareholders and customers and leverage these insights to ensure we are providing the best possible experience with a sustainable business mindset. As we transition from development to deployment in Las Vegas in 2026, we are setting the stage to scale our technology globally. This role requires a visionary product leader who can zoom out to build a cohesive Motional point of view on the product experience, while zooming in to untangle complex technical dependencies between hardware, AI, and operations. You will ultimately lead our product teams, establishing a high-velocity development loop that ensures every release is safer, more performant, and more commercially viable than the last and our tools develop and scale for growth.

**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!**

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

**Welcome to Orchestration Works — Ensemble's bold leap into the future of healthcare innovation.**

We're building something big. Orchestration Works is a brand-new division designed to move fast, break barriers, and bring cutting-edge technology like AI and automation to life across the healthcare revenue cycle. This is where ideas don't just get tested — they get scaled. Our mission is simple: transform how we work, deliver next-level results for our clients, and lead the industry into tomorrow.

**Why Orchestration Works Exists**

Healthcare is changing at warp speed. To stay ahead, we're taking R+D out of the lab and putting it into real operations — quickly, intelligently, and boldly. This new division gives us the freedom and focus to experiment, learn, and deploy innovations that make a measurable impact.

**What Makes It Different**

* **A dedicated R+D powerhouse:** A 50-person independent team headquartered in Austin, Texas — built to move at startup speed.
* **Real autonomy:** Independent leadership, resources, and decision-making authority that lets us innovate without friction.
* **A laser focus:** Revenue Cycle Management innovations powered by automation, AI, and reimagined processes — including work on advanced Administrative and Clinical Reasoning Models.
* **A future-ready mindset:** We're here to help Ensemble evolve rapidly while protecting what makes us exceptional.

**Why It Matters**

The future of healthcare isn't waiting — and neither are we. Orchestration Works positions Ensemble to stay ahead of industry shifts, unlock new performance breakthroughs, and deliver smarter, faster, more reliable results for the organizations we serve.

### **Position Overview**

The Head of Product owns product practice for Orchestration Works: the intake funnel that feeds the portfolio, the ROI thesis discipline that every initiative must carry, and the operating cadence that keeps the 120-day model honest. Every problem that enters OW arrives with a documented hypothesis about automation lift, operational improvement, and financial return — this role is the keeper of that discipline, from intake through gate decisions through outcome reporting.

This is end-to-end initiative ownership across the pod portfolio: product leadership, outcomes, testing, and the reporting rhythm that keeps executive governance informed. The Head of Product runs the gate review cadence for the General Manager, owns portfolio reporting into Control Tower, and sets the product and design standard that pod Product Managers and Designers work to. The role is the interface to Ensemble's Product organization, ensuring OW's portfolio stays connected to the enterprise roadmap without duplicating it.

**About the Role**

You'll work closely with our product leadership, sales leadership and customer-facing teams, and partner directly with enterprise clients to shape how Finario shows up in the market.

**Position Overview**

jobs.title: Director of Product - Partnerships - FuzeRx
jobs.desc:
**Job Summary**
===============

About Fuze Health
  
At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.
  
  
Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.
  
  
The Director of Product Management for Partnerships is a multi-product domain leader responsible for FuzeRx’s most critical growth engines: Virtual Pharmacy, the Patient App, and Partnerships. Accountable for nearly half of our engineering capacity and essential to our gross profit goals, this leader will own a massive footprint of our roadmap, driving business-line performance, technical consolidation, and high-visibility enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role is mission-critical. You will step into a high-leverage environment to guide our patient-facing platforms and steer vital enterprise launches with top-tier pharma logos. By bringing strategic vision and process rigor to an ambiguous space, you will compound FuzeRx’s competitive advantage: delivering better patient care, faster turnarounds, and lower costs-to-serve while empowering our clinical teams to do their best work.  

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Domain Strategy & Vision:** Own the product strategy across Virtual Pharmacy, Patient App, and Partnerships. Translate complex, ambiguous business opportunities into a coherent, proactive roadmap for multiple engineering pods, shifting the team from reactive enterprise fulfillment to strategic, scalable capabilities.
* **Team Leadership & Growth:** Lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing team of PMs. Provide the necessary "air cover" for your team to execute flawlessly, raising the bar on product craft, ownership, and decision quality.
* **AI-Driven Operational Excellence:** Ship new AI-native (agentic, generative, predictive) capabilities that enhance how our care, clinical, and operations teams work. Make AI competency a default expectation within your organization.
* **Ruthless Prioritization:** Navigate and prioritize competing demands from Clinical, Care, Ops, and Commercial stakeholders. Defend trade-offs with rigorous data and clear judgment to protect unit economics and engineering bandwidth.
* **Process Rigor & Delivery:** Implement robust operating mechanisms—intake, prioritization, OKRs, and lifecycle audits—in domains where they are currently lacking. Operate in fast, continuous-improvement cycles to ship in weeks, instrument outcomes, and adjust.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Craft compelling investment narratives to align cross-functional leaders and executives around shared outcomes. Resolve conflicts independently and build roadmaps that accelerate enterprise sales cycles.
* **Platform & Engineering Partnership:** Collaborate deeply with Engineering on platform architecture, tech stack consolidation, and Fuzion integrations. Anticipate and mitigate risks related to scale, performance, and system reliability.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of progressive product management experience, including ownership of a distinct product line or complex bu

jobs.title: Director of Product Management (Jopari)
jobs.desc:
**About Us**

At Office Ally, we've been revolutionizing healthcare administration since our inception. What started as a clearinghouse focused on simplifying insurance claims processing for healthcare providers has grown into a full-suite healthcare technology company. We offer a range of affordable, cloud-based revenue cycle management solutions –from eligibility verification and claims management to revenue recovery and payment processing –that help healthcare organizations of all sizes streamline operations and reduce administrative burdens so they can focus on what matters most: patient care.

In April 2026, Office Ally acquired Jopari Solutions, Inc, a leader in straight-through electronic claims processing for Property & Casualty (P&C), Commercial, and Government healthcare. Jopari brings deep industry expertise and innovative enterprise payment solutions that are transforming how disbursements are handled across the insurance ecosystem. Together, we are expanding our capabilities across the full healthcare transaction lifecycle, connecting claims, payments, and data exchange to deliver a more seamless and efficient experience for providers, payers, and partners.

At the core of our company are four key values that guide our mission and work:

* **Ownership**: We take pride in our responsibilities, driving results and taking accountability for the success of our projects.
* **Empowerment**: We believe in giving our team the autonomy and support to make decisions that lead to innovative solutions.
* **Innovation**: We continuously seek new and better ways to improve healthcare administration, embracing creativity and forward-thinking technology.
* **Transparent Communication**: Open, honest communication is at the heart of our collaborations, internally and with our clients, ensuring alignment and trust.

**About the Role**

The Director of Product Management will support Jopari Solutions' continued expansion of healthcare technology solutions and services by owning the business and product requirements that shape product strategy, direction, and roadmap execution. This leadership position operates with a high degree of autonomy, making informed product and prioritization decisions within established company strategy, financial objectives, regulatory obligations, and delivery constraints. The Director translates market, customer, operational, and financial insights into a clear portfolio vision and roadmap, owns business outcomes across the product lifecycle, and ensures the Product Management team is aligned, accountable, and equipped to deliver measurable value.

The role serves as a senior product leader across executive management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Client Services, Customer Care, Sales, Marketing, customers, and strategic partners. The Director is expected to resolve ambiguity, make and communicate tradeoff decisions, escalate material enterprise risks, and create the operating discipline required for consistent portfolio execution.

This role combines deep subject matter expertise in Liquid Chromatography and Sample Preparation with a strong focus on early life cycle execution and a customer-focused, outside-in approach to product development, maintaining a deep understanding of the market, customers, and competitive landscape. The Senior Director leverages this market knowledge to lead the effort to build and scale Restek’s LC and SP business, identifying the investments and organizational support needed to drive sustained growth and profitability.

In addition to managing and developing a team of Product Management professionals, this role leads cross-functional teams to generate and implement new product initiatives alongside strategic management of the existing LC and Sample Preparation product portfolio.

Leaders create clarity around goals, hold themselves and their teams accountable, partner effectively across functions and regions, and foster inclusive, high-performing teams. They develop people, remove barriers, and lead with humility and service so every employee-owner can contribute to Restek’s success.

jobs.desc:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa’s Customer Journey Business Product team is a cross-functional organization responsible for driving product strategy and execution across the end-to-end customer journey from demand generation through sales, implementation, servicing, and growth. Our team operates as a true enterprise product organization, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, Operations, Finance, Support, and Technology to design and scale capabilities that work consistently across Visa. Product leaders on this team own outcomes across the lifecycle, not just individual tools, and play a critical role in shaping how work scales across regions, value streams, and customer motions.

We are seeking a Director, Implementation & Activation Product Management to lead the product strategy for the post-sales customer experience, with a focus on implementation, onboarding, activation, and transition to ongoing customer success. This role will serve as the connective point between the seller and Customer Success teams, bringing together the systems, workflows, data, and governance needed to create a more seamless and connected post-sales journey. The leader in this role will be critical to driving revenue outcomes by improving time-to-value, activation, adoption, implementation efficiency, and visibility into post-sale performance.

Key Responsibilities:

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Implementation / Activation value stream across the sales to post-sales customer journey.
* Design and scale a connected implementation and activation experience from deal through onboarding, go-live, early usage, and handoff to Customer Success.
* Bridge Sales, CS, Implementation, Finance, and Technology teams to align process, roles, systems, and customer milestones.
* Define the business architecture and workflow model that connects seller commitments, implementation readiness, customer onboarding steps, activation milestones, and ongoing success management.
* Drive platform and process improvements across CRM, onboarding, implementation, workflow, case management, customer communications, and reporting tools to reduce friction in the post-sale journey.
* Partner operations and customer-facing leaders to ensure implementation and activation motions support revenue targets, forecast accuracy, customer retention, and expansion readiness.
* Establish and monitor OKRs such as implementation cycle time, time-to-value, activation rate, onboarding completion, feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and post-sale revenue realization.
* Translate customer, seller, and operational pain points into prioritized product requirements, business cases, and delivery plans.
* Lead cross-functional governance for post-sales process standardization, while balancing enterprise consistency with regional and segment needs.
* Drive change management, field enablement, and adoption for new implementation and activation capabilities, workflows, and operating models.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
Description:

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

AIAEC is hiring a Head of Product to lead the strategy, development, commercialization and growth of our SaaS portfolio: current and future products.

We want more than a roadmap manager. We’re looking for a product leader who has taken technology products from idea and discovery through launch, adoption and commercial scale. You’ll lead our Product Owners and UI/UX team, partner closely with Engineering, QA, Support, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing and executive leadership, and make sure AIAEC focuses on the opportunities that matter most to customers and the business.

This role calls for strong product judgment. You’ll guide prioritization, weigh competing opportunities, and direct product and engineering capacity toward the initiatives with the greatest potential for customer adoption, usability and market impact.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

You’ll translate company strategy and market opportunities into clear product strategies, roadmaps and measurable outcomes. Working within AIAEC’s established operating model and product development framework, you’ll drive disciplined execution across the full product lifecycle and help evolve product management practices, standards and tools as we scale.

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership**

* Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for each product based on company goals, market opportunities and customer needs.
* Prioritize across the portfolio when multiple products compete for product and engineering capacity.
* Evaluate new products, features, integrations and markets, and make sure major investments are backed by customer, market and business evidence.
* Assess product and feature readiness before major releases, and partner with the COO and executive team on product direction.

**Discovery & Validation**

* Lead discovery through customer interviews, market and competitive research, workflow analysis and usage data.
* Define problems clearly and assess opportunities before committing significant development resources.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from Customer Success, Sales, Support, pilots and production customers.
* Validate problems and ideas through prototypes, usability tests and experiments, and track product-market fit.

**Product Development**

* Lead execution across the full lifecycle: Idea ? Discovery ? Validation ? Prioritization ? Roadmap ? Backlog ? Development ? Release ? Adoption ? Feedback ? Improvement.
* Turn validated needs into clear requirements, and keep each piece of work traceable to the customer problem it solves.
* Work with Engineering on sequencing, feasibility and delivery. Product owns the what and why; Engineering owns the how.
* Make sure releases meet acceptance, usability and readiness standards, and that post-launch learnings shape future priorities.

**Commercialization & Adoption**
