**About Volley**
================

Volley Automation is building the future of parking through fully automated robotic parking systems. Our mission is to create sustainable parking solutions that are compact, efficient, and adaptable throughout a building’s lifecycle, while making EV charging easier and more accessible.

Are you intrigued by the idea of putting cars away with robots? Do you hate parking? Do you love parking? If so, we’d love to talk.

Volley Automation builds fully automated parking. Drivers hand off their car at the entry bay and walk away. From there the building takes over: AGVs move vehicles on trays, vertical conveyors move them between floors, and a controls and software stack orchestrates everything. The result is a garage that fits more cars into less concrete, in exactly the urban cores where parking is most expensive to build. Our systems go into real buildings, on real construction schedules, with real occupancy dates. That constraint shapes everything about how we build, develop, and engineer our product.

**The Role**
------------

* Turn customer and market evidence into product decisions: segment definition, configuration and pricing structure, feature go/no-go. Evidence means site visits, operator and owner interviews, and win/loss definitions and not a survey deck someone else built
* Articulate a product vision and get a company that does not yet agree to align behind it, in front of the executive team, the board, customers, and all the way through the entire org - especially the engineering team. You have held the line against per-project one-offs quietly becoming the product

* Experience with a product where the buyer and the user are different people with different definitions of value (developer and owner on one side, driver or parking spot owner/user on the other)
* Has owned a product's direction as well as its delivery. Can point to a roadmap you authored rather than inherited, and explain what you cut and why as well as what was executed on and why
* Owns a cross-functional development roadmap and plan spanning engineering, operations, commercial, and finance with time estimates that are aggressive and still real. Experience delivering this roadmap against an externally fixed date (construction schedule, customer opening, capital project milestone), where the date does not move because a certain department needs or wants it to
* Runs dependency mapping, critical path, and a risk register as habits, with suppliers, contract manufacturers, integrators, and long-lead components tracked as schedule dependencies
* Can close the loop from our Denver HQ and field deployments by turning commissioning, operational friction, and customer feedback into requirements and backlog items

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years combined, with real depth on both sides of the product owner and program execution fronts. At least 3 years owning a product and at least 3 years owning a program outcome, which may overlap
* Experience with product definition and/or technical program execution with AGVs, AMRs, robotics, material handling, warehouse automation, or vertical transportation
* BS in engineering (ME, EE, or CS) or equivalent hands-on background. Must be able to read an architecture, interrogate a design decision, and push back credibly on a technical effort estimate
* Commercially literate enough to be believed by the CEO and the board: argues a feature in dollars, payback, and segment access
* Startup mode: ambiguity, thin process, influence over authority
* Travel roughly 25-35% for customers, suppliers, and installations

* Capital equipment product management: long sales cycles, six and seven figure deals, pricing and configuration structure, service and warranty definitions
* Ran a design partner program, customer advisory board, or equivalent structured voice-of-customer mechanism
* Safety-critical or code-reg

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster. These areas include developer reach, testing, sandboxing, metering, and deployment of AI and human generated code.

As agentic build tools compress the time it takes to author a change, the bottleneck moves downstream. Testing and deploying safely to production is already one of the loudest customer asks and one of the sharpest pain points on the platform. When changes originate from agents as well as people, and arrive at a much higher rate, the ability to validate and trust them quickly stops being a quality-of-life improvement and becomes a precondition for platform growth. You will lead the team that enables this for developers.

This is not four adjacent feature areas with a shared manager. Customers experience the SDLC as one motion, and the central product challenge of this role is the connective tissue: a sandbox that behaves like the instance you will deploy to, a test suite that knows what changed, a release path that carries the evidence, and a model for building directly in production that an admin can actually govern. You set the strategy that makes their roadmaps resolve into a single lifecycle rather than four products that ship past each other.

The scope is deeply technical and close to execution. The Developer Reach feature area alone unlocks a path to building in production that admins can manage at scale without losing control, and it demands real technical depth to steer. You will also carry a broad surface, over twenty product areas, with the escalation volume that comes with it, and you will need to run that operational load without letting it consume the strategic work.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across Developer Reach, Developer Sandboxes, Agentic Testing, and Release Ops, and define how they compose into one lifecycle from authored change to governed, audited deployment.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of PMs, one per area. Set a clear standard for product craft, coach PMs on strategy and execution, and hold the bar on the seams between them: shared primitives, consistent models, and a single coherent customer narrative.
* Set product direction for validating AI-originated change at scale: what it means to trust an agent's output, what evidence a release needs to carry, and how much of the test and review burden can be automated without losing accountability.
* Drive the Developer Reach strategy, including the product model for building in production with admin control, guardrails, and reversibility at enterprise scale.
* Define the sandbox strategy: provisioning speed, production parity, data handling, and the developer experience of getting a safe place to work in seconds rather than days.
* Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental.

jobs.title: Head of PMO & Product Operations
jobs.desc:
Head of PMO & Product Operations

As the Head of PMO & Product Operations at Capital One, you will build and run the operating backbone for a complex, multi-team organization. That means owning how work flows, how capacity gets planned and allocated, where the system can run leaner, and how this organization connects with the other organizations it depends on and serves. You will work with senior leaders across the company to shape an operating model built to scale, then lead a team that turns that model into steady, repeatable execution.

**About the Team:**  
This team operates a portfolio of product and risk operations teams with roughly 200 associates that drive impact across our entire enterprise. The leader in this org will play a key horizontal role across various verticals reporting directly to the Managing Vice President of Product.

**Responsibilities of the Head of PMO & Product Operations:**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Owning the operating model for the organization: how priorities are set, how capacity is planned, and how work is sequenced and tracked across teams
* Driving efficiency and capacity management across the system: identifying bottlenecks, rebalancing load, and ensuring the organization's resourcing matches its highest priority commitments
* Designing and running the mechanisms (planning cycles, governance forums, reporting cadences) that give leadership visibility into delivery health, risk, and tradeoffs as they emerge
* Serving as the connective layer between this organization and the ones it interconnects with: aligning dependencies, surfacing cross-org risks early, and brokering tradeoffs so commitments made across boundaries actually hold
* Leading and developing a team of program and project managers and operations associates, setting the standards and tools they use to manage complex, dynamic work
* Partnering with senior stakeholders to translate strategy into an executable plan, and refining that plan as priorities and constraints shift
* Building scalable, repeatable processes that cut down on ad hoc firefighting and make the organization more predictable over time

**The person will:**
--------------------

* Think in systems: able to see how capacity, dependencies, and incentives interact across an organization, not just within a single project
* Exhibit outstanding influencing skills to drive alignment across teams and leaders who do not report to them
* Bring a proven track record of standing up or significantly maturing a PMO, operations, or similar operating model function
* Display a passion for coaching and developing a team through a clear, consistent leadership style
* Communicate with precision and credibility at all levels: translate operational complexity into clear choices for executives, and clear direction for teams

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience
* At least 10 years of project management experience
* At least 5 years of people management experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Masters / MBA degree
* 12+ years of project management experience
* 6+ years of people management experience
* PMP, Lean, Agile or Six Sigma certification
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills
* Excellent problem solving and influencing skills

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

DigiCert is building that trust layer. jobs.title: Director of Product, Buy
jobs.desc:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

**The role**
------------

The Director of Product, Buy owns the buying experience and the product decisions that shape marketplace economics. This is the pillar closest to where customers experience value every day: finding the right product, at the right price, from the right supplier, and knowing what happens after the order is placed.

Catalog quality, supplier coverage, sourcing intelligence, and fulfillment reliability shape both the customer experience and the cost of serving it. You will lead product work across those levers, partner closely with Marketplace and vendor operations, and measure the contribution of Buy product changes to purchasing volume, margin, and cost-to-serve.

You will establish clear PM ownership across catalog and search, sourcing and fulfillment, and the vendor network, building and developing a team as staffing and delivery capacity permit. You will be accountable for defined outcomes, not a backlog.

**What you will own**

### **The buying experience**

* Catalog, search, and product discovery, including how customers find what they need and how we guide them toward better choices.
* Sourcing and substitution: presenting alternatives on price, availability, and delivery speed, and making the better choice the easy one.
* Cart construction, order placement, and the pre-purchase journey.
* Fulfillment and order tracking, including how we communicate delays, exceptions, and partial shipments.
* The experience across multi-location customers, where a regional manager, a site lead, and a central procurement team may need different views of the same activity.

### **Marketplace economics and cost-to-serve**

* Catalog coverage and quality across customer needs, including how we prioritize which gaps to close.
* Product levers that influence marketplace margin, including sourcing, substitution, catalog quality, and the cost of fulfilling orders.
* Product and automation changes that reduce supplier onboarding effort and cost per supplier, with Marketplace and vendor operations.
* Product improvements to manual vendor workflows, portal automation, and exception handling. Measure their contribution to lower operating cost with the operational owner; this role does not own the vendor-operations team or its entire budget.

### **Vendor commerce integration**

* Product strategy and requirements for order transmission, supplier portals, catalog feeds, and EDI connections to vendors, in partnership with Engineering and vendor operations.
* The product decisions that make orders reach suppliers reliably and at scale.
* Partnership with Engineering on which integrations to build, automate, improve, or retire.

* Translate the Payments business case and Finance's policy into a usable, instrumented product journey.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Engagement
jobs.desc:
Stash exists to put a financial advisor in everyone's pocket: investing, banking, and personalized guidance in one app for everyday Americans to invest and save with confidence.

Stash is hiring a **Director of Product** to lead Engagement; the in-app experiences that help people decide what to invest in, how much to put in, and what to do next.

You will lead the product managers on Engagement, on web and mobile. You will be accountable for whether subscribers use the product and stay: product usage, recurring contributions, and retained paying subscribers. You will report to the Head of Product and partner as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Data, and Compliance.

This is a player/coach role that is best for someone that wants to manage and develop people while staying hands on. You'll set the strategy, manage 2-3 Product Managers, and lead by example as part of a team yourself.

**This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on-site in our New York office** **at least****three days per week to** **work with stakeholders and****foster team collaboration.**

**What you'll do:**

* Set multi-quarter strategy for Engagement: guidance, investing and banking surfaces, and the habits that keep subscribers active
* Hire, coach, and lead the Engagement product managers; set the bar for judgment, writing, and use of data
* Own the Engagement roadmap across web and mobile, and decide what gets capacity when the team is pulled in more than one direction
* Hold the team to outcomes: product usage, recurring engagement, and retained paying subscribers
* Partner with Marketing so lifecycle messaging and the in-app experience tell one story
* Run a rhythm of discovery, experimentation, and shipping inside regulatory guardrails
* Represent Engagement in leadership forums with a clear story and numbers
* Use AI in how you and your team do the work, and expect the same from the people you hire

**What we're looking for:**

* 10+ years in product management, including several years managing product managers
* Strong consumer app experience: you have owned a mobile and/or web product people use in daily life, and you can talk about user and business impact with numbers
* A track record on engagement, retention, or monetization, in addition to shipping new product
* You can set strategy and still get into the details when a decision depends on them
* Clear communication with executives, peers, and your team
* A strong partner to engineering, design, marketing, and data
* You use AI in your workflow today, or you are ready to adopt it here and with your team
* Strong experimentation practice and fluency with product analytics (Mixpanel, Looker, or similar)

**Gold Stars**

* Subscription or other recurring-revenue consumer business
* Fintech, investing, banking, or another regulated consumer product
* Products built around habits and automation

jobs.title: Global Head of Product Marketing
jobs.desc:
Clearwater Analytics is seeking a dynamic leader to strategically build and oversee our product and portfolio marketing function, with a focus on global and client expansion. We are looking for someone passionate about understanding client needs, delving into product details, and creating messaging that drives value-driven initiatives. This leadership role reports directly to the CMO and requires outstanding communication, leadership, and marketing skills. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across teams, including product, sales, partnerships, and more.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop Strategic Narratives, Messaging, and Positioning: Craft and optimize positioning and messaging across various dimensions (market, company, platform, product, and competitive positioning) to empower sales teams, support successful product launches, and deploy through all market-facing communication touchpoints (website, sales messages, SDR, content, etc.).

* Client Engagement: Engage with current and prospective clients, advocate for their needs and motivations in our brand and roadmap and guide the team to promote new concepts and maximize the value derived from our solutions.

* Customer Journey Design: Design and maintain an end-to-end customer journey for buyer personas in collaboration with revenue leadership; use this journey to implement acquisition, activation, and expansion strategies.

* Collaborate with Sales and Customer-Facing Teams: Develop proactive enablement materials, value tools, and strategies that enhance our ability to win deals, consult clients, and add value.

* Educate and Advocate: Educate industry analysts, prospects, and customers about Clearwater’s vision and solutions through meetings, webinars, conferences, and tradeshows.

* Thought Leadership: Participate in event presentations, write compelling articles, and brief decision-makers to solidify Clearwater’s position as a thought leader in our industry.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have:**

* 15+ Years of Relevant Experience: Extensive experience in product marketing (Financial services, SaaS and data) with a demonstrated track record of responsibility and ownership of product marketing direction and strategy.

* Technical Product Differentiation: Experience in differentiating technical products to both technical users and economic decision-makers.

* Engaging Presentation Skills: Strong presentation abilities, effective in both small, private groups and large, public audiences.

* Strong Communication: Ability to align and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, including sales, product management, and other marketing functions.

What we offer:

* Business casual atmosphere in a flexible working environment

* Team focused culture that promotes innovation and ownership

* Access cutting edge investment reporting technology and expertise

* Defined and undefined career pathways allowing you to grow your own way

* Competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits

* Maternity and paternity leave

* Personal Time Off and Volunteer Time Off to give back to the community

* RSUs as well as employee stock purchase plan and 401k with match

* Work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year

* Work from home Fridays

Compensation: The salary range for this position is between $160,000 and $250,000 +bonus and RSUs, based on market analysis and relevant factors

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.desc:
Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

### **Come Build with Us**

We're a NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

### **The Opportunity**

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies, and product helps to shape decisions related to which patients we reach next and how soon.

As Director of Product, you will lead a team of product managers covering the full platform, reporting directly to the CEO. You will also keep a hand in the work running discovery, writing the spec, making the call — on the bets that matter most.

The roadmap here is not handed down. You will decide what we build, in what order, and what we deliberately don't do, in a market where the right answer is rarely obvious and the stakes are patients starting therapy. If you have led product teams inside someone else's operating model and want to define your own, this is the seat.

### **What You'll Build**

**A product team that makes its own calls.** You will coach to a standard in weekly one on ones and roadmap reviews, raise the bar on writing and discovery, and give your PMs enough room to be wrong and get better. The goal is a team that can size a bet and defend it without you in the room.

**A roadmap the whole company can bet on.** Sales, implementation, and engineering all plan against what product says is coming. You will set the sequencing across a growing customer base, make the tradeoffs between what one strategic client needs and what the platform needs, and say no clearly enough that people trust the yes. Commitments hold, and when they change, everyone knows why in time to act.

**Discovery grounded in how patients actually get to therapy.** Our users are the people running patient support programs, field teams, and hub operations. You will get your team in front of them, translate what you hear into product, and build the customer and market fluency that makes our roadmap hard to copy. Strong opinions are welcome here. Strong opinions without customer contact are not.

### **What Makes You Successful**

* 10+ years in product management at a B2B software company, with a track record of shipping products enterprise customers renewed and expanded.
* 5+ years managing product managers. You have hired, coached, and given hard feedback that made someone better.
* Proven ownership of a roadmap end to end from customer discovery and strategy through launch and measured outcomes, not just execution against someone else's plan.
* Strong technical fluency. You can work through data models, API integrations, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers and hold your own. Coding is not required. Depth is.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You can make a call with incomplete information, explain the reasoning, and change course without drama when the evidence shifts.
* Exceptional written communication. You think in documents, and your specs make the decision obvious.
* Comfortable working directly with senior customer stakeholders, including the conversations nobody wants to have.
* Experience building process where none existed, and the restraint to keep it minimal.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in healt

MVDigital is hiring a Head of Product to own CinqDI, our data and audience intelligence platform. CinqDI brings together first-party contextual data, proprietary survey and polling research, and voter file data to build issue-based and psychographic audience personas, giving clients unmatched granularity in understanding audience motivation and the ability to activate campaigns directly from the platform. CinqDI already lets clients build audiences using natural language, and part of this role is pushing that further, exploring new ways people and systems consume and act on the platform's data as those approaches keep evolving. The platform is live and generating real client value today; this role is responsible for defining and delivering what it becomes next.

This is a technically fluent leadership role. Much of what CinqDI needs next, including new data integrations, new modeling capability, and new AI-driven workflows, doesn't have an established playbook yet. The person in this seat is expected to define that path, not just execute against someone else's roadmap. The role also carries direct leadership of the teams around the platform customer success/implementation and insights along with ownership of our development contract and our working partnership with Advance Local's technology and data teams.

Compensation for this position is comprised of a base salary plus incentive compensation. The base salary range is $180,000 to $203,000 per year. Additional incentives bring total potential compensation to $216,000 to $243,000.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for CinqDI, and drive decisions on what gets built next as the platform expands its data sources, modeling capability, and activation tools.
* Manage the customer success/implementation team to keep the platform continually available meeting uptime commitments and SLAs and meeting the needs of current customers.
* Guide the insights team to produce novel analysis and reports that enhance the product and the relevance of its off-the-shelf insights.
* Manage the contract with our development team, including one or more project managers overseeing contract developers, and ensure the development plan leads to monetizable enhancements.
* Serve as the primary conduit to Advance Local's technology and data teams, directing or co-managing AL resources and project managers as needed so CinqDI receives the support it needs and continues to deliver a superior product to its users.
* Work directly with data science, account executives, and strategists to turn early-stage ideas and client needs into well-defined PRDs and specs reviewing or writing them for the development team to implement.
* Partner closely with data and software engineering teams in a complex, fast-moving technical environment, staying technically fluent enough to make informed tradeoffs on architecture, data modeling, and delivery.
* Translate audience and behavioral data concepts, including issue-based segmentation, psychographic modeling, and profile-based audiences, into product features that are usable, scalable, and differentiated in market.
* Drive innovation and new thinking on the product, proactively identifying where new data sources, AI capabilities, or workflow automation could create a meaningfully better product rather than an incremental one.
* Lead product planning ceremonies, including sprint planning and backlog grooming, and prioritize the roadmap so the highest-value work ships first.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-driven capabilities into the platform, including natural language access to data, automated audience modeling, and assisted workflows for internal and client-facing users.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from concept and requirements through delivery, adoption, and iteration, with real ownership over that process.

**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

As Director of Product Strategy, Monetization & Operations, you will own the commercial and financial engine of Motive's R&D organization. You will lead revenue, pricing, packaging, margin, and cost-reduction efforts across Product and Engineering, and pair that near-term revenue strategy with the long-term product and company strategy that sets Motive's direction. You will report to the Sr. Director of Product, build your own team, and work daily with senior leaders across the company.

You are an exceptional partner and a rigorous analyst: someone who earns trust across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market, and who turns complex data into clear decisions. * Size new product lines and adjacencies, and work with product leadership to run proofs of concept and decide whether to bring new products to market.
* Shape long-term product and company strategy, turning market, customer, and competitive insight into multi-year plans and investment choices.
* Run the operating cadence for R&D strategy, including planning, business reviews, and executive reporting.
* Hire, build, and lead a team of strategy and operations professionals.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Acquisition Intelligence
jobs.desc:
**WHO WE ARE**

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry's largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

**The Role**

The Director of Product Management for ZX leads product strategy and delivery for Zeta's customer acquisition business unit. This leader turns the needs of ZX's clients and teams into a clear product vision, roadmap, and set of priorities, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Cloud, and business unit leadership to bring them to market.

The role requires both ownership of ZX's distinct needs and a commitment to building One Zeta. The Director will identify where Zeta's core platform can serve acquisition use cases, adapt those capabilities to ZX workflows, and help turn successful solutions into reusable products across the company. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, commercial understanding, and the ability to lead through cross-functional partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the ZX product vision and roadmap. Define a product strategy for customer acquisition that reflects client needs, business priorities, and Zeta's broader platform direction. Set priorities, articulate tradeoffs, and measure the impact of what the team ships.

* Connect the business unit with Product and Engineering. Serve as the product lead for ZX, translating business opportunities and operational needs into clear requirements and delivery plans. Partner with engineering and platform teams from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

* Build on Zeta's core capabilities. Apply Zeta's identity, data, AI, activation, and measurement capabilities to ZX use cases. Determine when an existing platform capability should be configured, extended, or developed into a new product experience.

* Lead the email acquisition product experience. Bring strong command of email acquisition and ESP ecosystems to the role. Shape the products and integrations that support audience targeting, deliverability, campaign execution, optimization, and measurement at scale.

* Scale solutions across One Zeta. Identify common needs across ZX and other business units. Champion shared components, consistent workflows, and reusable approaches that strengthen the platform and avoid duplicative development.

**Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)**

**Job Description:**

Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

**The opportunity:**

* Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
* Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
* Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver SafeSend. Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
* Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy. Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer[CH1]
* Componentize the portfolio. Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
* Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration. Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel. Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.  

**What success looks like:**

* Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
* The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
* Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
* A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
* Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
* Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
* Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-pro

Bruno is the local-first, Git-native API client trusted by more than 4 million developers worldwide. From startups to Fortune 500 companies, engineering teams use Bruno to build, test, and collaborate on APIs without the complexity, cost, or security concerns of cloud-first tools.

We're looking for a product leader who is still a builder at heart.

Someone who has strong opinions about what makes a great developer product, understands the technical details behind it, and enjoys working closely with engineers to bring ideas to life.

You'll lead Bruno's product direction, work closely with the founders and engineering leadership, and develop a growing team of Product Managers.

jobs.title: Director of Product Strategy, Commerce
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

We are looking for a **Director of Product Strategy, Commerce** to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

* Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
* Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
* Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM SAM capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
* Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
* Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
* Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Plaud is building the real-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 2,500,000 users worldwide since 2023. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity.

Plaud Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated, San Francisco-based company pushing the boundary of human–AI intelligence through a hardware–software combination. Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think.

* Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $250M revenue run rate achieved in just three years.
* Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction.
* Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion.
* Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success.
* Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development.
* Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere.

**About the role**

Plaud is looking for a leader to run global product marketing for our ecosystem of AI hardware and software. You'll own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market across every launch, connecting product truth to brand narrative at global scale.

* 10+ years in product marketing, including 5+ years leading a PMM team of 5 or more at a consumer tech, AI, or hardware company
* Ownership of at least two full hardware or hardware-plus-software launch cycles, end to end (not campaign support), from positioning through day-one conversion surfaces and sustain
* Experience positioning products in a category under active competitive attack, with real counter-positioning discipline rather than category-leader messaging alone
* Experience managing PMM across multiple markets with regional activation partners, and building messaging system

jobs.title: Product Manager, Business Systems
jobs.desc:
Who We Are

KeepTruckin builds technology using the latest advancements in AI and computer vision to improve the safety and efficiency of businesses with vehicles. Over one million drivers and 100,000 companies across every industry trust KeepTruckin’s integrated platform to power their operations, prevent accidents and reduce costs.  

At KeepTruckin, we see our hard work rewarded in tangible ways every day, and we believe that intelligence is most powerful when paired with humility. We’re motivated by the opportunity to save lives on the road while impacting and improving every facet of multiple trillion-dollar industries that keep our physical economy moving. KeepTruckin is proud to be a Forbes Cloud 100 company, Forbes Best Startup Employer 2020, and an Inc Magazine Best Place to Work.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Relentlessly improve the efficiency, scalability and reliability of our Lead-to-Cash systems and business workflows.
  • Be the subject matter expert by partnering with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Order Management and other stakeholders to deeply understand their business needs, prioritize them against overall business goals, and provide architectural and technical design inputs
  • Define vision, strategy, and multi-year product roadmaps for Lead-to-Cash systems and workflows. 
  • Drive strategic initiatives for Lead-to-Cash systems and workflows.
  • Draft design documents, gather requirements, build test and deployment plans, manage communications, and own initiatives from inception through rollout.
  • Collaborate closely with Salesforce Systems Administration, Development, Quality Assurance and Support teams to build, configure, test and release systems changes in a timely manner and with the highest quality.

What We're Looking For:

  • Deep understanding of Lead-to-Cash business processes and systems related to Marketing, CRM (Salesforce ecosystem), CPQ (Salesforce), Billing (Zuora), ERP applications (Netsuite), and Order Management.
  • 5+ years of experience designing solutions and building requirements for CRM, CPQ and ERP platforms that translate into low friction and high impact business processes.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience with Salesforce with Admin certification
  • Experience with applications such as LeanData, Gainsight, CPQ, SalesLoft, Genesys, DocuSign preferred
  • Experience working with Leadership in technical/developer/business communities
  • Understanding of best practices and processes in Agile 
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills to set up and interpret logic, data tables, and rule relationships.
  • Ability to explain complex systems and technical topics in a clear and concise manner using written visual and oral communications.
  • Outstanding emotional intelligence, people skills, self-awareness, and team focus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferably in computer science, information systems or related fields.
  • Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of KeepTruckin's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Rovo
jobs.loc: Flexible / Remote, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

We are seeking a Product Manager with a passion for AI-powered conversational experiences and a track record of building intelligent, scalable SaaS products. This role will focus on driving the vision, strategy, and execution of Rovo Chat, Atlassian's AI-driven conversational interface that helps teams discover knowledge, take action, and work smarter across their entire digital workplace.

You will be part of the Central AI team and will play an important role in shaping how millions of users interact with AI across Atlassian's product suite. Your core responsibilities will be as follows:

  1. Strategic Vision and Roadmap

    • Contribute to and execute the product vision and roadmap for Rovo Chat, aligning with Atlassian's AI strategy and user needs.
    • Identify and prioritize opportunities to grow Chat adoption and engagement (MAU), balancing user value with measurable business outcomes.
  2. Conversational AI Experiences

    • Drive the development of intelligent chat experiences that connect users to knowledge across first-party (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) and third-party (Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Salesforce, etc.) sources.
    • Advance multi-turn conversation quality, context awareness, memory, and proactive assistance.
  3. Cross-Functional Execution

    • Partner with engineering, design, data science, GTM, and enterprise teams to deliver features from ideation through launch and iteration.
    • Operate with program-level rigor: run shiprooms, manage action items, and hold teams accountable to deadlines and quality bars.
  4. Quality, Trust, and Measurement

    • Define and monitor success metrics for Chat quality (accuracy, groundedness, user satisfaction) and adoption.
    • Champion responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, transparent, and inclusive conversational experiences.


At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role:

As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Source, scope, execute, and present analyses for your product team, working independently from question to recommendation.
  • Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance.
  • Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses.
  • Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation.
  • Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics 
  • Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis.
  • Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar).
  • Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State).

Travel Expectations:
We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:
Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Mail-In Blood Testing
jobs.desc:
About SiPhox Health

SiPhox Health is building the leading home testing platform for biomarkers across inflammation, hormones, and metabolic and cardiovascular health. Six in ten Americans live with a chronic disease, and our mission is to make early detection possible from home.

We operate two business lines, both scaling quickly:

  1. Mail-in blood testing: Growing more than 50% quarter over quarter, and the most comprehensive and highly rated at-home blood testing available today.
  2. At-home blood testing device: Planned launch in 2027. Our chip-based module combines biochemistry with integrated photonics, electronics, and microfluidics, protected by more than 50 patents.

SiPhox is an MIT startup backed by Tier I investors including Y Combinator, Khosla Ventures, and Intel Capital.

The Role

This is not a product-maintenance role. It is a role defined by urgency, ownership, and consequence.

We build and deliver a physical product to customers' homes. It is filled with their blood, processed by laboratories under regulatory scrutiny, and returned as a result on which they will base real health decisions.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the full product lifecycle, execution and quality, who moves decisively under pressure, and who is willing to implement a practical solution now rather than wait for a perfect one later. Candidates who require a fully mature organization, established handoffs, and a documented procedure for every situation will not find that here. The ideal candidate is prepared to build those systems while the operation runs at full speed.Areas of Ownership

Product ownership, mail-in blood testing

The product is both the physical kit and the digital results experience. You own both.

  • Own the product end to end: kit design, sample collection, return logistics, lab processing, results delivery
  • Own the digital results experience, portal and app, as a core surface, not a SW hand-off
  • Own design, build quality, cost, and customer experience across kit and software
  • Execute launches and modifications with clinical, operations, and SW development
  • Deliver new kit variants for e-commerce and B2B channels, drive continuous improvement

Product strategy and GTM, mail-in blood testing

  • Own the product roadmap
  • Run continuous customer development and drive product-market-fit improvements
  • Partner with e-commerce and B2B teams to optimize GTM and find new channels

Retention and Retention

  • Identify churn reasons; improve retention with targeted, cross-functional initiatives
  • Guarantee results are accurate and delivered on time; this standard is non-negotiable
  • Ensure products and processes meet CLIA/CAP, HIPAA, and FDA / laboratory-developed-test requirements
  • Move fast within those regulatory guardrails, not around them

Process and Metrics

  • Track sample success / redraw rate, and other drivers of delay, cost, and churn
  • Own it as a product problem: collection device, instructions, packaging
  • Track activation / completion rate: ordered, sample returned, result delivered
  • Continuously identify and eliminate bottlenecks to improve efficiency and scalability

Vendors and Partners

  • Co-own manufacturing and lab relationships; hold partners to commitments and replace them when they fall short
  • Initiate new partnerships to expand the testing menu and customer experience

Team and Collaboration

  • Develop the support team through training, feedback, and clear guidance
  • Collaborate across marketing, operations, R

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About David AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

About our Technical Product Manager team

Our Technical Product Manager team builds the Data Factory at David AI. We set the strategy for how raw audio becomes high-quality training data, decide what gets built, and own the outcomes: scale, quality, cost, and the experience of our contributors. Working across Operations, Engineering, and Research, we move fluidly across all three to solve some of the most challenging problems at David AI.

About this role

David AI is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own a core part of our Data Factory, from early prototypes through production scale. Depending on your background and where we need you most, that could cover our contributor marketplace, our Operations infrastructure, a new or scaling business unit, or the systems our ML team relies on. You'll need the operational chops to lead complex efforts, the instinct to automate them, the technical ability to build the first MVP yourself, and the judgment to partner with engineering and research to implement at scale.

In this role, you will

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for your area of the Data Factory, from 0→1 prototypes through scaled production systems.

  • Lead complex operational efforts and design the workflows and automation that let them scale.

  • Build the first version yourself—scripts, queries, dashboards, and prototypes—then partner with engineering to implement it at scale.

  • Translate the model capabilities our customers care about into concrete workflows, requirements, and project plans.

  • Partner with Operations, Engineering, and Research to focus the team on the most important problems and take new systems from idea to deployment.

  • Use data to guide decision making, diagnose issues, and measure performance against throughput, quality, and cost.

  • Know when to move fast and when to slow down for alignment, with a bias for rapid prototyping.

  • Take full-stack accountability across product, operations, engineering, and customers, solving bottlenecks and ensuring delivery.

Your background looks like

  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or another technical / STEM field, or comparable work experience.

  • 2-8 years of experience in product, operations, consulting, or startup environments.

  • Direct experience as a product manager, technical program manager, founder, or technical operator accountable for outcomes.

  • Highly proficient in SQL and able to develop lightweight prototypes end-to-end.

  • A track record of building your own tools in operationally complex roles, or of taking a messy business problem from data foundation through analysis to implementation.

  • Systems thinker who can spo

Why MailerLite?

  • You'll turn big ideas into reality
    With ambitious plans for our product and team, you'll play a key role in making them happen—solving exciting challenges and driving changes that keep our own product-engineering teams stay fast and reliable, and our customers successful.

Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers.

We’re an applied AI company focused on one of the hardest problems in enterprise technology: rewriting complex legacy systems in a way that is provably correct, low risk, and fast enough to matter. By focusing on system behavior rather than code alone, we turn modernization from a high-stakes, failure-prone effort into a repeatable, confidence-building process that unlocks ongoing innovation.

Joining Mechanical Orchard means working on problems that truly matter—to our customers, their businesses, and the people who rely on these systems every day. We’re building technology and methodology that challenge long-standing industry assumptions, prioritizing proof over promises and progress over theatrics. If you care deeply about quality, rigor, and doing the right thing—even when it’s hard—you’ll find your people here.

We’re seeking a Product Manager to lead our Code Generation team — a critical pillar of our modernization platform. In this role, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how AI-powered code generation accelerates large-scale legacy modernization. You will work closely with forward-deployed engineering teams and customers to deeply understand real-world modernization challenges and translate them into product capabilities that deliver measurable impact. jobs.desc:
Who are we?

We're Bee Talents, an IT recruitment agency that has been helping clients from all around the world in building their technical teams since 2015. Currently we have a great pleasure of working as an exclusive RPO provider for Gcore and we would like to invite you to participate in the recruitment process for Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert).


Company Description

This position is available only under an employment (labor) agreement. 

The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world. 
We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe. 

You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime. 

Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry?  Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem. 

We are currently looking for a Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert), a Data-Driven Growth Partner for our Platform team. Your focus is our Self-Service funnel. We have a powerful cloud platform where users can register, pay, and launch infrastructure on their own. Your job is to analyze their journey in Mixpanel, find friction points, and help us increase Activation and Revenue.

Job description

You will work in a cross-functional setup:

    • Daily collaboration: You will work side-by-side with our Digital Director, as well as Backend and Frontend Developers, Product Managers and the UX/Design team, helping them prioritize features based on data.
    • Reporting: You will be structurally part of our BI (Business Intelligence) team, ensuring you have professional support and access to our data infrastructure. However, you will be embedded in the Platform team, working directly with the Digital Director on a daily basis.

What You'll Do:

    • Self-Service Optimization: Deep dive into the registration → activation → payment flow. Identify where users drop off and propose A/B tests to fix it.
    • Product Qualified Leads (PQL): Analyze usage patterns to identify high-potential customers (e.g., "This startup just spun up 50 GPUs") and signal our Sales team to engage them.

================================================================================

ABOUT HITPAY

================================================================================

HitPay is the payments and business operations platform for small and medium

businesses across Southeast Asia and beyond. We process card, e-wallet, bank

transfer, PayNow, QR and card-present payments for tens of thousands of

merchants across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Australia and

the United States — through a single onboarding flow, a single dashboard, and a

single API.

Payments is a regulated business. We hold a Major Payment Institution licence

from the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under a spread of local

regimes, scheme rules and partner-bank obligations. Today, most of our risk,

fraud and AML capability exists to keep us safe. We believe a meaningful share

of it should also be a product our merchants pay for.

That is the job.

================================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================================

You will own risk, fraud and compliance as a product line — not as a cost

centre. You are being hired to design, build and ship products that reduce loss,

shorten onboarding, and generate revenue: fraud screening our merchants opt into,

chargeback and dispute tooling they will pay for, underwriting and KYB

capabilities we can sell or embed, monitoring and reporting our larger merchants

and platform partners need in order to grow on us.

This is a builder's role with a regulator's discipline. You will spend your week

between a compliance officer, a backend engineer and a merchant, and you will be

the person who can hold all three conversations without a translator.

================================================================================

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

================================================================================

Revenue products

  • Define, price and ship monetisable risk and fraud products: fraud scoring

    and screening tiers, chargeback protection and representment tooling,

    dispute automation, merchant-facing risk dashboards, KYB / identity

    verification as a paid capability, and risk services for platform and

    marketplace partners.

  • Build the commercial case: attach rate, pricing model, loss economics,

    payback. Own the P&L logic of what you ship, not just the roadmap.

  • Work with Sales and Partnerships to take these products to market — you will

    be in customer calls, and you will lose some of them and learn why.

Compliance and risk engineering

  • Own the product surface of transaction monitoring, sanctions and PEP

    screening, merchant onboarding and KYB, prohibited-industry and MCC policy

    enforcement, and chargeback and fraud loss controls.

  • Turn regulatory obligations and internal policy into shipped system

    behaviour: rules, thresholds, queues, audit trails, evidence packs,

    escalation paths and reporting.

  • Drive rule tuning and alert quality as a product metric. False positive

    rate, analyst minutes per alert and precision at the top of the queue are

    yours to move.

  • Evaluate, integrate and manage third-party vendors — fraud engines,

    screening providers, device intelligence, identity — including build vs.

    buy calls and commercial negotiation support.

Stakeholder leadership

  • Be the trusted counterpart to the Compliance and MLRO function. You will not

    ship around them, and they will not be surprised by what you ship.

jobs.title: 1st Product Manager
jobs.desc:
The company

Ooak Data turns company data into training data for AI agents.

Frontier labs can train models to reason. They cannot train them to work: navigating a real company's Slack threads, half-finished Notion docs, contradictory Jira tickets, and permission boundaries. That requires real enterprise data, and you cannot synthesize it. You have to source it.

We plug into enterprise tools, anonymize everything into a structurally identical digital twin, and generate reinforcement-learning environments with expert-level tasks calibrated against frontier models.

We are a Y Combinator company with 7 figures signed contracts with three frontier AI labs, and we are scaling delivery aggressively over the next twelve months. Three founders, full-time since December 2025: Pierre-Louis (CEO, ex-COO in edtech, sold data to frontier labs), Grégoire (CPO, first PM & head of Ops at Epsor through Series B), Thomas (CTO, ex-Head of Data at PayLead, ex-Samsung AI lab).

Why this role exists

Our engineering team ships faster than founders can specify. We have four product surfaces, most of them internal, all of them technical, and every one of them decides whether an environment ships this week or next.

We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the product: what gets built, in what order, and whether it actually made us faster.

What you will own

The full chain, from the moment a CEO agrees to share their data to the moment a frontier lab receives an environment.

Partner experience

  • The Data Hub, onboarding and export tutorials a CEO sees when they hand us their company's history. Trust and speed at the top of the funnel.

The data pipeline

  • Connectors, ingestion and anonymisation. How raw Slack, Drive, mail and CRM exports become a clean digital twin. You will spend a lot of time with Thomas (CTO) here.

Pharos, our delivery platform

  • The internal tool our Ops team lives in to run QA and delivery. Throughput is the metric. This is where 3 env a week becomes 10.

RL environments

  • The thing the labs buy. Task design, calibration, what separates a dataset from a real agent training ground.

You will run two kinds of work at once: short projects that need tight coordination across Tech, Ops and GTM this week, and long ones where nothing exists yet and you get to decide what should.

Who you are

  • A doer. You know the product methodologies and you use them when they help, not by the book. Your instinct when something is slow is to fix it, not to schedule a workshop about it.
  • AI-pilled. You vibe code. You prototype before you write a spec. You design your own mockups. You are curious about how the models themselves are built and trained.
  • UX taste, ROI brain. Our workflows have to be brutally efficient. You judge a piece of software or a workflow by efficient it allows us to be or what value it brings to our customers.
  • You keep pace. Our engineers ship a lot. You turn that into something coherent rather than slowing it down.
  • 7+ years in product, at least some of it technical: data, infra, ML, developer tools or ops platforms. Founders and first PMs who built the function from nothing are very welcome.
  • Fluent French and English. Our customers are American, our data partners spread worldwide, our team speaks both.
  • Based in Paris.

The extra that make the difference

  • A research streak: you read papers, you have opinions on RL, you have trained or fine-tuned something.

Terms

  • Compensation: €70-90k + bonus, and 0.2% to 0.5%

About Pasito

Pasito is the AI workspace for employee benefits.

We’re rethinking how group insurance and benefits are underwritten, delivered, used and measured - by the people who design them and the people who depend on them. Instead of static PDFs, disconnected systems, and manual workflows, Pasito brings plan design, payroll and benefits data, claims, and financial context into a single, AI‑native workspace that helps benefits actually work for the 178 million Americans who depend on this system.

We don’t build for brokers, carriers and employers - we build with them. That collaboration shows up in everything we ship: AI agents that extract and structure plan data, tools that turn complexity into clarity for employees, and workflows that save carriers and consultants hundreds of hours per case.

Today, Pasito supports many of the largest insurance carriers and brokers in the U.S. We’re backed by Y Combinator and Core Innovation Capital, and we’re growing quickly. We ship fast, iterate relentlessly, and care deeply about building systems that are accurate, scalable, and human.

If you’re excited to work alongside exceptional operators and engineers, and apply AI in a legacy industry where precision and trust matter, Pasito is the place for you.

The Role

We’re hiring a Product Owner to own and drive the development of key products at Pasito, including our broker and carrier enrollment workbench and AI Extractions and plan processing products. 

This role sits at the center of the company, bridging customer needs and technical execution. You will report to the VP of Product & Data and take full ownership of the product and feature lifecycle for your areas, from idea to launch and beyond.

Own communication and rollout

  • Partner with Marketing to clearly communicate product updates and launches

Enable internal teams

  • Act as the internal expert for your product areas

**The role**

Allocortech does not need a backlog janitor. We need someone who understands why four-quadrant FOC, voltage class, SWaP-C, and certification timeline are the product — and can turn that into a roadmap OEMs will buy.

Taurus motor controllers, Clio power/comms hubs, and the surrounding battery/PDU work already power eVTOL, hybrid cargo aircraft, and electric hydrofoils. Your job is to productize that stack.

**What you will do**

* Own the propulsion backlog: Taurus variants, voltage/power SKUs, firmware feature flags, packaging, accessories.
* Sit with EE, FOC firmware, and customers and turn “400 V, regen, eight-week MOTS” into sequenced work.
* Write requirements hardware and firmware can actually build. Kill nice-to-haves that blow SWaP or schedule.
* Partner with sales on positioning, spec sheets, and which custom asks become catalog.
* Keep the 18-month versus 24-month product bets honest.

Joining our team means embracing a fast-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you.

Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Brief Summary of Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll own a meaningful product area end-to-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve.

You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned.
* **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building.

Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

jobs.desc:
**The Opportunity**

Caraway’s Digital Product team is responsible for delivering a best-in-class e-commerce experience. We’re looking for a Digital Product Manager to own our onsite experimentation program and drive product improvements that increase conversion and generate incremental revenue, from identifying opportunities through testing and shipping improvements.

Reporting to the Director of Digital Product, you’ll shape the customer experience across product detail pages (PDPs), cart, checkout, homepage, landing pages, and PLPs.
