* Translate product direction into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, success measures, and sequenced delivery plans.
* Own the site experimentation roadmap, using funnel analysis, customer feedback, and behavioral insights to identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Manage Digital Product intake across stakeholder requests, bugs, launch needs, optimization ideas, technical debt, and roadmap opportunities.
* Own backlog grooming, sprint planning, delivery follow-up, release readiness, and post-launch reviews for assigned workstreams.

Experimentation & Technical Execution

* Partner with Engineering and Design to assess feasibility, sequence work, manage tradeoffs, and resolve delivery blockers.
* Manage delivery from scoping through launch, balancing experiments with conversion-critical bugs and site improvements.
* Own QA across variants, devices, responsive layouts, cart and checkout behavior, and tracking. Partner with Engineering on feasibility, performance, release readiness, and rollback plans.
* Use HTML, CSS, and browser developer tools to inspect onsite experiences, troubleshoot issues, and make targeted changes within approved tools.
* Turn results into decisions to ship, iterate, or stop; coordinate permanent implementation and post-launch validation, keeping partners aligned on tradeoffs and next steps.

Onsite Personalization & Segmentation

* Own and expand onsite personalization and segmentation logic, including new versus returning visitors and traffic source.
* Partner with Growth, Merchandising, Creative, and UX on audience-specific content and experiences, with clear targeting rules, exclusions, and fallback behavior.
* Validate targeting and measure incremental impact through controlled testing where feasible.

Measurement & Reporting

* Partner with Analytics and Growth to establish trusted metric definitions, tracking, funnels, and dashboards before launch.
* Define sample size, test duration, success criteria, and guardrails for experiments. Apply sound statistical judgment and account for overlapping tests, promotions, and data-quality issues to prevent false positives.
* Deliver a monthly readout connecting experiment outcomes to estimated incremental revenue, including assumptions, uncertainty, rollout status, and learnings.
* Distinguish observed results from projected impact, avoid double-counting gains, and use post-launch performance to inform future product decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customer insights and business priorities translate into a focused roadmap and clear product decisions.

* Experiments and features launch with strong QA, reliable tracking, and clear ownership.
* Results and learnings inform future work, including when to stop or change direction.

jobs.desc:
**Location:** Camas, WA / Hybrid  
**Department:** Product  
**Reports To:** Founder & CEO / Executive Leadership

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Compensation:** Competitive salary based on experience  
**Benefits:** Healthcare benefits and a company-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan

**About Synkwise**

Synkwise is a rapidly growing healthcare SaaS company dedicated to improving how residential long-term care providers operate and deliver care. Our platform helps adult family homes, assisted living communities, memory care providers, and other residential care organizations simplify daily operations, strengthen compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve care quality.

We are building a mission-driven company grounded in integrity, innovation, accountability, thoughtful product design, and exceptional customer experience.

As Synkwise continues to grow nationally and expand our platform’s capabilities, we are looking for an experienced product leader to help us accelerate our offering.

**About the Opportunity**

Synkwise is hiring a full-time Senior Product Manager to help shape and guide the continued evolution of our platform. This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between product strategy, customer needs, UI/UX, business requirements, technical specs, and engineering execution.

We are looking for a strong product thinker and operator who can understand a real-world problem, translate the solution into clear requirements, and work closely with design and engineering to carry it through release.

The right candidate will understand that great product management starts with understanding the user, use case, and underlying problem, not simply implementing feature requests.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead product initiatives from early discovery through design, development, testing, and release
* Keep Jira fully functioning and moving…enough said
* Turn complex customer and business problems into clear epics, workflows, and actionable requirements
* Understand who we’re building for and keep their real-world needs at the center of product decisions
* Partner closely with design and engineering to create intuitive, consistent, and scalable product experiences
* Spot unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, and potential usability issues before they reach development
* Bring structure and momentum to backlog refinement, sprint planning, product reviews, and retrospectives
* Gather insights from customers and teams across Customer Success, Sales, Clinical, Compliance, and Engineering
* Evaluate opportunities based on customer impact, feasibility, and long-term strategic value
* Create practical SOPs and product documentation that people can actually understand and use
* Write clear, customer-friendly release notes that explain what changed and why it matters

**Building Products for What’s Next**

We believe AI is changing how great products are imagined, tested, and built. We’re looking for someone who is excited to help us take advantage of that shift.

You’ll use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Figma, Jira, GitHub, and AI-assisted prototyping platforms to explore ideas, sharpen requirements, accelerate research, and collaborate more effectively with design and engineering.

You don’t need to be an expert in every tool. You do need to be curious and willing to experiment with better ways of working.

Most importantly, we believe AI should strengthen human judgment, not replace it. Great product development still begins with understanding customers, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and knowing which problems are truly worth solving.

**Job Context**

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager who is excited about building and delivering AI-powered products that create real business impact. This role goes beyond traditional product management: you will own not only the roadmap, but also the outcomes. You’ll work at the intersection of AI capabilities, customer needs, and business strategy to deliver products that meaningfully improve how our customers operate.  
The ideal candidate is deeply curious about AI, enthusiastic about applying it to real-world problems, and motivated by measurable results. You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and energized by building in a fast-moving environment.

**What You’ll Do**

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept to launch to iteration.
* Define and execute the product roadmap aligned with company strategy and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful value for customers and translate them into product initiatives.
* Use experimentation, metrics, and customer feedback to guide product decisions and continuously improve outcomes.
* Champion the use of AI both within the product and internally across workflows.
* Define clear success metrics and be accountable for product performance, adoption, and business impact.
* Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their workflows, problems, and opportunities for AI-driven improvements.
* Move quickly from idea to prototype to production, balancing speed with quality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong interest in AI technologies and their real-world applications.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and motivated to build from scratch.
* Track record of owning outcomes, not just delivering features.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical thinking and ability to make data-informed decisions.
* Passion for learning, experimenting, and pushing the boundaries of what AI can do.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with AI assisted coding (Claude Code, Cursor etc).
* Background in startups or early-stage product environments.
* Experience shipping AI-enabled features or products.

**Why Join Us**

* Build products at the forefront of AI innovation.
* Work with a highly collaborative and ambitious team.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Rapidly growing software company in San Fernando, CA (over 22,562 companies use our GPS tracking software) is looking to add a Product Manager to our team.

Product management is a newer function at our company. Until recently it was handled part-time across engineering, operations, and leadership, and it has outgrown that arrangement. The scope and workflows of the role are still being defined, and you'll have a hand in defining them.

We need someone who can take a project from "we should build this" all the way to "customers are using it and understand it": talking to the right people, getting the requirements right before engineering starts building, and seeing it through to launch.

If helping shape a role rather than stepping into a fully mapped-out one sounds exciting, keep reading. If you'd rather join an established product org with a playbook already written, this probably isn't the role for you.

**What You'll Own**

Every project you take on, you own end to end:

* Discovery and requirements. Sit with support, sales, operations, and customers directly. Understand the real-world task the customer is trying to complete, break it into steps, and turn those steps into features and functional requirements. Produce wireframes that show how the workflow will look on screen.
* Tickets engineering can actually build from. Write well-formed Jira tickets with clear acceptance criteria and data requirements: what's displayed live in the UI, and what needs to be stored for later reporting.
* Keeping projects moving. Coordinate with engineering leadership, design, and operations to determine where each ticket fits in overall priorities. Work with engineers on estimates, own the project timeline, make scope trade-offs to hit dates, and surface risks and slips early rather than late. Monitor tickets so nothing sits waiting for a decision that nobody knows they need to make.
* UX quality. Make sure the user can complete the task in the order they naturally think about it, and that information on screen is clear and legible.
* Testing before and after release. Test on staging and production. Find the bugs, the lag, the rough edges, and document exactly what needs to change. Retest until it feels production-ready.
* Internal rollout and training. Write up how each release works, train internal staff, and be the go-to person for questions. Coordinate staff testing of new features and channel that feedback back to engineering.
* Launch. Draft customer-facing announcements and coordinate final release timing with the development team.

Discovery, requirements, and keeping projects moving are the core of the job. Testing, internal training, and launch communications are also part of it, because on a small team the person who owns a feature sees it all the way through; if those parts sound like a chore rather than part of shipping well, please don't apply.

**The Technical Bar**

You don't need to write code. You do need to be able to hold a productive conversation with an engineer about what's possible, what's hard, and what the trade-offs are, and you need to understand why something that sounds like a simple feature may actually be difficult. You should be comfortable looking at how the application behaves and at its data model well enough to specify what should be shown on screen versus stored for reporting.

Our product is GPS fleet tracking, which means physical devices in vehicles, firmware, cellular connectivity, and a lot of data arriving in near real time. Prior experience with a product that includes hardware or devices is a real plus.

Our stack, for context: Golang and MySQL on the server, Vue.js on the web, Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) for mobile, on AWS.

**Ramp-up and the 60-day review**

Nobody expects you to know our system on day one. Your first weeks will be spent learning the product alongside support and operations before you take ownership of a project.

### **About the Role**

HelpGrid is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our growing Product team.

We’re particularly interested in someone who understands how to build products that drive engagement, participation, performance, and retention across flexible workforces. Experience with gamification, rewards, incentives, or behavioral design is highly relevant.

This is a hands-on role for a product thinker who can turn ambiguous problems into scalable solutions, balancing user needs, business goals, data, and technology to deliver measurable impact.

You’ll work closely with Product leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, prioritize solutions, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand business and user problems and translate them into clear product opportunities.
* Conduct discovery, research, and analysis to identify and validate potential solutions.
* Challenge assumptions and contribute ideas that improve the product and the broader business.
* Balance user needs, business priorities, technical considerations, and scalability when making product decisions.

### **Product Ownership & Delivery**

* Own product initiatives from discovery through development, launch, and iteration.
* Define requirements, workflows, and priorities in collaboration with Product and Engineering.
* Create clear documentation and ensure teams have the context needed to execute effectively.
* Identify dependencies, edge cases, and potential risks before and during development.
* Monitor progress and adjust priorities as business needs evolve.

### **User Experience**

* Advocate for simple, intuitive experiences that help users accomplish their goals.
* Translate user needs and behaviors into practical product and UX decisions.
* Work closely with design and development teams to ensure solutions are both useful and feasible.

### **Data & Product Insights**

* Use data and qualitative feedback to understand problems and inform decisions.
* Define meaningful measures of product performance and evaluate outcomes after launch.
* Use insights to identify opportunities for improvement and future iterations.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs clearly.
* Keep initiatives moving in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Product initiatives move from ideas to well-defined, scalable solutions.
* Business and user problems are translated into clear product requirements and priorities.
* Product decisions are informed by data, research, and sound judgment.
* Teams have the clarity and direction needed to execute effectively.
* Products continuously improve based on user feedback and measurable outcomes.
* You become a trusted product partner who can independently drive meaningful initiatives forward.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* 2–3+ years of experience in Product Management or a closely related product role.
* Experience owning product initiatives from discovery through delivery.

Own the Product Backlog and Roadmap

Partner with Manufacturing Stakeholders

Lead Agile Product Delivery

Define Quality and Performance Criteria

* Define false-positive and false-negative thresholds based on manufacturing requirements.
* Support inspection strategies for applications and critical vehicle build verification.

Guide Deployment and Production Validation

* Coordinate with plant and technical teams to verify that solutions are ready for production deployment.

Measure Results and Drive Continuous Improvement

* Establish, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators, including:
* First-time-through quality

Enable Adoption and Operational Readiness

* Support the creation of standard operating procedures and operational documentation.
Coordinate training for line operators, plant quality leads, and controls technicians.

We're a Series A startup building an AI-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. **About the Role**  
Corporate teams spend billions every year on business entertainment, dinners, events, client experiences, and almost none of it runs through purpose-built software. At the center of our platform are AI agents that do real work for our customers: agents that carry multi-step, high-stakes workflows through to completion, with real money and real relationships on the line. We're looking for a PM to own these agentic experiences. There's no established playbook for this work; the patterns for running agents in production are being figured out in real time, by a small number of teams, and we're one of the teams doing the inventing. You'll own how our agents behave, how their quality is measured and improved, and how the system earns the trust to take on more. AI isn't a feature we bolted on, it's the foundation of our product and how we run the company: we automate what can be automated so people spend their time on judgment, not busywork. As a PM here, you'll prototype ideas yourself, get answers from data without waiting on anyone, and ship faster than you're probably used to.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end experience our customers have with our AI agents, from first interaction to completed outcome
* Own agent quality as a product: evaluation frameworks, review loops, and the metrics that define "good" for a production agent
* Own the division of labor between agents and people, where automation earns more autonomy, and where human judgment stays in the workflow
* Own the improvement engine: the feedback loops and mechanisms that make agents measurably better every week, at growing volume
* Define, prioritize, and execute the roadmap for our agentic product experiences
* Go deep in the mechanics: prompt and context engineering, evals, failure analysis; you'll read transcripts, find patterns, and turn them into product decisions
* Partner with engineering to ship improvements fast, and build the tooling that makes quality visible and measurable
* Work closely with the operations teams whose workflows interlock with the agents; they're part of your product surface
* Coordinate with PMs across the product group, since the agents touch nearly every part of the customer journey
* Track the frontier: new patterns, research, and techniques emerge weekly in this space, and part of your job is knowing what's real, what's noise, and what we should try next

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, including hands-on work shipping agentic workflows
* Fluency in the patterns of production agentic systems, things like escalation and handoff design, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, feedback loops, and eval-driven development, and the judgment to know which pattern fits which problem

**About Mariana Minerals**
==========================

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

**The Role**
============

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. Our data systems don't live in a vacuum — they feed process simulators, drive site automation, and are the substrate the business runs its decisions on.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to be the single product owner for the data engineering family — the data platform, analytics, data science, and the AI and agentic workflows built on top of them. Today this work is spread across technical leads and absorbed informally, with no one setting direction across the whole. Your job is to change that: decide what the data organization builds and why, get stakeholders aligned behind it, and make sure engineers can stay heads-down on the work that matters.

This is a hybrid Pioneer/Settler role: you'll get lightweight demos and PoCs built on ambiguous problems, and you'll bring order and cohesive ownership to data work streams that already exist. You'll prioritize ruthlessly and visibly — being explicit about what will not be worked on — and set direction rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Talk to our internal teams constantly — operators, machine learning engineers, software developers, analysts, and data users are your users, and their problems set the roadmap.
* Own the roadmap for the data platform, analytics, and data science tooling: what gets built next, for whom, and why.
* Write the product specs, KPIs, and success metrics that turn ambiguous asks into scoped, shippable work.
* Own prioritization and stakeholder alignment so engineers stay focused on deep technical work.
* Make the build-vs-buy calls for BI and analytics, and prioritize tooling that lets stakeholders answer their own questions instead of adding headcount.
* Own where agents fit versus conventional software, and drive AI and agentic workflows from demo to adopted tool.
* Decide which new data streams get integrated, when, and to what standard as new sensors and sources come online.
* Set the bar for what "supported" and "correct" mean as tools graduate from scripts and spreadsheets, and be explicit about what won't be migrated.

**How You'll Operate**
======================

* **Structure from ambiguity:** Bring direction to cross-disciplinary initiatives and align stakeholders rather than waiting for direction.
* **Ruthless, visible prioritization:** Be explicit about what will not be worked on, not just what will.
* **Hybrid Pioneer/Settler:** Get initial prototypes built with stakeholders, then write the roadmap to validate the use case and, if worth it, take it to production.
* **Ecosystem fluency:** Understand where Mariana's data sits relative to the systems that consume it and relative to the current frontier of LLM capability, so prioritization calls stay well-calibrated.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must have**

* 4–8+ years in technical product management, data platform or analytics product roles, or equivalent experience leading cross-disciplinary technical programs
* Comfortable being the only PM in a highly technical room — you know when to drive a decision, when to defer to engineers, and how to build credibility without being the most technical person there
* Enough depth in data infrastructure and analytics to earn credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts, and to know when a technical answer is a good one
* Working fluency with the current LLM/foundation-model landscape and whe

jobs.title: Manager, Product Telemetry Lead
jobs.desc:
**About the role:**

LSEG Analytics has been trusted for over 30 years by portfolio managers, risk teams and quantitative analysts. These clients want to access analytics where they're already working. This happens in spreadsheets, notebooks, BI dashboards, automated workflows and increasingly in AI assistants and agents.

Every one of those interactions is evidence: what customers actually use, how often, through which surface, and whether it worked. Today that evidence is uneven, which means the teams who build, sell and support our analytics have an incomplete picture of how customers experience them. This role owns closing that gap.

You will lead telemetry strategy across our analytics platform, owning what gets captured at the point of use, what it means, how it is surfaced, and working with the central telemetry team to ensure that the reporting is meaningful and consistent with D&A standards. That spans instrumentation standards, product adoption analytics, the usage evidence that supports commercial decisions, and the reporting our product, commercial and client service teams rely on.

This is a horizontal role. Telemetry cuts across every analytics vertical and every delivery channel, which means broad exposure to the LSEG estate and to the teams behind it.

This is a hands-on role. You will run your own discovery, own your roadmap, work directly with engineering to deliver, and stay accountable for the success of what you ship.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for analytics product telemetry, from instrumentation at the gateway through to the reporting and visualization built on top of it
* Collaborate with product teams to define what gets captured and what it means: the event schema, the identity and entitlement dimensions, and the rules that make usage comparable and actionable across products surfaces
* Partner with the cloud data platform teams who own storage and pipeline, translating product requirements into what the platform needs to capture and retain
* Inform the consumption layer: dashboards, usage reporting and the visualizations that make customer behaviour legible to the teams who act on it
* Turn usage data into an account of the customer experience — where workflows succeed, where they stall, and which surfaces customers are actually choosing
* Run discovery with your internal consumers across product, commercial, client service and engineering, and treat them as customers of what you build
* Hold the line on data quality and consistency, and be the person who can say what a number means and where it came from
* Act as the subject matter expert on usage data for commercial, client service and internal stakeholders
* Track how consumption patterns are changing, particularly agentic and AI-assisted usage, and make sure measurement keeps pace with them
  

**Background Experience/Skills:**

* Product management experience, or an equivalent background owning a platform, data or API product for internal or external consumers
* Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, event data and data structures, and able to hold a credible conversation with engineers. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to read it and be competent with SQL
* A feel for how data gets presented: you can tell the difference between a dashboard people open once and one they use to make decisions
* Data-driven in practice, not just in principle: you define what success looks like before you build, instrument for it, and change course when the evidence says to
* Judgment about measurement itself: you know the difference between a metric that is easy to collect and one that is worth acting on
* Working familiarity with AI tooling and how agentic consumption differs from human consumption
* Experience in financial data and analytics
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization
* Degree or equivalent in: Bachelors Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering/Operations Research

Description:

At CSpring, we believe in the power of data to drive decisions and real-world impact. We’re a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in data strategy, data engineering, and data analytics. Our clients span the public and private sectors, and our work helps them solve complex problems, gain insights, and achieve measurable results.

We're seeking talented professionals who are collaborative, curious, and committed to making a difference that thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy. Whether you're passionate about transforming public programs, enabling executive decision-making, or modernizing legacy systems, you'll find meaningful work and purpose here.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Purposeful Projects** – Improve systems that serve real people by delivering smarter data, streamlined processes, and strategic insight.
* **People-First Culture** – We’re as committed to your growth as we are to delivering high-impact solutions. You’ll find support, autonomy, and community here.
* **Strategic, Hands-On Work** – From data architecture and documentation to client workshops and solution delivery, you’ll influence every step of the process.
* **Collaborative Trust** – Our clients rely on us to listen carefully, deliver consistently, and guide wisely. We partner with integrity, curiosity, and heart.

**What You'll Do**

You'll work with clients to turn their enterprise data vision into a defined, sequenced, and communicated plan of record:

* Own product definition for the data portfolio — reporting and analytics, privacy-by-design, segmentation, predictive models, and the platform capabilities underneath them.
* Maintain the roadmap: a rolling view of what the data team is delivering across the next two to three quarters, kept current, and defensible to any executive who asks why something sits where it does.
* Write the product vision documents, acceptance criteria, and release notes that let engineers build without guessing and let stakeholders know what they are getting.
* Define what success looks like for every product, instrument it, and report on it — usage, adoption by department, time to insight, model performance in production, and the business result it was built to move.

* Run the planning and execution rhythm: monthly planning, standups, and the working agreements that keep a small senior team moving on a Kanban flow.

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.desc:
**Why Wellthy is for you!**

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.  
  
We're building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we're seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what's possible.  
  
Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families' real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, especially around emerging technologies. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.

Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we're building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.

We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.  
  
We're building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we're looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.

**As our Product Manager II**, you will work in a management capacity to shape the future of our product. You will help build and deliver solutions to better support our caregiving members, enable our internal care teams to more efficiently deliver a world-class experience, and showcase the value of our service to our clients. You will lead efforts around product vision, prioritization, and scoping.

**You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer.**

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

* **Product Vision & Strategy:** Owning and championing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning stakeholders and leadership while exercising strong judgment to prioritize what gets built and why.
* **Hands-On Discovery:** Leading a rigorous discovery process by running user interviews, conducting experiments, and analyzing data to uncover insights and validate hypotheses.
* **Execution & Collaboration:** Working side-by-side with engineers, designers, and data professionals to clarify requirements, solve roadblocks, and guide the development of high-impact features.
* **Innovation:** Actively identifying opportunities to leverage AI and other emerging technologies to create a competitive advantage and deliver step-change improvements to the user experience.
* **Ownership & Impact:** Defining success metrics, tracking product performance against key business goals, and taking full ownership of the product lifecycle from launch to sunset.
  

**Qualifications**

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be open to learning, experimenting, and evolving. Comfort with emerging technology and curiosity around how tools like AI can support your workflow or help families more effectively is a plus.

* You are a builder who is energized by learning, experimenting, and evolving. You actively seek to apply emerging technologies, especially AI, to enhance your workflow, build smarter products, and more effectively support the members we serve.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Web
jobs.desc:
**About Us**

Wag! Group Co. strives to be the number one platform to solve the service, product, and wellness needs of the modern U.S. pet household. Wag! pioneered on-demand dog walking in 2015 with the Wag! app, offering access to 5-star dog walking, sitting, and one-on-one training from a community of over 500,000 Pet Caregivers nationwide. Additionally, Wag! Group Co. operates Petted, one of the nation’s largest pet insurance comparison marketplaces; Dog Food Advisor, a leading pet food review platform; WoofWoofTV, reaching over 18 million followers with delightful pet content on social media; and maxbone, a digital platform for modern pet essentials, offering superfoods for dogs and stylish, functional products for today’s pet owners. For more information about our company, visit Wag.co. and wagwalking.com

  

**The Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the Wag! Services web experience end to end. Wag! is a mature two-sided marketplace run with a startup mentality. Our web surface touches both sides of it: the booking funnel where pet parents find caregivers and the onboarding funnel our caregivers apply in. You will own the web roadmap and communicate the strategy and impact to leadership. Day to day, you draft tickets, approve designs, and run the experiments that tell us what to roll out. This is a hands-on role working directly with engineering, design, and analytics. This role is full-time and in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for current or future employment visa sponsorship.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

Booking Funnel and Experimentation

* Own the pet parent web booking funnel from page landing through service completion for new and returning customers
* Run the web A/B testing program end to end
* Find and fix conversion leaks across landing pages, signup, and booking flows

Growth Surfaces

* Own our SEO and marketing pages: page structure, speed, internal linking, and click through rate
* Partner with Marketing on new landing pages and acquisition surface improvements

Caregiver Onboarding Funnel

* Own the caregiver onboarding funnel from sign-up to approved application
* Balance dev resources between supply-side and demand-side work

Core Responsibilities

* Maintain a quarterly roadmap broken into weekly sprints
* Draft PRDs and tickets with requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering
* Leverage dashboards and reports to own daily and weekly performance reporting
* Use AI tools to draft initial designs and prototypes before looping in the designer
* Communicate performance metrics to leadership including funnel conversion rates

  

**Minimum Paw-lifications**

* 3+ years of product management experience on a consumer web product
* Experience owning a web booking or conversion funnel
* Experience running A/B tests end to end, including sizing, instrumentation, and ship/revert decisions
* Comfortable working with data, Excel, and basic BI tool proficiency
* Actively use AI and emerging tools to improve workflows and productivity
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Strong sense of ownership and eagerness to make an impact across teams

* Ability to work in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office

  

**Purr-furred Paw-lifications**

* Working proficiency in SQL
* Experience in a two-sided marketplace
* Experience with a feature-flag or experimentation platform such as Split, LaunchDarkly, or Optimizely
* Familiarity with Snowflake, Mixpanel, or a comparable analytics stack
* SEO and landing page experience, particularly on a large content footprint
* Subscription or membership product experience
* Interest in consumer marketplaces, two-sided platforms, or pet/consumer wellness

  

**Benefits & Purrr-ks**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Complimentary parking on-site at our dow

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Zlayt AI is a litigation automation platform built exclusively for personal injury law. From demand letters and deposition summaries to discovery responses and case analysis, Zlayt equips law firms with intelligent tools that draft faster, think strategically, and deliver results without friction, setup, or compromise.

We're an early-stage, product-led company building the category-defining product for legal AI in a large, underserved niche. This is a rare opportunity to shape what the product becomes — working directly with the founding team, real PI lawyers, and real case data.

**The Role**

Zlayt AI is hiring a Product Manager to own the product from problem to shipped feature. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering to decide what we build, why, and in what order — then make sure it ships and actually works for the lawyers and legal assistants who use it every day.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. There is no product org to step into. You'll be writing the first specs, running the first structured discovery, and setting up how product decisions get made.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the product roadmap: talk to PI lawyers and staff, find the highest-value workflow problems, and turn them into a prioritized plan
* Write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guesswork
* Work hands-on with AI: define how features should behave, test outputs against real legal work product, and set the quality bar for what "good enough to ship" means
* Run discovery and feedback loops with early customers, including Zinda Law Group as the first major client
* Define and track the metrics that show whether a feature is working (adoption, time saved, output quality, retention)
* Operate with significant ambiguity in an early-stage environment, making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting quickly

  

**Who You Are**

* **A builder, not an inheritor:** You've shipped a 0-to-1 software product or major feature as the accountable PM — you know what it takes to build something from nothing, not just run an existing roadmap
* **Technical enough to be dangerous:** You've worked directly with engineers day to day, can read a technical design, and don't need a translator to discuss APIs, data models, or model behavior
* **AI-native:** You've shipped or worked hands-on with LLM or AI-powered features, and you use AI tools yourself to do your own work faster
* **Workflow-obsessed:** You've built software for a demanding professional user — legal, healthcare, finance, or similar — where the details of the workflow decide whether the product gets used
* **Startup-tested:** You've worked in small, fast-moving companies where you had to build process yourself, not step into one that already existed
* **Self-directed:** Your track record shows work you personally drove — not just team results you were adjacent to
* **Experienced but still hands-on:** Roughly 4–10 years of total professional experience, with at least 3 in product management
* **Stable but not stagnant:** A track record of meaningful tenure at each stop, with job changes that make sense (promotions, acquisitions, layoffs, or clear career logic — not a pattern of short stints)

  

**Our Philosophy**

We firmly uphold the value of every individual within our team, ensuring they have the chance to build a rewarding career both financially and personally. Our firm's structure is designed to offer exceptional prospects for growth and advancement. At Zlayt AI, every team member leaves at the end of the day with the satisfaction of knowing they have diligently served our clients and positively impacted the lives of others. Join us and experience a remarkable work environment at our organization!

jobs.desc:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

**Job Overview:**

This is an Assistant Vice President position in Advisor Experience as a product owner for the Personalization and Business Configurator product. As a trusted business partner, you will drive outcomes, lead cross-functional teams, drive strategy and contribute to the deep and thoughtful analysis that enables our leadership team to make informed decisions.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be the subject matter expert on our users and their needs and desires, through customer interviews, product analytics, user feedback sessions, and insight from internal partners
* Define mid-term technology product development roadmap, key features/capabilities, and manage the development cycles with clear schedules, deliverables and milestones
* Develop and monitor metrics to track the success of products and features and inform future iterations
* Work with a diverse group of cross-functional teams to ensure creative and continuous improvements
* Collaborate across the firm to maintain alignment on vision, strategy, and performance to goals, approaching strategy with an entrepreneurial mindset, leveraging critical thinking to increase the value proposition of assigned products and programs
* Work closely with Product Management to create and maintain a vision, road-map, growth opportunities, and product backlog according to business value or ROI
* Lead the planning of product release plans and set the expectation for delivery of new functionalities with PI roadmaps
* Provide an active role in mitigating impediments impacting successful team completion of Release/Sprint Goals
* Set direction for Agile development teams and stakeholders throughout the project and facilitate requirements
* Plan and prioritize product feature backlog and development for the product
* Assess value, develop cases, and prioritize stories, epics and themes to ensure work focuses on those with maximum value that are aligned with product strategy
* Provide backlog management, iteration planning, and elaboration of the user stories
* Research and analyze market, the users, and the roadmap for the product

**What are we looking for?**

We want **strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class client experience**. We are looking for people who thrive in a **fast-paced environment, are client-focused, team oriented**, and are able to execute in a way that encourages **creativity** and **continuous improvement**.

**Requirements:**

* 5-7 years experience hands-on experience with business & systems requirements processes
* 5-7 years of product owner experience or relevant business work experience.
* Bachelor’s or in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or other related fields
* 3-5 years experience in a financial services or wealth management industry

**Core Competencies:**

* Demonstrated experience as Product Lead, Manager or Owner
* Successfully engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Must be comfortable in rapidly changing and sometimes ambiguous work situations.
* Comfortable working independently, adapting to shifting priorities, demands and timelines in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional customer focus with a strong bias for action
* Demonstrated problem solving, organizational and time management skills
* Collaborative team player
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Preferences:**

* Broker dealer, investment bank, or RIA product experience in financial services environment
* Masters Degree preferred
* Experience in Fintech and/or Financial Services

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About GaggleAMP

GaggleAMP helps companies turn employees into active advocates on social media. Our customers run employee advocacy programs that drive brand visibility, sales engagement, and recruiting impact, all with minimal effort from the people involved. We've been at this for years, have real customers, and have a clear point of view about what we do and who we do it for.

Mission

Own product at GaggleAMP so that every feature we ship makes our customers' jobs genuinely easier and proves measurable value to their organizations, applying phase-one discipline and customer evidence to every decision.

Outcomes

We share this scorecard openly so you know exactly what success looks like.

**By day 30:**

* Reviewed at least 20 recorded customer calls and built working knowledge of customer pains and language patterns
* Held one-on-ones with each developer, the engineering lead, the customer success lead, the CEO, and at least two CS team members
* Read and internalized our product principles, persona docs, brand guide, and GTM playbook well enough to apply them in conversation
* Audited the current product backlog, can articulate what's in flight and why, and formed initial opinions on prioritization
* Scoped at least two product optimizations end-to-end (from usage data through a defined solution to engineering handoff)
* Produced a written first-impressions document for the CEO and engineering lead

**By day 90:**

* Shipped at least one meaningful piece of new work that you scoped, designed, and handed off, with engineering buy-in
* Own and run weekly product/design reviews independently
* Produced a roadmap proposal for the upcoming quarter, defined as the full mix of new capability, optimizations to existing flows, and infrastructure work that affects usability. Grounded in customer evidence and our product principles
* Built your own customer conversation cadence (at least two live customer calls per month)
* Reduced senior leadership involvement in feature-level product decisions to near zero
* Made at least one clearly defensible "no" to a feature request, based on principle application rather than capacity

Competencies

**Customer obsession and persona discipline.** Every product decision grounded in real customer evidence, applied to a specific persona, not imagined users.

**Phase-one scoping discipline.** Ship the smallest meaningful version first and let customer feedback drive what comes next. Comfortable cutting scope. Can defend "no" with reasoning.

**Strategic and tactical balance.** Real product work is a mix of new capability, optimizations, and usability-affecting infrastructure, not just new feature delivery. Resist the bias toward shipping new things at the expense of improving what exists.

**AI-leveraged execution with human ownership.** Use AI tools fluently across discovery, writing, design, and analysis. Own every outcome and deliverable as your own work, regardless of which tools helped produce it. AI is leverage, not a substitute for judgment.

**Scrappy execution and self-direction.** Operate without scaffolding. Build your own systems and rhythms. Comfortable with ambiguity. Direct in communication, including with leadership.

**Design fluency (a plus, not required).** Comfortable partnering on UI work and reviewing it against our design system. Hands-on Figma execution is a bonus.

How we work

Small team, fast cadence, customer-driven. You'll partner closely with engineering on a continuous shipping rhythm and have direct CEO engagement on product strategy. You'll own product end-to-end: there's no separate designer, no PM peer, no analyst pulling reports for you. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to.

This role is for builders, not process managers. If you want to talk to customers, make the strategic calls, influence the design of the screens, write the stories, and ship to real people who depend on the product, let's talk.

 **Requirements**  
  
What you'll need

* Five-plus year

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Summary**
  
  
The Product Manager is responsible for supporting the direction, delivery, and ongoing success of assigned Naviam products. This role manages the product roadmap, backlog, requirements, release priorities, and cross-functional coordination for approximately two to three products, ensuring that product execution aligns with company strategy, customer needs, delivery realities, quality expectations, and engineering capacity.  
  
The Product Manager serves as a key collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholders. This role translates business goals, customer feedback, implementation learnings, and market insights into clear product requirements and actionable development priorities. While overall commercial and product strategy is led by senior product leadership, the Product Manager may provide input based on customer discovery, delivery feedback, product usage, and market observations.  
  
Success in this role requires strong communication, practical decision-making, attention to detail, and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, delivery timelines, testing readiness, and product quality in a B2B enterprise software environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the roadmap, backlog, priorities, and product direction for assigned products, typically overseeing two to three products.
* Define, document, and communicate product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities, and product decisions.
* Serve as a primary collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholder teams.
* Work closely with engineering teams during planning, refinement, sprint execution, review, and release activities to support clear prioritization and successful delivery.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance on testing scope, test planning, feature validation, defect review, regression considerations, and release readiness.
* Help ensure new features and product changes are clearly defined, testable, and aligned with expected functionality before release.
* Partner with delivery, implementation, customer solutions, support, and customer-facing teams to gather feedback, identify recurring needs, and ensure product improvements address real-world enterprise use cases.
* Participate in customer, prospect, partner, and internal stakeholder conversations, including sales and delivery discovery calls, to understand needs, explain product direction, and gather feedback for future planning.
* Prioritize product work based on customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical considerations, quality, testing needs, and strategic alignment.
* Support release planning by helping define release scope, communicate planned functionality, review readiness, coordinate stakeholder awareness, and identify unresolved risks or dependencies.
* Maintain product documentation, including product requirements, feature definitions, internal enablement materials, release notes, testing coordination notes, and related product communication.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, delivery, and QA stakeholders to ensure features are usable, technically sound, practical to implement, and sufficiently validated.
* Help identify opportunities for product improvement, operational efficiency, product integration, and better alignment across Naviam’s enterprise software offerings.
* Monitor customer, market, and technology trends relevant to assigned products and use those insights to inform product recommendations and prioritization discussions.
* Support Agile and Scrum-based practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, review, retrospective activities, and ongoing coordination with delivery teams as appropriate.
* Use product management and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar platf

#### Wherever drivers go, we're leading the way. Agero's mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients' relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we're pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

**Note:** **For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.**

The Product Manager leads and executes complex product initiatives focused over the next 3-12 months. Delivers high quality products on time and within budget that meet defined goals for the product. Leads multi-functional teams to ensure product requirements are completed and technical requirements can be created. Owns the product launch and full lifecycle management, including the identification and initial diligence into business or technology partnerships, gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements, understanding the competitive marketplace and trends, developing a business case and pricing, and working closely with engineering, sales, marketing and support to ensure revenue and customer satisfaction goals are met.

**Key Outcomes**:

* Identify and seize opportunities, evaluate the market and competitive environment, for new products and product extensions over the upcoming 12-18 months
* Meet with internal partners (Sales, Network Development, Customer Care, etc.) to understand and prioritize their needs and translate their strategic business questions/concerns into projects or analysis as appropriate
* Develop business and product requirements, including timelines and dependencies

* Form product hypotheses, design test plans, and communicate learnings back into product development
* Develop the product roadmap, prioritize features, build consensus and set expectations with all relevant stakeholders
* Define methods and metrics for identifying success and failure, and iterate quickly
* Define and formally document the product strategy and roadmap
* Run beta and pilot programs with early-stage products and enhancements
* Perform product demos to internal associates and clients as needed
* Research appropriate business and/or technology relationships as related to development of product initiative.

**EDUCATION****:** Bachelor's degree required, advanced degree preferred.

**EXPERIENCE:** 4-7 years Product Management experience within the service industry, high tech or advanced CRM applications preferred. 3 years of progressively increasing project or management experience and responsibilities. Experience building and managing teams is a plus. Previous experience analyzing trends and market developments.

**SKILLS:**

* Service Oriented/Internal Customer Service
* Strategic Partner/Global Perspective
* Strategic Thinking

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Warby Parker is on the lookout for a motivated Product Manager to join our Business Systems Product Management team. In this role, you’ll support the product roadmap and business outcomes for a cross-functional product team concentrating on supply chain and operations. Key areas of focus for this role will include leading and optimizing technology solutions that support our Manufacturing, Distribution, Inventory Control, Logistics, and Order Management functions. As the Product Manager of Business Systems, you’ll find yourself at the crossroads of much of what we do—you’ll influence and impact not only our internal operations but also the customer experience through the support of new product launches. Sound like your dream gig? Read on!

**What you’ll do:**

* Manage the product team responsible for features used by our Business Systems teams
* Help identify and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of features based on our business objectives, metrics, and analyses, ensuring timely delivery of effective solutions
* Partner closely with stakeholders to launch new features and products that create efficient business operations, always with the goal of delivering the best possible customer experience
* Build out a prioritized roadmap by collaborating and building strong relationships with stakeholders across our Supply Chain and Operations teams
* Lead, work closely with, and mobilize other members of our Digital Product and Technology teams to execute cross-functional projects

**What you’ll learn:**

* The nitty-gritty of executing against strategic business concepts
* How to translate high-level objectives into effective product solutions
* A lot—or a lot more!—about supply chains, lab and warehouse management, and transportation and logistics
* How top-quality glasses are made!

**Who you are:**

* 5+ years of professional experience
* Experience owning a product roadmap for backend systems, internal tools, operations-supporting products, or supply chain
* Equipped with experience in supply chain management or an understanding of ERP order management or warehouse management concepts
* Quick to act and able to make tough decisions when called for, leaning on your own background and knowledge of strategic business concepts
* Naturally curious and decisive—you dive into any available information and use those learnings to inform your decisions
* A well-rounded communicator, collaborator, and presenter who loves to share findings and actionable insights
* A team player who’s at ease acting as a leader on certain projects and a contributor on others
* Eager to help others and passionate about creating stellar products
* A strong analyst with basic knowledge of SQL
* Not on the Office of Inspector General’s List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE)

**Extra credit:**

* Experience as a software engineer
* Experience in Oracle ERP
* Experience working at a direct-to-consumer or retail company

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

The Product Manager is responsible for the planning and execution of successful product initiatives. This includes understanding and prioritizing product and customer needs, defining product goals, and working closely with engineering, product owners, and business stakeholders to bring solutions to market. The role monitors product performance through market analysis, a deep understanding of customer needs, and objective data analysis and reporting.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

* Inform, shape, and drive execution of specific Casino product initiatives
* Establish and maintain domain expertise on the product, market, and competitors
* Assess product opportunities and contribute meaningfully to ideation and prioritization for new
* initiatives and products
* Ensure transparency and alignment with organizational stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering, product owners, marketing and operational functions to ensure successful product deliveries and launches
* Identify, prioritize, and execute post-launch optimizations and improvements
* Track and report objectively on product performance, including an understanding of related incidents
* Be the "Canadian Champion" – always ensuring our Canadian customer preferences are considered and their requirements met

**THE STATS**  
What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Minimum 2+ years' experience as a product manager or similar role required
* Proven track record of delivering successful and innovative products
* Ability to handle multiple simultaneous projects while effectively balancing scope, resourcing, time, and quality
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for goals and deliverables
* Demonstrated success cross-functionally influencing teams without formal authority
* Strong quantitative skills
* Excellent critical thinking skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

jobs.desc:
At Exacta Systems, we’re not just shaping the future of gaming—we’re redefining it. As a leader in historical horse racing (HHR) technology, we create cutting-edge gaming solutions that power thrilling player experiences nationwide. Now part of the Churchill Downs family, we’re backed by a storied legacy of excellence in racing and gaming. This new chapter brings exciting opportunities for growth, stability, innovation, and impact. If you're looking for a career where technology meets tradition and where your ideas drive the future, let’s explore the possibilities together!

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

This role sits directly under the Sr. Director, Product Management in a small, high-visibility product organization. The Product Owner will own the backlog for a defined product area, with real latitude over day-to-day delivery decisions, direct access to product leadership, and a clear line of sight from the work to how operators run their business. For someone who wants to build durable expertise in a complex regulated domain and see their decisions reach production quickly, this is a more substantive seat than an equivalent role inside a large product org.

The Product Owner is responsible for translating Exacta’s product strategy and roadmap into clear, actionable work for software development teams. Serving as a key connection point between Product leadership, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Operations, and other business stakeholders, this role owns and prioritizes the product backlog and ensures development teams have the requirements, context, and clarity necessary to deliver high-quality solutions.

The Product Owner works closely with technical teams throughout the software development lifecycle to define requirements, develop user stories and acceptance criteria, clarify business needs, prioritize work, and validate that completed functionality achieves its intended outcome. This position requires a strong understanding of Exacta’s Historical Horse Racing (HHR) products, customers, operational environments, and business processes.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused position. The Product Owner operates within the product strategy and roadmap established by Product leadership and is expected to exercise strong independent judgement on day-to-day prioritization, scope, and sequencing.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Product Backlog Ownership & Prioritization

* Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap priorities, business needs, and customer requirements into actionable development work.
* Prioritize work based on business value, customer impact, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and defect severity.
* Ensure backlog items are defined, sequenced, and development-ready.
* Exercise independent judgment on daily priorities; escalate decisions materially affecting scope, roadmap, or strategy.
* Ensure development teams understand priorities and business rationale.

Requirements & User Story Development

* Translate business, customer, operational, and technical needs into user stories, use cases, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Clearly define problems, desired functionality, expected behavior, and intended outcomes.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, edge cases, and conflicts before development.
* Break larger initiatives into appropriately sized, actionable work and maintain accurate documentation.

Agile Delivery, Quality & Release

* Serve as the primary Product representative for assigned development teams and participate in Agile ceremonies.
* Partner with Engineering, developers, Scrum Masters, and QA throughout development to ensure alignment on requirements and intended outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and address dependencies, risks, constraints, and competing priorities.
* Partner with QA to ensure acceptance criteria are testable; review completed functionality and participate

About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

We’re looking a Product Manager to own product work for our data marketplace. You’ll make it easier for data vendors to bring high-quality RL environments and training data to HUD, and for research teams to discover, evaluate, and use them. You’ll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn technical and operational needs into product decisions.

  • Experience with marketplaces or products serving two distinct groups of users

Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

**Team Overview**

  

The Platform Engineering team is a strategic engineering team focused on building and operating shared platform components that enable our application teams and investment teams to deliver software more efficiently and consistently, reduce duplication and improve engineering productivity. The team works closely with technical stakeholders to understand common needs, drive adoption of platform capabilities and ensure platform services are reliable, well-supported and aligned with the organizations’ broader engineering strategy.

  

**Role Overview**

The Technical Product Manager for Platform Engineering is responsible for maximizing the value, adoption, and service quality of our internal platform capabilities. Reporting to the Head of Platform Engineering, this role owns the shaping, maintenance, and communication of the integrated Platform Engineering roadmap. The Technical Product Manager translates the overall strategy and technical direction as set by the Head of Platform Engineering, together with stakeholder needs, operational priorities, risk, cost, dependencies and engineering capacity into a cohesive roadmap.

  

Working closely with application teams, investment team, engineering leads and other highly technical stakeholders, the Technical Product Manager will be responsible for understanding a diverse range of needs, assessing those needs against the capabilities of our platform offerings and providing recommendations for how they should be addressed within roadmap priorities. The role will oversee the service performance across the platform portfolio, ensuring that platform components are being adopted, service expectations are defined, operational results are transparent, and gaps are actively addressed.

  

This is a highly collaborative role. Engineering leads and subject-matter experts will often lead detailed technical discussions and remain responsible for architecture, implementation, and day-to-day service operation. You will ensure stakeholder engagement is effective, priorities and commitments are coordinated, and platform services operate at the required quality bar.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager – Commerce Platform
jobs.desc:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

We are looking for an experienced **Lead Technical Product Manager** to help define the strategy for our global Commerce Platform.

The Commerce Platform provides foundational capabilities that power Levi's digital commerce experiences across channels and markets. These capabilities span areas including product and inventory, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, identity, search, analytics, observability, and the services and integrations that connect our broader commerce ecosystem.

We are undergoing a significant transformation, evolving from a legacy monolithic commerce platform to a modern architecture built on domain-driven services, APIs, event-driven integration, and reusable platform capabilities.

As the Lead Technical Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for key Commerce Platform capabilities, partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business stakeholders to turn customer and commercial needs into scalable technical solutions.

Beyond gathering and prioritizing requirements, you will help shape the platform's future. This includes identifying opportunities for reusable platform capabilities, addressing architectural and process constraints, prioritizing investments that unlock long-term value, and balancing short-term needs against long-term scalability and complexity.

You will bring product judgment, technical fluency, and curiosity. You are comfortable operating in a changing landscape, digging into complex systems and business processes, challenging assumptions, and bringing structure and direction to problems that cross technical boundaries.

**About the Job**

**Technical Product Roadmap**

* Build and evolve the product strategy for defined capabilities within the Commerce Platform.
* Translate customer, business, and commercial needs into scalable technical products and platform capabilities.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape platform strategy, identifying opportunities to unlock value through new technologies and architectural capabilities while proactively addressing technical constraints, tradeoffs, and long-term risks.
* Balance near-term needs with foundational platform investments, technical health, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
* Build toward reusable, configurable platform capabilities rather than market-, channel-, or use-case-specific implementations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the platform, reduce duplication, and establish clearer product and domain boundaries.
* Define clear product outcomes and success measures and use them to guide roadmap decisions.

**Product Discovery, Definition & Execution**

**About Portside**

Portside is a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for the global aviation industry. Our platform powers critical operations across business aviation, regional airlines, and aircraft leasing & finance, helping over 1,000 aviation organizations streamline operations, improve decision-making, and operate more efficiently.  
  
Backed by leading technology investors Vista Equity Partners and Insight Partners, Portside is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our platform, investing in AI driven innovation, and building a global team focused on shaping the future of aviation technology.

**Job Summary**

Portside is hiring a Product Manager to work on Horizon, our cloud-based flight management platform built for flight departments, fractional ownership programs, and jet card operators of every size and level of complexity. Horizon serves as the operational core for these organizations, unifying aircraft scheduling, crew management, compliance tracking, and financial operations into a single connected system, supported by advanced analytics and a growing suite of integrations.  
  
In this role, you'll help build and deliver features that support real flight operations, in an industry that is rapidly modernizing, including a growing use of AI.  
  
The ideal candidate takes ownership of problems until they're genuinely resolved, not just flagged, and is curious by nature — verifying assumptions and raising concerns before small issues compound. You're genuinely invested in customer outcomes, not just closing out a feature ticket, and you're collaborative, low-ego, and thrive as part of a team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver on a segment of the Horizon product roadmap, translating outcomes and priorities set by product leadership into shipped features and improvements
* Collaborate day-to-day with a small, cross-functional team with engineers and others, and with the broader product team, to make and execute product decisions
* Maintain regular, direct conversations with customers to inform requirements and validate ideas before committing engineering time
* Synthesize customer input, support themes, and usage data into clear priorities
* Own specific projects and initiatives end to end, with oversight from product leadership
* Own releases for your area, including release notes, briefing Sales, Customer Success and /Support ahead of customers-facing changes, and measuring adoption against a target
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders across departments, framing product work in terms of business impact — revenue, retention, cost, risk — rather than features alone
* Incorporate AI tools into your day-to-day work, including prototyping, PRD writing, and accelerating routine tasks

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager at a SaaS company, or a degree or certification in product management
* Comfortable working directly with customers and internal teams, such as Sales and Implementation, to understand needs and manage expectations
* Fluent in working with engineers, able to translate requirements and priorities clearly to drive toward the best product outcome
* Able to prioritize decisively and defend those decisions with data
* Comfortable incorporating AI tools into daily work, including drafting PRDs

* Competitive base salary
* Fully remote work
* Generous time off policy
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Dynamic, collaborative, and fast-growing work environment.
