jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.desc:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Asset Management
jobs.desc:
**About Luma Financial Technologies**

Founded in 2018, Luma Financial Technologies (“Luma”) has pioneered a cutting-edge fintech software platform that has been adopted by broker/dealer firms, RIA offices, and private banks around the world. By using Luma, institutional and retail investors have a fully customizable, independent, buy-side technology platform that helps financial teams more efficiently learn about, research, purchase, and manage alternative investments as well as annuities. Luma gives these users the ability to oversee the full, end-to-end process lifecycle by offering a suite of solutions. These include education resources and training materials; creation and pricing of custom structured products; electronic order entry; and post-trade management. By prioritizing transparency and ease of use, Luma is a multi-issuer, multi-wholesaler, and multi-product option that advisors can utilize to best meet their clients’ specific portfolio needs. Headquartered in Cincinnati, OH, Luma also has offices in New York, NY, Miami, FL, Zurich, Switzerland and Lisbon, Portugal. For more information, please visit Luma’s website.

**About the role**

Luma Financial Technologies is expanding into asset management, and is seeking a Product Owner to help lead that expansion. This role owns product delivery for ETF, Actively Managed Certificate (AMC), Separately Managed Account (SMA) and other related product types that will be supported across Luma's Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, and for the data connectivity that underpins them — integrations with ETF ecosystem partners, such as DTCC, custodians, transfer agents, index provides, sub advisors and other market participants.. The role requires strong organizational discipline, the ability to quickly reprioritize as situations evolve, and the judgment to balance near-term execution with longer-term platform objectives.

The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of experience with ETF, AMC, SMA or other similar products and understands the workflows of Asset Managers, ETF Providers, Custodians, DTCC, and other market participants. A background working at an Asset Management Company that creates and manages ETFs (e.g., Invesco, BlackRock, or similar) is strongly preferred, alongside experience at a fintech platform, custodian, or similar capital-markets institution.

**What you'll do**

**AI-DLC Execution and Delivery**

* Own end-to-end execution of Luma's AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) across discovery, design, development, QA, release, and post-launch evaluation for asset management capabilities.
* Apply Luma's AI-DLC process as the standard delivery methodology which is followed by all Luma Product Owners, using it to accelerate discovery, requirements drafting, and delivery.
* Translate complex asset management workflows into clear, detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage multiple high-priority initiatives at once across Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, ensuring each remains on track through structured planning and active communication.
* Demonstrate strong flexibility and real-time reprioritization as new information, constraints, or business needs emerge.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering to guide sprint planning, backlog refinement, and milestone management.

**Business Stakeholder Partnership**

* This is an external facing role that will require the Product Owner to manage client and partner relationships during the requirements, design, test and launch phases. Prior client or partner facing experience is a key requirement.
* Act as the central liaison between business teams and engineering, ensuring alignment of priorities and clarity of requirements.
* Partner with Sales, Trading, Operations, Asset Managers, ETF Providers, Custodians, Legal/Compliance, and Client Success to refine workflows and validate solutions.
* Communicate evolving priorities clearly and adjust plans as market conditions or stakeholder needs

jobs.desc:
**Overview**
------------

A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love.

We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration

Shared Services & Enablement

Full-time, Springfield, MA

  
  

**The Opportunity**

As the **Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration,** you will create the strategy, determine the business goals, formulate scope and develop a roadmap for the implementation of the Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) platform and other large-scale strategic MassMutual initiatives intended to transform how we deliver service to our advisors and customers for years ahead.

In this role, you will partner with all levels of leadership and cross-enterprise parties (e.g. Operational areas, MMLIS, ETX, Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, etc.) on the execution of the advisor and customer engagement strategy.

  
  

**The Team**

As a key member of the Shared Services & Enablement Team—a highly collaborative group that drives engagement strategy across the enterprise—the Product Owner will shape the long‑term vision for how MassMutual equips its advisors and delivers service to customers. This role blends strategic thinking, cross‑functional leadership, product planning, and operational alignment to ensure that large‑scale initiatives deliver meaningful, future‑ready capabilities that elevate the overall service experience.

  
  

**The Impact**

This role defines and prioritizes product features that meet current and future customer and advisor needs. It partners across business areas—Operations, ETX, vendors, and subject matter experts—to deliver tools that optimize technology, improve service interactions, and drive business value. The position leads prioritization, scope, and timing of Salesforce deliverables; develops business requirements aligned to strategic outcomes; removes obstacles; evaluates risks; and makes key decisions that guide project direction and timelines. It also ensures each business area is operationally ready for transitions with minimal service impact.

Success in this role requires strong project leadership, data analysis, business knowledge, agility, resilience, and consistent stakeholder communication to maintain transparency on strategy, status, decisions, and challenges throughout the multi-phase effort.

  
  

**The Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or 10+ years equivalent work experience in business consulting or project management in lieu of degree

* Financial acumen with experience in tracking and reporting benefit realization
* Knowledge of systems, processes and workflows within operations
* Excellent project management skills
* Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present complex information clearly
* Extremely organized, detail-oriented individual, who is capable of self-managing and multi-tasking in a fast-paced, demanding environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal direction and potential ambiguous situations
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing business priorities and a strong work ethic
* Ability to think strategic

jobs.desc:
We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

**About Designer Brands**

At Designer Brands, we are the proud parent company of DSW Designer Shoe Warehouse, The Shoe Company, and Rubino, operating nearly 675 stores across North America and a billion-dollar digital commerce business. We lead the footwear industry with a diverse portfolio of iconic brands, including Topo Athletic, Keds, Vince Camuto, Kelly & Katie, Jessica Simpson, Lucky Brand, Mix No. 6, Crown Vintage, and others. With expertise in design, production, and sourcing, we create on-trend footwear and accessories, delivered through a robust omni-channel infrastructure and national wholesale distribution. At Designer Brands, we are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and inclusivity, where each employee's unique perspective contributes to our success. Anchored by our core values of “We Love What We Do,” “We Own What We Do,” “We Do What's Right,” and “We Belong,” we continuously drive forward together, building a future where everyone can put their best foot forward.

**Digital Product Manager**

**Location: Remote**

**Department:** Digital  
**Reports To:** Senior Digital Product Manager

**The Opportunity**

At Designer Brands, we're passionate about creating digital experiences that make it easier, more inspiring, and more enjoyable for customers to engage with DSW. As a Digital Product Manager, you'll play a key role in shaping those experiences by turning ideas into impactful solutions that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.

In this role, you'll partner with teams across the organization to bring digital strategies to life, elevate the customer experience, and deliver results against key business objectives. You'll balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations to help determine what gets built, when it gets built, and how success is measured.

We're looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and energized by solving complex problems. You'll thrive if you enjoy learning new technologies, are passionate about digital experiences, and can bring people together around a shared vision.

* Lead the Product Management function of an Agile team, in close partnership with Development, and Business Analyst

* Maintain and prioritize the roadmap and backlog based on customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, effort, risk, and dependencies

* Make informed decisions rooted in Consumer Insights, Analytics, and financial modeling to deliver business results.
* Partner closely with UX Design Team to ensure optimal experience are achieved for enhancements/optimizations.
* Lead the product team to continuously assess progress, disseminate lessons learned, and understand next steps

* Bring technical acumen, empathy, and a growth mindset to identifying opportunities, creating solutions, and understanding results

* Leverage AI tools and capabilities to improve product management efficiency, accelerate research/analysis, documentation, and other day to day activities
* Partner with cross functional teams to explore and lead targeted POCs/pilots for emerging technologies

* 3-4+ years in Product Management or Product Owner role
* Experience owning digital products, platforms, or customer facing experiences

Anderson Power Products® is an industry leader in the design and manufacture of electrical power connectors and power distribution solutions. Anderson Power partners with leading-edge companies to create innovative connector designs that leverage advanced contact technology and high-power expertise to provide superior value across the power electronics industry. Applications span material handling equipment, battery systems, charging infrastructure, warehouse automation, electric vehicles, ground support equipment, renewable energy, and industrial electrification markets.

**Position Summary**
====================

The **Product Manager - Energy** serves as Anderson Power’s Energy market expert and strategic business leader, responsible for defining and executing segment strategy to drive profitable growth across battery energy storage systems, fuel cells, microgrids, backup power, power conversion, distributed energy infrastructure, and related industrial electrification applications.

This role translates market intelligence, customer requirements, technology trends, and competitive insights into growth strategies, product roadmap input, commercialization plans, and priority initiatives that accelerate Anderson Power’s position in targeted Energy markets. The position works closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and Product Management to identify high-value opportunities, support OEM design wins, and convert long-cycle Energy applications into scalable revenue growth.

* **Hybrid role that averages 3 days onsite per week**

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Energy Segment Strategy & Market Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute the Energy segment strategy, growth roadmap, and priority initiatives aligned with Anderson Power’s long-term business objectives.
* Identify, prioritize, and quantify market opportunities across battery energy storage, fuel cells, microgrids, backup power, power conversion, distributed energy, and industrial electrification applications.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, Voice of Customer activities, and application mapping to define where Anderson Power should play and how to win.
* Monitor industry trends, customer roadmaps, regulatory developments, technology shifts, and competitive activity to inform investment priorities and growth strategies.
* Build business cases and strategic recommendations that support profitable growth, product investment, and market expansion decisions.

**Product Roadmap & Customer Insight**
--------------------------------------

* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to align product roadmaps with Energy market requirements, customer expectations, and emerging application needs.
* Translate customer requirements, application challenges, and technology trends into product concepts, roadmap inputs, positioning recommendations, and growth opportunities.
* Support OEM design-in activities, technical evaluations, customer qualifications, and platform opportunities by providing market and application expertise.
* Identify portfolio gaps and recommend new products, product enhancements, application solutions, or partnership opportunities that strengthen Anderson Power’s Energy offering.
* Serve as the internal voice of the Energy market to strengthen customer alignment, product relevance, and long-term competitive position.

**Commercialization, Growth & Execution**

* Lead commercialization activities including value proposition development, market positioning, launch support, sales enablement, and application messaging.
* Partner with Sales to develop account growth strategies for priority Energy customers, applications, and channel opportunities.
* Partner with Marketing to create customer-facing content, application materials, demand generation initiatives, and industry thought leadership that support Energy growth.

jobs.desc:
Hygiena provides rapid microbiology diagnostic tests and solutions for mission-critical, time-sensitive processes around the world. Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to; prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. Solutions are sold in a wide range of industries globally, but the core focus is food safety.

Headquartered in Camarillo, California and with offices around the world, we are actively looking for talented individuals to help grow the business!

**At Hygiena we believe:**

* In providing the highest quality products & service
* Being a leader in innovation
* Having a compelling desire to improve and win in the marketplace
* In contributing positively not only in the workplace, but in our community and environment!

With rapid growth comes opportunity. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our team! This is a full-time, remote (USA), exempt position.

* Own and maintain the product roadmap and revenue objectives for SureTrend's regulatory modules and traceability capabilities, prioritizing features based on compliance risk, customer value, technical feasibility, and strategic alignment.
* Translate global regulatory mandates and scheme requirements - FSMA and FSMA Section 204 (Food Traceability Rule), HACCP/Codex Alimentarius, GFSI-benchmarked standards (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000), and EU General Food Law - into clear, prioritized product requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define the traceability data model and interoperability requirements, including Critical Tracking Events (CTEs) and Key Data Elements (KDEs), lot/batch genealogy, electronic recordkeeping, audit trails, and data exchange with ERP and customer systems via API and SFTP.

* Partner with Engineering in Azure DevOps for backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination across regulatory and traceability workstreams.
* Monitor the global regulatory landscape and post-launch adoption, defect rates, and audit outcomes; proactively alert stakeholders to upcoming mandates and drive continuous improvement cycles.
* Provide senior-level product leadership across the portfolio - mentoring product managers, representing regulatory strategy to executives and the Board, and enabling Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success with clear compliance positioning.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science or a related field required; degrees in Engineering, Life Sciences, or Quality/Regulatory Affairs will also be considered. MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in product management, regulatory affairs, or quality assurance roles, including at least 2 years managing software products for regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, or manufacturing.

jobs.desc:
NOW HIRING: Technical Product Manager - AI

**Remote | $116,984–$146,230 Annually**

This is an opportunity for an experienced product manager to lead the development and execution of AI-powered technology initiatives across the business.

You'll work directly with developers, data science teams, and business stakeholders to turn AI opportunities into real products and solutions, from customer-facing AI features to internal automation tools.

If you have experience in product management, AI/ML, and e-commerce, this could be an opportunity worth exploring.

What You'll Be Doing

* Own the AI product roadmap, including customer-facing AI features, personalization, recommendations, and automated self-service tools.
* Lead the development of AI-powered solutions from initial concept through production launch.
* Identify business opportunities where AI can create measurable value.
* Partner with developers, data scientists, and engineering teams to build and deploy AI products.
* Write technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria using JIRA and Confluence.
* Design experiments and A/B tests to measure AI product performance.
* Track key performance metrics, including accuracy, engagement, conversion, and response times.
* Champion responsible AI practices around privacy, security, fairness, and quality.
* Develop training materials and documentation to help teams adopt AI tools.
* Stay up to date on emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to implement them.

What They're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5–8 years of product management experience.
* At least 2 years leading AI/ML or data-driven product initiatives.
* E-commerce product management experience is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Large Language Models, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, search, ranking, and personalization.
* Experience working with data science and machine learning engineering teams.
* Technical understanding of APIs, data schemas, and system architecture.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**I**

Pay: $113,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Experience the HCA Healthcare difference where colleagues are trusted, valued members of our healthcare team. Grow your career with an organization committed to delivering respectful, compassionate care, and where the unique and intrinsic worth of each individual is recognized. Submit your application for the opportunity below: Technical Product Manager

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**

What makes HCA Healthcare Information Technology Group (ITG) unique as a technology company is that our solutions ultimately impact the care of patients. Although our skills are needed in many industries, we in ITG apply them specifically to the noble cause of healthcare. We are "Healthcare Inspired." It is this guiding vision that pervades and positively influences every level of our organization. It shapes our mission, defines our values, and brings our leaders and employees together in a shared enthusiasm for their work, setting ITG apart as a uniquely purpose-driven company in the IT industry. As a part of that, we exist to raise the bar, unlock possibilities, and care like family.

The Technical Product Manager will help lead product management efforts on their assigned product portfolio which may consist of one or more products. Product portfolios may contain products utilizing different technology stacks and execution methods and range from collections of reusable components to full stack internally and/or externally developed platforms. This role will also work with other developers and business stakeholders to define requirements, groom user stories, and consult with development teams on various projects.

We are on a mission to change the face of the healthcare industry through value driven products. These products will create innovation for all users of healthcare across HCA Healthcare’s nationwide ecosystem. To do this we are building teams that are curious and quick to adapt to new technologies.

Develops a deep understanding of business goals and processes to inform product priorities and improvement recommendations.

Develops strong relationships and regularly communicates with product stakeholders and customers to shape the product strategy and surface and prioritize needs.

Leads product strategy, planning, and life cycle management efforts.

Monitors business, market, and technology trends to inform product strategy and proactively propose new solutions.

Establishes product roadmaps and release plans that satisfy requirements and achieve business outcomes.

Contributes to translating business requirements into actionable products and technical requirements.

Continuously monitors and evaluates product performance and proactively champion product improvements.

Determines internal and contract/external resources and skills required for the product team to deliver on the product roadmap.

Guides the product engineering team to scope, plan and deliver work, applying established delivery methodologies (e.g., agile methods) and best practices (e.g., reusability).

Proactively identifies and resolves blockers to achieve business objectives for their products, including technical and resourcing challenges.

Ensures alignment and adherence to corporate, financial and IT standards (e.g., architecture, compliance, security).

Increases adoption and consumption of product capabilities.

Manages investment decision making and finances for the product, taking a return-on-investment approach to increasing the value while minimizing product costs.

Serves as product manager for multiple, related products.

Evaluates all proposed new technology for the departmental use and organizational fit

Works closely with other developers, project managers, business analysts, and QA engineers.

You will own the product roadmap for the systems that help advertisers measure performance and enable our advertising platform to use data effectively for targeting and optimization. * Develop identity resolution capabilities that connect events to users using permitted first-party identifiers and, where appropriate, probabilistic matching.

* Identify gaps in internal analytics and prioritize improvements based on business impact.

Product Manager  
  
Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.  
  
POSITION OVERVIEW  
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.  
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. *Judgment is still the job.*  
  
Key Responsibilities

* **Product strategy:** Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
* **Customer and market understanding:** Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
* **Discovery and user research:** Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
* **Requirements and definition:** Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
* **Prioritization:** Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
* **Agile delivery:** Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
* **Data-driven decision making:** Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
* **Go-to-market partnership:** Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
* **Communication:** Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
* **Problem solving:** Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features.

Ways of Working We Value  
The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.

* **Prototyping:** Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.
* **User experience design:** Strong instincts for information architecture, user flows, and interaction design. You can give a designer specific, useful feedback rather than adjectives.
* **Practical AI fluency:** You use AI tools in your own work: synthesizing research and feedback, drafting and pressure testing documents, exploring data, and generating edge cases. You know where these tools help and where they add risk or noise.

jobs.desc:
***About Us***

Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.

In 2025, we grew revenue 480% and scaled to 400+ venues across 25 destinations, with the launch of our Culture Calendar extending Dorsia beyond restaurants into the world's most sought-after cultural moments.

Backed by $54M in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Invus, and Red Sea Ventures, and strategic partners including MoonPay, Major Food Group, and The Dinex Group - Daniel Boulud, we are entering our most consequential phase of growth and reshaping the global hospitality landscape. We're adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that's where you come in.

***About the Role***

Dorsia is seeking a **Product Manager, Payments** to own Dorsia Pay and the full member payment experience, from card on file and deposits through checkout, split bills, tipping, settlement, and post-dining support. At Dorsia, the best payment is the one a member never has to think about. We're getting there with agents that understand intent, use payment tools, act within clear permissions, recover from exceptions, and move real money on a member's behalf. The hardest problem in agentic commerce is trust, and this role owns it.

This is a builder role at the boundary of product, engineering, and operations. You won't just write requirements for AI features or bolt on off-the-shelf copilots. You'll prototype agents yourself, define their tools and decision boundaries, write the evals, read the traces, and decide how much autonomy they've earned before they reach production.

The right candidate has hands-on experience in consumer payments or digital wallets, has shipped payment features on mobile, and has built and deployed agents that take real actions in production, beyond features that only summarize or suggest. You'll be accountable for payment conversion, adoption, authorization rates, agent task completion, member trust, and operational leverage.

***What You'll Do***

***Product Strategy and Execution***

* Shape the roadmap for Dorsia Pay and the in-app wallet, with agentic payments at the core.
* Build and ship agents that settle checks, handle deposits and tipping, and recover failed payments on members' behalf.
* Define each agent's tools, context, permissions, and escalation paths, with hard limits on amount, risk, and reversibility.
* Prototype agent behaviors in code, get them in front of users in days, and partner with engineering to ship what works.
* Build golden task sets and adversarial evals before launch, inspect production traces, and expand autonomy only when the evidence earns it.

***Payment Experience and Design Flow***

* Audit and optimize core payment flows, from card onboarding and Apple Pay through split bills, tipping, and post-dining support.
* Replace multi-screen workflows with intent, so a member can split a bill, add a guest, or fix a charge with a single request.
* Design for delegation, so members can hand a payment job to an agent and trust the outcome.
* Build confirmation, explanation, rollback, and human-handoff patterns for ambiguous or high-stakes actions.
* Turn wireframes and agent behaviors into testable builds in days, then refine them through live traces and usability testing.

***Payments Infrastructure and Partnerships***

* Partner with engineering and finance on processor integrations, tokenization, venue payouts, ledgers, and reconciliation.
* Help build a reusable agentic payments platform with shared tools, policies, evals, and observability.
* Deploy back-office agents for reconciliation, disputes, fraud triage, and payout exceptions as volume scales.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50 US jurisdictions and 100+ countries. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

* 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies
* 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies
* Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Spark, Index, and Khosla Ventures.

Every month, Anrok files more tax returns than ever before, and the next month beats it. Behind each return is a company counting on us to file it correctly, on time, and get the money to the right government. Nobody else is set up to do this at our scale.

As the **File & Remit Product Manager**, you'll own the last mile of tax compliance: from preparing a return until the money reaches the tax authority. Everything else Anrok does builds up to this. You'll be solving two problems that shape the company:

**File every return in the world.** Our filing volume keeps setting records. The systems that got us here won't carry us through the next 10x. You'll define the filing platform that can file every return for every company in every jurisdiction. It should run itself, with automation that monitors and repairs its own problems and humans involved only for edge cases.

**Open Anrok to the world.** Today, a company based outside the US has to open a US bank account before it can remit through Anrok. For great international companies, that's often the last thing standing between them and Anrok. You'll build the remittance infrastructure that lets them pay from their local bank account in top international markets.

Our vision: tax filing is handled like magic, and sellers never have to think about it.

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

* Build a filing platform that scales to every return in the world, with most filings fully automated and zero human touches
* Put AI at the center of filing, with agents that write filing automations, catch problems before a filing period opens, and repair them automatically
* Unlock international sellers by making remittance work from their local bank accounts, in local currency
* Own money movement end to end, from collecting seller funds to landing payments at thousands of tax authorities across currencies, banking partners, and jurisdictions
* Build tools for our in-house TaxOps team, your power users, so they can do more jurisdictions with less effort
* Make the returns experience that sellers trust completely: every filing on time and accurate
* Drive the metrics that matter: cost per filing, 100% on-time filings, and fewer amendments
* Identify the next frontier, including whether Anrok's filing engine becomes a standalone platform of its own

**What excites us**
-------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, with 2+ years building B2B products
* Experience in payments, fintech, money movement, or high-volume operational systems
* Systems thinking: you design for 100x, not just for next month
* Comfort going deep technically alongside engineers building automation infrastructure
* High standards in places where a mistake costs a customer money
* A GM mindset with strong product and business instincts
* Clear, concise communication, verbal and written
* Strong cross-functional work with

jobs.desc:
Overview:

At Grow Financial Federal Credit Union, we believe in service — to our 300,000 members, 600 team members and local communities. We’re not just your average bank. We’re a credit union, owned by our members and dedicated to serving people, not profit. We know that happy, engaged people provide the best service, so we live by our mantra: Be Bold. Be Great. Have Fun. Consistently named a Top Workplace by the Tampa Bay Times among multiple national awards we strive to develop a diverse, collaborative culture where you can grow personally and professionally.

Our “work from where you do your best work” strategy provides flexibility to our team members — who currently reside across the U.S. — with a variety of remote, hybrid and in-person roles. We enjoy plenty of opportunities to stay connected through video collaboration, digital tools, community service initiatives and numerous activities. Whether you thrive in a remote setting, prefer the energy of in-person collaboration or seek a balance between the two, you'll find your fit here. Join us as we seek to make things grow — people, communities, money and dreams.

***Grow Financial is headquartered in Tampa, FL. For remote roles, candidates must be located in the following states:*** *AL, AZ, AR, DE, FL, GA, ID, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, MS, MO, MT, NE, NH, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, WV, WI, WY.*

**Some of our Benefits/Perks:**

* **Work-life balance:** 15 days of paid vacation to start, plus paid holidays and sick time
* **Family-first benefits:** Paid family leave for eligible team members
* **Community impact:** Two paid volunteer days each year
* **Professional development:** up to $5,250 annually for full-time team members
* **Retirement readiness:** 401(k) with employer contributions and matching totaling up to 8% for team members
* **Comprehensive healthcare:** Medical, dental, vision, virtual care, and mental health support
* **Financial perks:** Special team member discounts on consumer loans
* **Career growth and development:** Dedicated in-house training team focused on helping you reach your full potential

Responsibilities:

The Agile Product Owner (APO) has the primary role to own and manage the Product Backlog, serve as the voice of the customer and work on a highly collaborative, cross-functional Scrum team required to support the credit union’s Vision. The APO is responsible for driving the development of highest value capabilities for all Grow products. Through the Agile methodology, closely collaborates with business product sponsors, business analysts, developers, designers, and other stakeholders such as business, legal/compliance, security, and operations to ensure that the detailed designs and features delivered by the Scrum meet the needs of all stakeholders. The APO is self-motivated, able to adjust to changing circumstances quickly and professionally and diplomatic with strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, or additional four years of experience in lieu of degree, required.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) required.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience working on Scrum and/or Kanban teams required.
* Minimum 1 year experience leading systems/processes/tools for complex integrated organizational projects required.
* Must possess superior communication skills to ensure a successful partnership across all levels of the organization.
* Must be highly organized, methodical and detail oriented to effectively prioritize work.
* Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality.
* Computer knowledge utilizing Microsoft Office Suite.

**Physical Demands**

* Must be able to sit for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to read, write, speak and type English.
* Must be able to hear and use a telephone.
* Use of computer requires repetitive keystrokes.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
At Shutterfly, we make life’s experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self-expression. That’s why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are.

**Shutterfly is looking to hire a Product Manager to join their team!**

**What You'll Do Here:**

* Ability to continuously manage and groom feature/product backlogs with the goal of prioritizing the most important work. This requires collaboration across the organization to populate the backlog, understand what is feasible from an engineering perspective, and provide adequate information to help inform execution planning. Key expectations of backlog grooming include the ability to generate a business case estimate benefit/value, understand strategic alignment and work closely with the project management organization to estimate effort.
* Drive upstream project deliverables associated with a given project including business cases, project proposals, user requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* During execution, it is expected that you effectively identify and resolve risks, tradeoffs and obstacles, and understand when to engage leadership teams for support.
* Challenge the organization to be quality focused by leveraging data to help drive decisions, having a mindset focused on continuous process improvement and helping to guide test plans to ensure end-to-end, robust coverage.
* Collaboratively work with stakeholders across the organization to gather input and assist product leaders with multi-year product roadmaps.

**The Skills You'll Bring:**

* 5+ years of product management experience
* Demonstrated knowledge and ability to manage product backlogs
* 3+ years of experience leading project teams
* Experience managing a platform roadmap
* Demonstrated experience and knowledge working with Atlassian tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and BitBucket
* History and experience juggling multiple concurrent projects
* Experience working with agile scrum teams to bring new features to market
* Analytical and problem solving experience with large scale systems
* Strong partnership and collaboration skills – you appreciate the importance of bringing others along on the journey
* Experience managing teams through change

Supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce is important to Shutterfly not only because it directly reflects our value of Embracing our Differences, but also because it’s the right thing to do for our business and for our people. We welcome all applicants and evaluate them based on their qualifications. Learn more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion on our Career Site.

This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis until filled.

The compensation package for this role is based on multiple factors, such as job level, responsibilities, location, and candidate experience. The base pay ranges included below are specific to the locations listed, and may not be applicable to other locations.

Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and Washington: [$125,000-$150,500]

This position may be eligible for a bonus incentive, health benefits, a 401K program, and other employee perks. More details about our company benefits can be found at https://shutterflyinc.com/benefits/.

This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis until filled.

**The big picture:** Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy news and information with efficiency, clarity, and Smart Brevity. As a Product Manager, you will independently lead features and projects of moderate complexity that improve experiences for readers, journalists, and advertisers while driving business outcomes.

**Why it matters:** This role is central to shaping the future of Axios' products. As a Product Manager, you will own initiatives from discovery to delivery, using data and user insights to guide decisions. You'll collaborate with designers, engineers, and stakeholders across the company to define priorities, optimize user journeys, and launch impactful features.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will make an impact at Axios with the following responsibilities:

* Independently manage features and quarterly priorities, from discovery through delivery.
* Use data to inform decisions, track performance, and optimize conversion funnels and core user journeys.
* Conduct user research and stakeholder interviews, translating insights into actionable requirements.
* Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, editorial, and revenue teams to align execution with business goals.
* Communicate clearly across teams, adjusting messaging for different audiences.
* Maintain high-quality standards, ensuring features are delivered with minimal oversight.
* Mentor junior team members through reviews, feedback, and modeling best practices.
* Actively support teammates through collaboration, pairing, and team rituals.
* Apply AI tools independently to improve speed and quality of routine tasks, sharing prompts and workflows with peers.

**Skills**

Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios' mission, and have the following skills:

* **2–4 years of experience** in product management or equivalent roles in technology, media, or SaaS.
* Proven ability to independently manage features, projects, and quarterly priorities.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to optimize user flows, funnels, and core product experiences.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to stakeholders at different levels.
* Experience conducting user research and translating findings into product requirements.
* Collaborative mindset with experience mentoring or supporting junior teammates.
* Fluency with AI tools to accelerate work, and the ability to share effective use cases with peers.

**What success looks like**

* Delivery of features and quarterly priorities that measurably improve user engagement and business performance.
* High-quality execution with minimal oversight and strong cross-functional alignment.
* Clear, audience-appropriate communication that builds trust with stakeholders and peers.
* Positive mentorship impact on junior product team members.
* Demonstrated use of data and research to shape product decisions.
* Effective application of AI tools that improve speed, quality, and team efficiency.

*Starting salary for this role is in the range of $100,000 - $125,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** BrandRank.AI

**Duration:** Full Time

**Reports to:** Chief Product/Operations Officer

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and small-team pace.** You would rather own the outcome than wait for a process.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with search, or ranking and scoring systems.
* Experience working with large consumer brands or enterprise customers.
* Exposure to AI answer engines and how they source, cite and rank content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a cutting-edge startup that is revolutionizing brand strategy through AI-driven insights.
* **High-Impact Ownership:** Work directly with engineering and company leadership, with meaningful responsibility for how the product is defined, prioritized and communicated.
* **Small-Team Pace:** Join an early-stage environment where decisions move quickly, ownership is visible and everyone contributes to shipping.
* **Customer Proximity:** Work on product decisions that directly affect leading consumer brands and enterprise customers.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

BillGO is seeking a Product Manager to help build and improve the product capabilities that support customers across the lifecycle (enrollment, activation, retention, churn, engagement). Reporting to the Director of Product – Customer Experience, you will turn the Customer Experience strategy into well-defined requirements, prioritized backlogs, and shipped features.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on discovery, requirements, delivery, and measurement. You will own day-to-day product execution for Customer Experience features, working closely with engineering, data, marketing, and go-to-market teams. Your work will help improve the experience for existing customers, with a focus on increasing lifetime value, improving retention, and broadening adoption of BillGO’s products & services, and will support efforts to improve prospect targeting.

**Why This Role Matters**

This role turns BillGO’s Customer Experience strategy into the product capabilities customers use every day. By owning requirements, delivery, and measurement for Customer Experience features, this role helps the team ship the right things on time, with clear evidence of impact.

With a dedicated product manager focused on execution, BillGO can move faster from idea to release, learn from every launch, and steadily improve utilization, engagement, and retention across our customer base.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Discovery & Roadmap Execution**

* Own the backlog and contribute to the roadmap for Customer Experience capabilities across BGX, in line with the strategy set by the Director of Product

* Understanding of customer lifecycle metrics (activation, utilization, engagement, retention, churn)

* Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as a force multiplier to improve speed, quality, and impact of work.
* Action-oriented and detail-minded, comfortable owning work from requirements through release

jobs.title: Product Owner- Fire and Mapping
jobs.desc:
**About Overwatch Imaging**  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, Overwatch Imaging builds AI-enabled Smart Sensors and Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software for time-critical airborne imagery intelligence.  
Wildfire is our core market. The U.S. Forest Service, CAL FIRE and agencies from France to Australia fly our sensors to map fires overnight and deliver intel to incident command by morning.

  

**About the Role**  
The Product Owner – Fire & Mapping reports to the Lead Product Owner and leads a dedicated, cross-functional Fire & Mapping product team. Expanding the civil market is the main focus, achieved through product development for wildfire, commercial services and inspection and product sustainment for existing customers. You will partner closely with the Fire & Mapping Product Director: the Director sets product vision and market strategy, and you turn it into the backlog and delivery. The role has two goals:  

* **Drive growth through the product.** Define and deliver the new features based on market and current customer need, expanding the product along new market verticals, such as tactical fire response, etc.
* **Make the product work for existing customers.** Support current fire customers from a technical and functional perspective, so our products perform reliably in their missions.

**Focus Areas**  

* Fire mapping and intelligence (our core)
* Tactical fire response and initial attack
* Commercial infrastructure inspection
* Broader mapping: disaster response, damage assessment and other wide-area mapping missions
* Manned and unmanned aviation platforms

**What You'll Do**  

* Be the technical and functional product contact for existing fire customers, and work issues through with engineering and support.
* Turn customer feedback and the Director's strategy into new features, including for tactical fire response.
* Write epics, user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA.
* Own a prioritized backlog that balances fixes, customer needs and new features.
* Run sprint ceremonies and keep delivery on track.
* Plan releases in sync with the fire season and support release notes, training and documentation.

**What Success Looks Like**  

* Products work reliably for existing customers, and issues are resolved quickly.
* New features ship that customers ask for and that open new fire and mapping markets.
* Engineering has clear requirements and a steady, predictable cadence.
* Releases ship on time for fire season.

**What You'll Bring**  

* 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst.
* Experience supporting customers on technical products while exploring and delivering new features.
* Strong writing skills, especially user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with complex or hardware-enabled software.
* A practical agile mindset and comfort with ambiguity.

**A strong plus:**  

* Wildfire, emergency management or fire agency experience
* Airborne imaging, remote sensing or GIS background
* Aviation or aerospace experience
* Agile certification (CSPO, CSM, SAFe) and JIRA/Confluence

**Location**  
Full-time and on-site in Hood River, Oregon. At this point, no remote candidates will be considered. Up to 20% travel, including customer and field visits.

**What We Offer**  

* Fully covered medical and dental premiums for you and your family, plus an HSA
* Equity/stock options
* 401K with up to 4% employer match
* Generous PTO and 10 company holidays
* Late Start Wednesdays for focus time
* Startup pace, real impact and an open-door leadership team

*All applicants must be authorized to work on a permanent basis in the United States.*

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager, People & Culture
jobs.desc:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Within Mack Trucks and Volvo Trucks North America Digital Management function you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals, we learn and improve continuously and embrace change to stay ahead.

You work in the intersection between business, technology, and user experience. You understand the end user, customer, and business needs, utilizing user journeys and design thinking to secure the digital product brings continuous value. You optimize the product to achieve the business goals while maximizing return on investment.

You collaborate with other parts of the organization, both in different business functions and the Community of DTO. We have an environment where ideas, thoughts and opinions can be shared. We are team players with clear common ambitions, and we win together.

This is how you could make an impact  
As the Digital Product Manager, People & Culture, you will be key in aligning with the business strategy and evolve the product including vision, strategy, goals, roadmap, and budget through the lifetime of the digital initiative. These will be some selected responsibilities:  
  

* Own and evolve the digital product portfolio supporting People & Culture and Legal processes.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Legal stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements into prioritized product capabilities.
* Lead vendor and platform roadmap discussions, assess product fit and technical health, and manage upgrades, releases, service performance, and application rationalization across the People & Culture and Legal landscape.
* Drive adoption through stakeholder communications, process readiness, training, and change management tailored to employees, people leaders, People & Culture professionals, Legal teams, and other authorized users.
* Define digital product vision, strategy, goals, and roadmaps.
* Regularly collect feedback on implemented work through measures, analytics, and end user input.
* Ensure the entire user experience is designed with the user at the center and secure the product brings continuous value.
* Identify dependencies, including on stable teams and individual contributors.
* Drive planning cycle for product, including roadmap, resource needs and budget required.
* Ensure digital products fulfill all legal, compliance and security demands.
* Secure release and roll-out plan, including change management and training approach.
* Cultivate strong collaboration and teamwork.
* Represent Group Trucks NA in relevant global forums and projects.

**Who are you?**
----------------

We believe you want to take your career to the next level, working with amazing people around the world. To be successful in this position we believe you have a university degree or equivalent, and experience from leading functionally, preferably within IT management.

Furthermore, we believe this role requires experience from working towards digital product orientation and agile ways of working as well as knowledge of information technology trends.  
  
You will need understanding of the cost drivers in systems delivery and operations and the business consequences of the technical decisions made and good familiarity with the disciplines of enterprise digital development and technical architecture.

In addition to this, you are a passionate believer in lifelong learning. You should feel energized by working both independently and interdependently, have proven skills in cross-functional collaboration and thrive in managing, foster, and enable both the perform and the transform angles of the job.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager, Integrations** to join the product team and take ownership of complex integrations connecting the creator ecosystem, customer experience, and external platforms.  
This is a highly technical product role focused on **APIs, SDKs, authentication, data flows, and third-party integrations**.
  
You will act as the product owner for the bi-directional flow of third-party data and authentication, working closely with engineering teams, enterprise customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.  
  
**Location:** San Francisco, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, Seattle, Texas (Remote)

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
-----------------------------------

* Define and drive the **integration strategy**, standards, and technical capabilities across the platform.
* Own the product lifecycle of **Integrations and SDK products** — from strategy and discovery through roadmap, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the integrations development process, ensuring that implementation meets customer needs, technical standards, and business objectives.
* Drive both **inbound data ingestion and outbound data publishing/syndication** across third-party platforms.
* Analyze customer requirements and translate them into scalable integration architectures in collaboration with technical leads.
* Define clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs for engineering teams.
* Lead technical discussions with **enterprise customers, ecosystem partners, developers, and integration marketplaces**.
* Translate complex technical concepts — such as payload structures, authentication mechanisms, data models, and latency — into clear product decisions and requirements.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Enablement teams to understand customer needs and incorporate the **Voice of the Customer** into product strategy.
* Develop and support the go-to-market strategy for attracting **third-party integration users, developers, and technology partners** to the ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities for product improvements and new integration capabilities based on customer feedback, market trends, analytics, and industry best practices.
* Apply a strong **security and DevSecOps mindset** when defining integration solutions and technical requirements.

**What we’re looking for:**
---------------------------

* **5+ years of overall software industry experience**, including at least **3+ years working with product APIs**.
* Strong experience as a **Technical Product Manager, API Product Manager, Integration Product Manager, or similar technical product role**.
* Hands-on understanding of designing and managing workflows involving:

  + **REST APIs**
  + **GraphQL**
  + **Webhooks / real-time integrations**
* Strong understanding of **bi-directional data flows and data structures**, including JSON and XML.
* Practical knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as:

  + **OAuth 2.0**
  + **JWT**
  + **API Keys**
* Experience designing solutions with or for **Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS)** products such as Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with customers to design and implement technical solutions based on their business requirements.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
jobs.desc:
As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients. The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale.

In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

### **Primary Duties:**

* Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.
* Ongoing optimization of live user workflows and capabilities including monitoring of key metrics & user feedback
* Work with internal teams and end users to develop a deep understanding of requirements, perform thoughtful solution design, use data to test hypotheses, and support teams throughout execution.
* Write detailed user stories for new features, capturing detailed descriptions of business rationale, requirements, and success criteria that are defined by measurable outcomes.
* Develop short- and long-term roadmaps that deliver maximum value with minimum risk and assume ongoing iteration.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of product management experience in marketing technology, technology-enabled services industry, or a SaaS product.
* Experience using data and primary research to inform solution design and build internal business understanding.
* Experience with and understanding of the software development lifecycle and software development methodologies. Preferably experience with Agile / Scrum teams.
* Product development experience in the context of the development of a healthcare technology product.

### **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:**

* Strong product-oriented martech domain expertise, with a clear understanding of how marketing and sales platforms, data and processes work together to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.
* Broad knowledge of the martech landscape (e.g. CDP, DAM, CMS, Marketing automation, etc.), including how unified data enables personalization and agentic marketing.
* Experience identifying and deploying high-impact AI and agentic marketing use cases that drive pipeline growth and operational efficiency.
* Experience working on or owning platforms in the marketing technology space (eg Hubspot, Salesforce, Seismic, Gong, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, etc).

* Excellent organizational and communication skills with an emphasis on problem-solving and building subject matter expertise.

You will develop a deep understanding of component design and manufacturing workflows and become the product expert and primary advocate for your products.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing & Collections
jobs.desc:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*
