**“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”**

**WHO ARE WE?**

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based in San Antonio, TX, but we're truly a remote, telecommuting company.

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

The Product Owner is responsible for translating prioritized product initiatives and epics into well-defined functional and technical requirements that enable efficient and predictable delivery by engineering teams. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and Quality, the Product Owner ensures that product initiatives are decomposed into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation that allow development teams to execute effectively.

This role serves as the operational bridge between product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner owns backlog quality and delivery readiness for their assigned product domain or engineering team, ensuring that stories entering development are well understood, actionable, and aligned with product objectives. The Product Owner plays a key role in maintaining backlog health, supporting agile delivery practices, and enabling consistent, high-quality product releases.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?**

* Translate prioritized product initiatives and epics into detailed functional and technical requirements, including user stories and acceptance criteria
* Maintain and manage the product backlog for assigned product areas or engineering teams, ensuring items are clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for development
* Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure product strategy and roadmap initiatives are accurately reflected in backlog priorities and delivery plans
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Design, and Quality teams to clarify requirements, answer questions, and support effective implementation of product functionality
* Lead or facilitate backlog refinement sessions to ensure stories meet established Definition of Ready standards before sprint planning
* Ensure functional and technical documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with delivered product functionality
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to support effective agile delivery practices
* Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined, and solutions meet expected functionality and quality standards
* Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, or ambiguities that could impact delivery timelines or solution quality
* Support continuous improvement of delivery processes, documentation practices, and backlog management standards within the Product Delivery organization
* 25% of your time may include travel for client visits, conferences, and networking

**WHAT DO YOU NEED?**

* 2–5 years of experience in a product, business analysis, delivery, or technical role within a SaaS or technology environment
* Experience working with agile development teams and familiarity with Scrum or similar iterative delivery frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to translate business or product requirements into clear functional specifications or user stories
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition
* Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, and Design
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Product Manager- Empower
jobs.desc:
**Help Drive Innovation in AAC – Join PRC-Saltillo as a Product Manager- Empower!**  
  
This position is where customer needs, product strategy, and innovation come together! Are you passionate about developing products that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives? Bring your leadership, collaboration, and problem-solving skills to a team dedicated to advancing communication solutions for individuals with complex communication needs.  
The **Product Manager-Empower** plays a key role in guiding the development and success of PRC-Saltillo products. This role works closely with AAC users, families, professionals, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify needs, prioritize solutions, and ensure products align with customer expectations and business goals. The Product Manager helps drive projects from concept through delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and engaged throughout the process.  
  
**Go to our website to apply** https://prentkeromich.bamboohr.com/careers  
  
**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Help shape products that empower individuals who use AAC to communicate and connect.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Influence product strategy and decisions that directly affect users, families, and professionals.
* **Collaborative Environment:** Partner with engineering, clinical, and business teams to bring innovative solutions to life.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Expand your expertise in product management, AAC technology, and market strategy.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Builds and maintains a deep understanding of AAC users, communication partners, professionals, and industry trends.
* Conducts market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and support product strategy.
* Maintains and prioritizes stakeholder and customer needs.
* Works with cross-functional teams to define products and features that align with customer needs and business objectives.
* Monitors project progress, timelines, and performance metrics while proactively addressing risks and obstacles.
* Gathers and communicates stakeholder feedback throughout the product development process.
* Collaborates with engineering, clinical, and business teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Supports product compliance requirements and works with stakeholders to address related needs.
* Communicates product updates, new features, and known issues to keep stakeholders informed.
* Manages external vendors and subcontractors as needed.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Speech-Language Pathology, Engineering, or a related field required. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience coordinating and/or collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience using Microsoft Office applications.

  

**Required Skills/Abilities**

* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a willingness to investigate issues and recommend solutions.
* Adaptable, flexible, and able to navigate changing priorities.
* Positive attitude and ability to remain effective in high-pressure situations.

jobs.title: Integration Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

Redzone, the Connected Workforce business unit within QAD | Redzone, helps manufacturers make more products for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. *At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected workforce.”*

We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world-class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 26% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance, and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision-making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.

With an AI powered platform, nearly 2000 plants and over 500,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.

 **Job Description**

Under the leadership of the VP of Product Management, the **Integration Product Manager** is responsible for defining, refining, and delivering enterprise products that help manufacturers connect Redzone with third-party systems (ERP, MES, and OT/IoT platforms), optimizing data flow, system connectivity and frontline execution across the plant floor.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the center of Redzone’s growth strategy. You will define how Redzone connects seamlessly into the broader manufacturing tech ecosystem—unlocking data from ERP, MES, HRIS, and OT systems to deliver seamless workflows and real-time connectivity for the frontline.

You will own the vision and execution for integrating with enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, Ignition, GE Proficy, Workday, Kronos, and others. If you’ve spent your career bridging factory floors with enterprise systems and creating seamless data flow across manufacturing environments, we want to talk to you. The Integration Product Manager will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to drive day-to-day product strategy, execution, prioritization, and customer engagement across integration.

*This position is Full-Time, Exempt, and Remote, with a requirement to travel up to 40% of the time.*

**Responsibilities**

* Gains a thorough understanding of customer integration needs and uses that knowledge to help deliver enterprise products that provide an unparalleled connected experience.
* Translates business goals, system requirements, and end-user needs into an actionable integration product strategy.
* Identifies goals, metrics, and analytics to determine the business and operational value of integrations.
* Continually makes recommendations and refinements to integration capabilities based on customer learnings and technical feedback.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
DENT Instruments, located in Bend, Oregon, is hiring a full-time Product Manager to own the product strategy and roadmap for our submeters, current transformers, power loggers and cloud software. You'll work closely with sales and customers to understand the market, keep our portfolio competitive, and make sure our products support our growth strategy. Day to day, you'll serve as DENT's first Scrum Product Owner, turning that strategy into clear priorities for engineering.

**Two Paths Into This Role**

* Industry Expert: You know energy metering, building automation or electrical equipment inside and out, and you're ready to move into product. We'll coach you on product management and Scrum.
* Product Management Pro: You've owned the strategy and roadmap for a technical B2B product, ideally as a Scrum Product Owner. You haven't worked in our industry, but you learn fast. We'll get you up to speed on our products and customers.

Either way, we'll pay for your Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) training or a similar certification. Where you land in the pay range depends on the path you come from and the experience you bring. Someone who walks both paths may justify a salary above the posted range.

**Who You Are**

* Decisive: You make the call with the information you have, and you can explain why.
* Customer-Focused: You'd rather pick up the phone than guess. You're comfortable on customer calls, building relationships with key accounts and asking for honest feedback.
* Market-Minded: You follow customers, competitors and market trends, and turn what you see into product decisions.
* Technically Curious: You can hold your own with engineers on hardware, firmware and software.
* Clear Communicator: Your requirements and business cases are easy to read and act on.
* Builder: You enjoy building out a function, not just running one.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Owning product strategy and the roadmap across meters, current transformers, software and cloud, aligned with our growth strategy
* Working closely with sales to understand customer needs, wins and losses, and where the market is heading
* Running market and competitive analysis to keep our product portfolio competitive, including the standards and certifications that shape it
* Getting in front of customers: joining sales calls, building relationships with key accounts and OEM partners, and reaching out for feedback
* Building business cases, making value-based product decisions and giving input on pricing
* Managing the full product lifecycle, from new product ideas and customer beta testing through end-of-life decisions
* Partnering with our Marketing Manager on launches, positioning and sales training
* Serving as Scrum Product Owner for the engineering team: backlog, priorities and acceptance

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 2+ years in product management or Scrum Product Owner work on a technical B2B product, or in a technical role in energy metering, building automation, HVAC/controls or electrical equipment
* Comfort with products that combine hardware, firmware and software
* Experience working directly with customers, sales teams or partners

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Product marketing or launch experience
* Market research, competitive analysis or product strategy experience
* Experience with OEM or private-label partners
* Cloud or SaaS products tied to connected devices
* Familiarity with building communication protocols such as Modbus or BACnet
* Familiarity with UL, CE or ANSI certification
* Scrum or Agile experience, or a CSPO (or more advanced) certification

**Benefits**

* 401(k) and 401(k) matching
* Medical insurance: health, dental and vision
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance, including CSPO training
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement

jobs.desc:
Trek Travel provides global cycling, hiking, and walking vacations of a lifetime with the goal of helping more people actively explore and experience the world. This is Trek Travel's first dedicated product management seat, owning the website and every other digital product across the business — the guest portal, booking and reservation flows, email infrastructure, campaign landing pages, CRM and data analytics, dashboards, and internal tooling.

This is a hands-on role that combines building the product operating model with running it day to day, across a delivery team of internal staff, fractional specialists, and agency partners. You'll bring product instincts, customer understanding, and marketing fluency to everything you spec, coordinate, and ship, with real autonomy to shape how product gets built. This is your opportunity to join the Trek Travel team and leave your mark on our company, on the active travel industry, and on the world at large.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the roadmap for the website, guest portal, and all other digital products
* Run quarterly product strategy reviews and monthly roadmap reviews with leadership
* Stand up the product development lifecycle end to end: idea intake, sizing and prioritization, PRDs, spec documents, and release readiness

Delivery & Team Management

* Run the delivery cadence across teams: sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retros, and dependency tracking
* Plan team availability and capacity, aligning people's hours against company priorities and the annual marketing and business initiatives calendars
* Manage a mixed delivery team of internal staff, fractional specialists, and agency partners

Marketing & Campaign Support

* Support and coordinate digital ads, organic and paid social, digital campaigns, and email — bringing strategy, creative, copy, build, and deployment together through to launch

CRM & Analytics

* Own CRM and marketing data analytics: HubSpot, campaign tracking, dashboards, GA4, segmentation, and lifecycle data
* Monitor product and business health daily: conversion, funnel drop-offs, feature usage, and campaign performance
* Report on metrics leadership can act on

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate across sales, marketing, guest services, guest experience, forecasting, field, logistics, and the trip product and design teams to turn feedback into prioritized product work
* Use AI to improve workflows, both for personal productivity and across the functions you coordinate — including drafting PRDs, scoring and sizing intake, and running AI-accelerated, spec-driven development with engineering

The top priority in this role is the end-to-end customer funnel: ads that run efficiently and carry awareness, retargeting, and re-engagement for new and repeat guests; an email program with meaningful segmentation that improves over time; and a website that converts on both. CRM and analytics support all three, and building a product process the team can run inside is central to the job.

* A track record shipping software products end to end, from problem definition through PRD, spec, build, QA, and release
* Strong product instincts and taste, with the judgment to hold the bar on what ships

jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

 **Job Description**

As a **Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance)**, you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, engineers, QA, data teams, and delivery partners to deliver scalable, user-centered solutions across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash workflows.

This role combines strong product ownership with a working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management, Sales and Distribution, and Finance/Controlling integrations. You will focus on improving business outcomes such as purchasing compliance, process efficiency, invoice automation, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, financial controls, and user experience.

**Drive Product Outcomes**

* Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for supply chain, procurement, and related finance capabilities.
* Define the customer and business problems to solve, desired outcomes, and success measures—not only the features to deliver.
* Translate business objectives into prioritized epics, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and incremental release plans.
* Balance customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, compliance needs, and delivery timelines.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that enable continuous delivery, learning, and measurable improvement.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, process efficiency, procurement compliance, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, and user satisfaction.

**Lead Discovery and Process Design**

* Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with procurement, supply chain, finance, warehouse, sales, customer service, and IT stakeholders.
* Understand current-state workflows, pain points, and control requirements needs across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash processes.
* Facilitate future-state process design, identify gaps and dependencies, document decisions, and build alignment on scope and priorities.
* Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and system insights to validate assumptions before significant investment.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through SAP capabilities, process simplification, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Maintain a strong understanding of core procurement, inventory, finance, and cross-functional business processes.

**Enable Strong Delivery**

* Partner with SAP functional consultants, engineers, QA, integration teams, data teams, and business process owners to refine solutions and remove ambiguity.
* Define requirements for integrations among SAP S/4HANA MM, SD, FI/CO, warehouse operations, tax, payment, logistics, customer, supplier, and third-party systems.
* Validate end-to-end business and accounting impacts across requisition-to-payment, inventory, sales-order-to-billing, and financial reporting processes.
* Participate in and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
* Prioritize defects, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact, urgency, risk, compliance, and roadmap value.
* Support implementation activities including master-data readiness

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

Southfield, MI (Hybrid) · Full-time · Reports to VP of Product

**Who We Are**

We believe in small businesses and the people who grow them. At Credibly, we combine data science, technology, partner relationships, and customer support to give business owners fast access to right-sized capital — from working capital loans and merchant cash advances to lines of credit.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, with offices in New York and Arizona, Credibly has provided access to more than $3 billion in capital to over 65,000 small businesses nationwide.

**The Opportunity**

The Product Manager will drive product planning and execution across Credibly's lending platform: the experiences our merchants and broker partners use to apply and get funded, the internal tools our sales, underwriting, funding, and servicing teams rely on every day, and the data and integrations that connect it all.

You will connect customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility; decide what to build and why; and lead cross-functional teams through discovery, delivery, and launch. You will use data to measure what works, and you will look for practical ways that automation and AI can make our products faster, smarter, and easier to use.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Own outcomes.** Define the goals and KPIs for your product areas (conversion, time-to-fund, operational efficiency, partner and merchant satisfaction) and use them to guide priorities and measure success.
* **Lead the product lifecycle.** Take initiatives from ideation and discovery through requirements, design, testing, launch, and iteration.
* **Understand our users.** Spend time with merchants, ISO and broker partners, and internal teams to understand their workflows and pain points, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* **Own the integration and data-vendor portfolio.** Evaluate third-party data, verification, and banking-data providers on hit rate, lift, latency, reliability, and cost; build the business case for adding, replacing, or renegotiating; and manage integrations with funding and capital markets partners.
* **Write clear requirements.** Document vision and scope through use cases, PRDs, epics, and user stories that give agile scrum teams what they need to build the right thing.
* **Partner with engineering and design.** Work closely with engineering, design, and data teams to shape solutions that are usable, technically sound, and secure.
* **Use data to decide.** Pull and analyze data with SQL and BI tools to size opportunities, understand behavior, and evaluate the impact of what we ship.
* **Find opportunities for automation and AI.** Identify manual work and decision points where automation, integrations, or AI can create value, and work with technical teams to deliver them responsibly.
* **Drive launches and adoption.** Coordinate with sales, marketing, operations, and support on launch plans, training, FAQs, and documentation so new capabilities get used.
* **Ensure quality.** Define acceptance criteria, support testing and UAT, and work with business and engineering teams to triage and resolve issues.
* Stay current on the alternative lending and fintech landscape, competitor offerings, and emerging technology.

**What You Bring:**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering software products, ideally in a B2B, fintech, or financial services environment
* A track record of shipping products that delivered measurable business results
* Strong product discovery and prioritization skills, and the judgment to balance customer, business, and technical needs
* Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work, such as drafting user stories, summarizing feedback, or analyzing data, and good judgment about when to double-check the results
* Comfort with data; working knowledge of SQL and BI tools is strongly preferred
* Enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers, including understanding AP

We're looking for a Product Manager to own roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for a digital product initiative, operating within Agile/Scrum frameworks. The role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — most engagements in this market are technical-delivery-adjacent (software, data, or AI products) rather than purely strategic, so comfort partnering closely with engineering is expected.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product backlog, prioritization, and roadmap using Agile/Scrum practices

  • Define and track success metrics/KPIs for the product area

  • (Frequent industry context) CPG/enterprise data-product ownership — managing data platforms, catalogs, or analytics products feeding business stakeholders


Required Skills (Must-Have)

  • Proven Product Manager, Product Owner, or Technical PM experience
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration (engineering, data, business)

Nice to Have

jobs.desc:
Posting Description:

**Technical Product Manager – Facultative Reinsurance**

Do you have technical product management experience and a passion for driving digital transformation? Are you a strategic leader who can connect business and technology to deliver innovative solutions? Join us as a Product Manager and help build the future of our placement platforms at Aon!

*This position is located in Bloomington, MN, USA, offering the option to work remotely or from our nearby office.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

As a Technical Product Manager, your day is dynamic and collaborative. You’ll work closely with senior business leaders and cross-functional teams to drive product innovation in the reinsurance sector. Your focus will be on aligning technology solutions with business strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and championing digital transformation across the facultative business. You’ll balance planning, working with partners, and hands-on leadership to deliver impactful results in a fast-paced environment.

**Typical Daily Activities:**

* Meet with senior leadership to align product roadmaps with strategic objectives and market trends.
* Represent the technology team in meetings with collaborators, promoting transparency and accountability.
* Communicate product vision and strategy to both internal and external collaborators.
* Analyze market research and competitive intelligence to identify new opportunities for product differentiation.
* Lead cross-functional sessions with engineering, architecture, and business SMEs to define and prioritize product features.
* Guide teams through the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.
* Advocate for coordinated technology platforms and drive adoption among users.
* Monitor product performance using important metrics and customer feedback, driving continuous improvement.

* Ensure compliance with insurance market regulations and industry standards around the globe.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and keep product initiatives on track with business goals.

**How this opportunity is different**

This role is crafted to serve as a strategic link between important business partners and technology teams. It ensures technology solutions directly drive business growth and improve operational efficiency. The position includes representing the Technology team in meetings with collaborators and aligning efforts across regions with global goals. The Product Manager should act as a product champion, sharing vision and strategy inside and outside the company while leading teams through cooperative problem-solving and resolving conflicts.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Demonstrated experience as a Product Manager with at least 3 years of business background, 3 years applying Agile methodologies, and 2 years managing product teams.
* Strong leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to encourage and motivate cross-functional teams.
* Excellent critical thinking, technical problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Highly developed communication skills, with proficiency in executive presentations.
* Advanced negotiation, facilitation, and consensus-building skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical collaborators.

* Experience with digital transformation initiatives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent years of industry experience.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. We're changing that.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payment Processing
jobs.desc:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

SHift4 is expanding globally and hiring a key Payment Processing Product Manager, Lead – North America owns the product strategy and delivery for the core transaction processing domain in North America, spanning Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management.

  

This role is central to the company's move away from legacy, homegrown processing infrastructure toward a modern, modular processing platform, and requires close, ongoing engagement with the third-party processors and networks the business relies on today as that transition unfolds. Reporting into the Global Payment Delivery leadership, this individual translates architectural direction into a concrete, sequenced product roadmap, working across engineering, operations, finance, and external processing partners to ensure the platform is reliable, compliant, and positioned for eventual platform independence.

**Responsibilitie**s

  

* Own the product roadmap for Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management within the North America processing stack, ensuring alignment with the broader global processing architecture and platform-independence strategy.
* Serve as the primary product point of contact with existing third-party processing and network partners, managing day-to-day requirements, escalations, and roadmap dependencies while planning for eventual consolidation onto the target processing platform.
* Translate high-level architectural direction (e.g., separating switching/auth, clearing, and settlement into modular, replaceable components) into detailed product requirements, phased migration plans, and measurable delivery milestones.
* Partner with Engineering to scope build-vs-buy decisions for processing capabilities not fully covered by external platform partners (e.g., residuals, billing nuances, reconciliation, reporting), and own the resulting internal product backlog.
* Work closely with Finance, Risk, Operations, and Compliance to ensure clearing, settlement, and exception-handling flows meet regulatory, funding, and reconciliation requirements across card networks and payment types.
* Define and track success metrics for processing reliability, settlement accuracy, exception resolution time, and partner performance, and report progress to senior product and executive stakeholders.
* Document and maintain the logical data model and interface contracts between the processing domain and adjacent systems (onboarding/merchant data, gateway, billing), ensuring consistency in naming conventions and identifiers as legacy systems are decomposed.
* Support internal and external certification efforts (e.g., network/scheme certifications) tied to new clearing and settlement capabilities.
* Act as a bridge between regional (North America) needs and the global Payment Architecture function, surfacing local requirements for peer review and ensuring North America is represented in global processing standards.

**Qualifications**

  

* 7+ years of experience in a product management role within payments processing, acquiring or a related financial technology domain.
* Working knowledge of transaction lifecycle mechanics, specifically clearing, settlement, and dispute/exception processes across card networks.
* Experience managing relationships with external processing or network partners, including roadmap negotiation and issue escalation.
* Demonstrated ability to translate architectural or technical direction into an executable, sequenced product roadmap.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside Finance, Risk, Operations, and Engineering.
* Comfort working with structured data and system interfa

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Managers work closely with product leadership, UI/UX, Business Analysis, Development, Quality Assurance, Sales, Legal, Account Management, and other stakeholders to deliver improvements that solve meaningful customer problems and support business goals. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to move work forward with appropriate independence while seeking alignment and escalating risks when needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Engage with customers, end users, and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, evaluate workflows, and identify product opportunities

* Evaluate customer requests and business opportunities, recommend priorities, and communicate trade-offs among customer value, business impact, effort, and risk

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and manage priorities, scope, and deliverables in alignment with product leadership

* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, including workflows, business rules, and acceptance criteria

* Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate solutions, refine requirements, resolve open questions, and ensure proposed solutions meet business needs

* Guide product functionality from discovery through development, testing, release, and post-release evaluation, maintaining clear ownership of product decisions, requirements, and outcomes throughout the lifecycle

* Proactively manage and communicate progress, decisions, dependencies, and risks, providing recommendations and escalating issues when appropriate

* Partner with stakeholders to communicate product value, expected business benefits, features, and functionality for customer education and sales enablement

* Monitor product adoption, customer feedback, and business outcomes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in software product management, business analysis, or a related product role, with demonstrated responsibility for defining and delivering software functionality

* Knowledge of residential mortgage processes, capital markets, or mortgage underwriting/origination and the ability to understand business rules, data, and customer workflows

* Experience developing and communicating detailed software requirements and translating complex business needs into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences

* Demonstrated ability to investigate problems, evaluate alternatives, and make well-supported recommendations

* Working knowledge of Agile or other iterative software development practices, including backlog management and experience using product and delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Aha!

* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, with sound judgment regarding when to involve them in decisions and discussions

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain follow-through across multiple initiatives

* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and recognize when alignment or escalation is needed

* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

* Familiarity with SQL or similar query tools is preferred; demonstrated aptitude for learning data investigation tools may substitute for direct experience

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience

Travel required: Up to 20% for customer meetings, internal collaboration, and industry events.

At Pentair, you will work alongside passionate problem-solvers who are committed to the future of our planet. We put our mission into practice, helping the world sustainably move, improve, and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential water filtration to industrial water management to pool products and more, our 9,000 global employees serve customers in more than 150 countries, working to help create a better world for people and the planet through smart, sustainable water solutions.

We have an opportunity for a Product Manager to join our team. You will be a key leader who refines and optimizes the overall product strategy for Pentair’s portfolio of products. **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship  
  
  
  
  
**About Tivly**  
Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.  
  
**About the Role**  
The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. The role aligns priorities across multiple teams into one clear, sequenced plan, sets the standard for what “ready for engineering” means, and makes sure the work being built is the work that matters most. It operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the primary point of accountability for stakeholder alignment across engineering, client services, sales, marketing, and operations, and it drives cross-team decisions to documented outcomes.  
  
**What You'll Do**

**Stakeholder Management & Outcomes**

* Own stakeholder management for the product area: identify key stakeholders, set expectations, manage communication cadence, and be the single point of accountability for alignment. What You'll Do
* Gather priorities from engineering, client services, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership and reconcile them into one shared, sequenced roadmap

* Manage cross-team dependencies and external partners so that every open item has a named owner, a next step, and a follow-up cadence.
* Escalate with a clear recommendation when a decision belongs above the team.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap aligned to company objectives.
* Lead discovery with client services, sales, and business stakeholders to identify the underlying problems behind requests and validate opportunities before committing to work.

**Requirements & Specification**

* Translate business ideas into clear technical requirements — most requests arrive as a business problem, not a deliverable, and it's in this role to determine what's actually needed and who else needs to weigh in.
* Own backlog health so work arrives at planning well-defined, right-sized, and sequenced against the roadmap.
* Write and maintain requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases precise enough that engineering can build without re-litigating scope.
* Partner with engineering on feasibility and technical approach early, and make scope decisions when tradeoffs arise mid-delivery while keeping stakeholders informed of the impact.

**Process & Standards**

* Define and evolve how intake, refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder acceptance work for the team, adjusting as team size, cadence, and product needs change.
* Partner with engineering to maintain accurate documentation and decision records so past decisions remain traceable.
* Identify recurring friction in how work moves between teams and drive fixes rather than workarounds.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, CRM, lead generation, or insurance/fintech.
* Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.
* Track record of owning a product area’s roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Digital Service Product Owner
jobs.desc:
Overview:

The Digital Service Product Owner is responsible for developing and continuously improving the digital and customer facing AI capabilities that support our Field Service Engineers and our customers.  
  
The role has two primary objectives:

  

* Improve FSE productivity by providing faster and easier access to technical knowledge, troubleshooting guidance, service information, and AI-enabled tools.
* Develop the customer-facing digital and AI experience, enabling customers to directly access selected Waters knowledge and support capabilities as part of our Service value proposition.

The role owns the Digital Service product roadmap and translates customer and field needs into practical capabilities that improve customer experience, instrument uptime, field efficiency, and the value of Waters Service.

Responsibilities:

**Own the Digital & AI Service Roadmap**

* Own and prioritize the roadmap for Service digital and AI capabilities.
* Understand customer and FSE needs and translate them into clear product requirements.
* Partner with Digital, IT, Technical Support, Product Management, Regional Service and other teams to develop and deploy solutions.
* Use feedback, adoption, and performance data to continuously improve the products.

**Improve FSE & Expert Center Productivity**

* Work directly with service delivery teams to understand their workflows and identify opportunities to simplify their work.
* Continuously improve digital and AI tools.
* Enable faster access to technical knowledge, troubleshooting information, service history, known issues, and other relevant content.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce non-value-added activities.
* Measure adoption and productivity improvements.

**Develop the Customer AI Experience**

* Define how customers should interact with Waters AI and what problems the platform should help them solve.
* Understand the customer journey and design a simple experience from question to resolution or escalation.
* Define, with Technical Support and subject-matter experts, the appropriate level of technical content available to customers.
* Maintain clear differentiation between customer-accessible knowledge and the deeper technical capabilities available to Waters FSEs.
* Continuously improve the experience based on customer feedback, usage, and unresolved needs.

**Connect Digital Capabilities to Service Offers**

* Work closely with the ASD Global Service Offers Management team to ensure the digital roadmap and Service offer portfolio evolve together.
* For each capability, determine whether it is primarily an internal capability improving Service operations and FSE productivity; or a customer-facing capability that can increase the value and differentiation of our Service contracts.
* Partner with the offer management team to identify opportunities to incorporate digital and AI capabilities into existing Service contracts or develop new premium offerings, including appropriate customer access and entitlements.

**Ensure Content Readiness & Drive Adoption**

* Partner with designated content owners across AI Team, Global Technical Support, Product Management, FSE experts, and other teams to define the technical content and knowledge required for both FSE and customer AI experiences.
* Hold content owners accountable for delivering and maintaining their assigned content, while coordinating priorities, dependencies, and timelines across teams.
* Ensure contributions come together as a cohesive, customer-friendly experience, with appropriate customer-facing content and deeper technical knowledge available to Waters experts.
* Look across the end-to-end experience to identify content gaps, inconsistencies, and emerging opportunities, and work with the responsible owners to address them.
* Drive adoption with FSEs and customers and continuously improve capabilities based on feedback and actual usage.

**Success will be measured through:**

* Increased adoption

jobs.title: Product Owner - Agile
jobs.desc:
**The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.**

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

**Functional Job Summary:**

  

At the Standard, Agile Product Owner job family is a discipline focused on the execution of product strategy and vision. The Product Owner family defines and prioritizes product features, aligns business goals with customer needs, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver high-value solutions in an Agile environment. They advocate for the end user, monitor key performance metrics, and drive collaboration across teams to deliver high-quality, timely solutions. Product Owners balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, leveraging data and feedback to continuously improve the product and ensure project success.

  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

  

The Product Owner is a member of the Agile Team responsible for defining Stories and prioritizing the team backlog to streamline the execution of program priorities while maintaining the conceptual and technical integrity of the features for the team. The Product Owner has a significant role in incremental value delivery and collaborates with the team to ensure that the story meets the definition of done.

  

20% Strategy & Planning

* Develops a deep understanding of the customer, their needs and is a champion for the voice of the customer.
Contributes to 12-18 month product roadmap and assists in prioritization of business features.  

  

80% Execution & Delivery

* Collaborates with Product Manager on feature creation and Program Backlog prioritization.
* Drives the decomposition of features into story maps and incremental value delivery.

* Responsible for the preparation and participation in PI Planning.
* Executes against the product roadmap and PI Priorities.
* Accountable for the health and readiness of the team backlog, including new features, defects and technical debt.
* Manages and prioritizes the flow of work to ensure consistency of incremental value delivery.
* Develops detailed user stories containing thorough and testable acceptance criteria, along with non-functional requirements.
* Understands enabler work and collaborates with product analysts and engineers to define and prioritize effectively in the backlog.
* Integrates user feedback and usability studies/research, to enhance user satisfaction.
* Collaborates with Product Manager to analyze metrics and analytics to make data informed decisions.
Keeps pulse on the customers, anticipates bottlenecks, makes tradeoffs, and takes acceptable risks to maximize the benefit for our customer and business.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong communication skills including active listening and effective presentation of ideas.
* Must excel working in team-oriented roles that rely on ability to collaborate with others.
* Curiosity – ensures that user stories drive the associated value to the customer.
* Exhibits bias-to-action and avoids analysis-paralysis.
* Separates what must be done now, and what can be improved later.
* Willing to take informed risks.
* Knowledge & Skills: Must exhibit strong consumer instincts, intuitively understands why product ideas will succeed, excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to communicate with a wide range of cross-functional team members and business owners, experience with hypothesis-driven learning and turning data into actionable insights.

jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

  

**Job Description:**

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

  

The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible.

  

They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. This is a hybrid role

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify new opportunities and inform product strategy.
* Translate complex customer needs and market insights into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful product development and commercialization.
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Monitor product performance, gather customer feedback, and iterate on features to drive continuous improvement and customer engagement.
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and updates to internal and external stakeholders.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to maximize organizational efficiency.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in product management, particularly with analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of product development methodologies and product commercialization processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.
* Demonstrated ability in group problem solving and strategic execution.
* Proficiency in computer literacy, including advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with marketing and customer engagement strategies.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of effective multitasking.
Strong researching abilities to inform product decisions and market understanding.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing tax, accounting, or other regulated professional-services software, ideally enterprise products serving large firms.
* Hands-on experience building and launching AI/ML-enabled products or features, including working with engineering on responsible AI, data quality, and governance.
* Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes such as adoption, retention, and revenue, with experience in pricing, packaging, and business-case development.
* Experience mentoring junior Product Managers and leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

jobs.desc:
Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss.  
Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis.

* We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011
* Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight
* Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote

**About Bitsight**
------------------

Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader. We help companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Global enterprises, governments, and organizations rely on Bitsight to prioritize cybersecurity investments, build trust within their ecosystem, and reduce the chance of financial loss.

We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011. Over 3,500 customers trust Bitsight. Our team of more than 600 people works from Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote locations around the world.

**About the Role**
------------------

Bitsight's engineering organization is changing fast. AI tools now write and review a growing share of our code, and the path from ticket to shipped change is shifting with them. We need a Technical Product Manager to help prioritize and coordinate execution on improvements to our process.

You will work closely with our engineering and AI subject matter expert teams.You will coordinate the work needed to improve and adopt AI-supported engineering workflows, bringing developer feedback, evidence, and open decisions to the people responsible for them.

**What You'll Do**

  

* Work with engineering and product leaders to agree on priorities, team participation, and the changes needed to put those priorities into practice. Bring product context into engineering discussions, and bring developers’ feedback into product decisions. Work with engineering teams day to day on priorities, process, and how AI fits into their workflow.
* Contribute to the AI SDLC roadmap. Gather input from engineers, surface high-impact use cases for AI in coding, review, testing, and documentation, and help shape priorities with the product and engineering leads.
* Coordinate work on the AI code reviewer. Help teams and its engineering owners agree on needs, priorities, delivery plans, and follow-up.
* Track the flow of work from ticket to merge request (MR). Spot gaps and bottlenecks, and work with teams to close them.
* Help engineering teams and product partners agree on quality expectations for AI-generated code edits. Track outcomes against those expectations, flag trends, and follow up with the accountable owners.
* Analyze where time goes across the SDLC. Pull the data, identify the biggest sources of delay, and recommend fixes.
* Support adoption of AI tooling across engineering. Collect feedback, work with internal champions, and report on how teams are using the tools.
* Work with security, compliance, and architecture partners so AI adoption stays safe and consistent with our policies.
* Help update Bitsight's product process to fit an AI-driven SDLC, documenting changes and rolling them out.
* Support the AI subject matter expert (SME) team with planning, prioritization, and coordinating their work with engineering teams.

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Experience as a software engineer. You have written and shipped production code and can hold your own in technical conversations with engineers.
* Familiarity with the SDLC, from idea to ticket to code to release.
* Strong organizational and project management skills. You can track many small, concurrent workstreams without dropping any.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Product Manager leads the development and commercialization of future versions of on-market or new product lines including new features and service components. This person supports the vision and 5-year planning for our product roadmap to remain a premium brand with leading market share. This role combines strategic thinking with execution, and requires strong leadership in cross-functional teams. Responsible for the product lifecycle from concept to obsolescence. This includes creation of a strategic product roadmap, evaluation and prioritization of new features and programs, creation of product requirements, and evaluation and improvement of product performance.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop or co-develop and execute the product roadmap for one or more reproductive health tests.
  • Deliver product requirements based on customer needs and operational limitations.
  • Manage product performance and field all product support needs, working across departments, including Product Management, Molecular Biology R&D, Statistics R&D, Software Engineering, Sales & Marketing, Clinical/Medical, Operations, Regulatory, and Business Development.
  • Develop quantitative product performance indicators, analyze and track performance data, and identify strategies for improvement across teams.
  • Identify business opportunities and create business cases and financial models.
  • Conduct VOC interviews, market research, and competitive analysis as a means to test and validate product features, improve customer satisfaction and support market growth.
  • Support product marketing in the definition of product positioning – from market launch plans, pricing, and delivering key collateral content to marketing communications.
  • Create written, data-based arguments and presentations to achieve buy-in from stakeholders
  • Provide internal and external stakeholders with the appropriate updates on progress, vision, product roadmap, etc.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in physical or life science, statistics or engineering discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience, which includes 2-3 years of product management, product/solution marketing, product commercialization, or strategic consulting experience.
  • Experience with Prenatal products/education, medical devices, or diagnostics preferred.
  • Expertise and experience in the Life Sciences industry preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to lead and motivate a cross-functional team
  • Ability to understand technology and articulate customer value/benefit propositions
  • Strong project/process management skills required.

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Alpaca's product team is looking for a Product Manager to own Alpaca's regulated crypto trading and yield surface: spot or perps exchange, fiat and stablecoin funding rails, staking / lending and the crypto API that partners build on.

You will partner deeply with engineering, compliance, legal, partnerships, and the broader Alpaca product team to ship regulated crypto infrastructure at scale. You will help shape and grow the crypto product itself, and you will be expected to provide early signal on US policy changes rather than react after rules formalize.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Own the spot crypto exchange product surface - pair coverage, order types, availability in various jurisdictions and the partner facing experience for trading crypto on Alpaca.
  • Lead integrations that unlock funding and liquidity with LPs and custodians. Own the stablecoin funding flow, including paths for USDC and other regulated / GENIUS-aligned stables.
  • Work with partners to understand crypto needs for fintechs, neobrokers, and institutional platforms. Expand supported networks and coins that balances partner demand and custody readiness.
  • Drive staking and lending / earn product design within regulatory and ops constraints.
  • Shape a crypto API surface that treats developers and agents as primary customers: SDKs, reference integrations, changelog discipline.
  • Lead and execute the product case for crypto perps.

Who You Are (Must Haves):

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and ready to own a core regulated crypto product surface.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of exp

About our client: Our client is at the forefront of digital transformation, specializing in advanced network management solutions that revolutionize how businesses connect, secure, and manage their networks. The cutting-edge platform integrates comprehensive connectivity, security, and management tools, providing robust and reliable solutions across diverse industries. Our client is a startup driven by innovation and a commitment to excellence, with a particular focus on leveraging the latest wireless technologies such as 5G and Starlink. Job Title: Product Manager Location: Remote in India Position Overview: Our client is seeking a mid-level Product Manager with a strong technical background to join their dynamic team and directly support the Director of Products. The ideal candidate will have experience in product management and project management, particularly within the network management or technology sector. This role involves creating and managing the infrastructure necessary to clarify and drive success in their product development efforts. You will act as the glue that brings together various disciplines, ensuring seamless collaboration and keeping projects on track. Requirements Key Responsibilities: Assist in defining and refining the product development process. Create and manage Confluence spaces for product requirements, features, and roadmaps, ensuring clear and organized documentation. Facilitate communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing. Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and progress reports to ensure product development stays on schedule. Coordinate and manage product-related meetings, ensuring follow-up on action items and decisions made. Conduct market research to support product planning and development efforts. Gather and organize feedback from customers and stakeholders, translating it into actionable insights. Help develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, release notes, and training materials. Act as a liaison between different teams, ensuring alignment and understanding of project goals and timelines. Support the Director of Products in various tasks to drive product development success. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent

jobs.title: Product Management MBA Intern, Data Center GPU - Summer 2027
Junior Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten)
jobs.desc:
What to expect


Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die eine moderne, datengestützte Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen und die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Zuhause schlagen. Unsere App bietet Patient*innen die Freiheit, ihre Nachsorge zeitlich flexibel und ortsunabhängig zu gestalten – individuell begleitet durch unser therapeutisches Team.

Als Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten) gestaltest du die digitale Transformation im deutschen Gesundheitswesen aktiv mit. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Impact, denn jedes Feature, das du entwickelst, zahlt direkt auf den Genesungsweg von Menschen ein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Engineering und Data durchläufst du alle Facetten eines modernen Produktzyklus – von der ersten Hypothese bis zum Release. Du arbeitest hands-on mit Prototypen, nutzt Experimente zum Lernen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer*innen. So erlebst du unmittelbar, welchen wertvollen Unterschied deine Arbeit für das Leben von Patient:innen und die Zukunftsfähigkeit unseres Gesundheitssystems macht.

Diese Rolle ist perfekt für dich, wenn...

  • ...du den direkten Kontakt liebst: Wöchentliche Nutzerinterviews sind für dich kein Pflichttermin, sondern deine wichtigste Inspirationsquelle

  • ...du Geschwindigkeit schätzt: Schnelles Prototyping und Shipping motivieren dich mehr als monatelange Konzeptionsphasen

  • ...du mutig entscheidest: Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, auch bei unvollständiger Datenlage die Richtung vorzugeben und durch Iteration zu lernen





Your Challenges


  • Werde zur Stimme unserer Nutzer*innen: Du führst eigenständig Interviews mit Patient*innen und sprichst regelmäßig mit Ärzt*innen und Kliniken. Du tauchst tief in ihre Lebensrealität ein, analysierst ihre Herausforderungen und übersetzt echte Gespräche in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, die den Genesungsweg spürbar verbessern

  • Gestalte die Therapie von morgen: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie mit Experimenten und Prototypen – und baust gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering echte Lösungen, die in unserer App live gehen. Du begleitest Features vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Release und darüber hinaus

  • Wachse in die Verantwortung für deinen Squad: Gemeinsam mit Design, Tech und Medizin moderierst du den Weg von der ersten Idee bis zum Release. Du lernst, wie man Klarheit schafft und Hindernisse aus dem Weg räumt, damit ihr am Ende gemeinsam den Erfolg eurer Arbeit feiern könnt

  • Sorge für Transparenz und Vertrauen: Du kommunizierst Fortschritte und Hürden offen. Dein Ziel ist es, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen und eine Basis zu schaffen, auf der wir unsere Produktvision Schritt für Schritt gemeinsam in die Realität umsetzen

  • Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

Our products support our humanitarian mission in many ways, including delivering financial assistance to those impacted by disasters, visualizing situational awareness for disaster response and logistics operations, and onboarding and assigning volunteers to critical mission roles.

  

**About Our Contact Center and Operations Platforms:**

This role supports a portfolio of 24x7 contact center platforms serving Disaster Relief, SAF Hero Care, and Fundraising operations. Built on AWS Amazon Connect and modern IVR technologies, these mission-critical systems help clients, donors, military families, volunteers, and responders access information, assistance, and support, especially during periods of crisis and large-scale disaster activity. The product portfolio integrates with numerous business systems and focuses on delivering compassionate, high-quality client experiences while driving operational efficiency, workforce productivity, and service excellence. The team is actively advancing automation, AI, intelligent routing, agent assist, and digital self-service capabilities to improve both client outcomes and operational performance.

**The Position:**

We are seeking a Product Manager to own and evolve our Contact Center platform — the technology and experience layer that powers workforce productivity, real-time operational insight, and AI-enabled service delivery across our contact center and chapter network. This role sits at the intersection of agent experience, customer/client experience, and AI innovation, and is responsible for ensuring that every call, chat, and interaction path is efficient, intelligent, and easy to navigate — for both the people answering and the people calling.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable diving into IVR call-flow logic and phone routing architecture as they define a roadmap for AI-assisted coaching, sentiment analysis, and generative summarization. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring close partnership with contact center operations, chapter/field offices, engineering, data science, and telephony vendors.

When our square shaped burgers made their first sizzle on the scene more than 50 years ago, people knew our approach wasn’t like any other. Same goes for the way we support our employees. Our culture of openness, flexibility, and inclusiveness allows everybody to flourish in their own way. If you’re looking for a career where you can be part of the action as we continue to grow our iconic brand – We got you!

The Associate Product Owner (APO) plays several key roles acting as the voice of the customer and advocating for the lifecycle of their products. In this role, you will help business owners realize the vision and align technology with key business objectives. You will drive progress on key initiatives through the execution of product roadmap(s) and management of backlog(s), and act as the link between the Product Manager and technical development teams. The APO will be on Wendy’s data management team working on enterprise data and analytics dashboard and reporting projects supporting our HR and Finance organizations. In this role, you will have the opportunity work on building out our next gen analytics and reporting applications on top of Looker and Big Query in the Google Cloud. A successful candidate in this role will demonstrate strong leadership, prioritization, and communication skills to consistently deliver outstanding results on-time and in line with established budget.

Responsibilities:

* Own sprint backlog and implementation of new product initiatives. Prioritizes product backlog working against established roadmap and coordinating dependencies with other POs. Manages portfolio of IT initiatives to ensure proper prioritization and delivery of initiatives on time and on budget.
* Responsible for development of lean business case. Incorporates this knowledge when prioritizing features for releases. Makes tradeoff decisions between scope (value in expected ROI) and schedule (higher operating expense in longer release cycles) to reflect the best interests of business owners and end users.
* As part of PI planning, decomposes feature(s) into user Stories and establishes Story acceptance criteria. Defines the definition of done.
* Facilitate relationship with the end customer and business leadership/owners, bringing the voice and priorities of the customer to the forefront. Work cross-functionally to ensure business requirements and solution capabilities are effectively matched and implemented. Develops spirit of teamwork and collaboration with clear lines of accountability for key decisions.
* Weekly tracking of incidents and service tasks to completion in partnership with service team. Shares regular feedback and follow up with business partners.
* Responsible for product introduction & review with stakeholders. Documents Story acceptance criteria into JIRA and approves/validates Stories into baseline.
* Understands business objectives and clarifies customer objectives for scrum teams.

  
Minimum Wage: USD $93,000.00/Yr. Maximum Wage: USD $158,000.00/Yr. Qualifications:

* Experience working in IT that has resulted in an understanding of technology and its applications.
* Understanding of and experience with Agile methodology required.
* Excellent communication skills. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and align stakeholders with competing interests.
* Proven prioritization and organization skills.
* Possesses financial acumen to ensure that organizational change efforts are aligned with the financial perspective of the desired business benefits.
* Passion for partnership with inclusive and diverse teams and mirror Wendy’s core values ‘Treat People with Respect’ and ‘Do the Right Thing’.
